376 —pa'i ting nge 'dzin kyi bar brgyad dang / de'i steng du mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i rnam par grol ba dang / mi slob pa'i yang dag pa'i shes pa ste mi slob pa'i chos bcur 'phags pa thogs med kyi gzhung 'ga' zhig la sa dbye ba mdzad de ngo bo dang sgras brjod ci rigs pa'i dbye bar blta'o/ /de lta bu'i lam bden gyi phan yon ni/ byang chub tu bgrod pa 'a ma gyi bya ba'i yon tan dang / sngib pa gnyis kyi gnyen po bzhi'i ci rigs byed pa rig pa'i bya ba'i yon tan dang / yang dag pa'i don la sems phyin ci ma log par phyorga/sa par byed pa sgrub pa'i bya ba'i yon tan dang / gang du bgrod pa'i spangs rtogs las nam yang mi nyams par byed pa nges 'byin gyi bya ba'i ོ/na tan dang / don dam par mtha' bzhir bsam du med pa'i yon tan dang / las nyon gnyis kyi cha ci rigs dang bral ba'i yon tan dang /phyin ci log gi rtog pa gang rigs rgyang bsrings rme'i yon tan dang / rang spong byed sgrib pa'i dri ma rnam par dag pa'i yon tan dang / rang yul bden pa gnyis po'i gang rung gsal ba'i yon tan dang / gnyen po zag med kyi ngo bor skye ba'i yon tan sogs phan yon mtha' yas pa mdo dang bstan bcos dag las mang du gsungs shing / bslab gsum so so'i phan yon tshul zhi lharte/ rnga sum gyi skabs su 'byung bas mtshon lam bden gyi bye brag so so'i phan yon rnams zhib tu brjod na bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i drin las nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye ba lta bu yod kyang blo gros kyi khyon dog pa dag snying 'gas pa'i gnas yo/da pas re zhig bzhag go /lam bden dang 9ram bden gyi nyams len thams cad bslab pa rin po che gsum du 'du

377bas/ de'i tshul la/ bshad pa/ tshangs pas zhus pa dang / sa'i dngos gzhi las 'byung ba ltar sems 'dul ba'i rim pa dang / 'bras bu gnyis po'i gang la ltos kyang bslab pa gsum du grangs nges pa dang / bka' gdams gong ma'i man ngag las 'byung ba ltar nyon mongs 'dul ba la ltos te bslab pa sa/sum du grangs nges bar 'o skol gyi ston pa blo bzang rgyal bas gsungs so/ /de bas na go rim la'ang / sems 'dul ba'i rim pa la ltos pa'i go rim dang / 'bras bu la ltos pa'i go rim dang / spang bya la ltos pa'i go rim rnam pa gsum du grub pa yin no/ /sgom rim dang nyan sa la sogs pa'i gzhung che ba dag las zhi gnas kyi tshogs drug dang / byang chub kyi tshogs bcu gsum gsungs ba thams cad tshul khrims srung ba'i nang du 'du lugs/ dran shes bzhin bag yod la sogs pa tshul khrims srung ba'i yan lag yin tshul/ tshul khrims yan lag dang bcas pa ma nyams par bsrungs na ting nge 'dzin shugs drag rtsol med ngang gis 'byung lus/sa/ting nge 'dzin gyi skyong tshul dran pa'i skyong tshul yin pa sogs la nges pa drangs na tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la brten nas sems kyi bslab pa zhi gnas/ 'byung ba dang / sems kyi bslab pa zhi gnas la brten nas shes rapa kyi bslab pa lhag mthong 'grub tshul la nges pa 'drong bar 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i bslab pa gsum gyi rang bzhin dang / dbye ba sogs ji ltar gzung snyam ma// smras pa/ skyabs 'gro 'am nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin ba'i yan lag drug dang ldan pa'i cha nas bzhag pa'i srung ba'i sems pa de/lhag pa tshu' khrims kyi bslab pa'i ngo bo dang / rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba

378srung ba'i tshul khrims dang / bcas pa 'i kha na ma tho ba srung ba'i tshul khrims gnyis las phyi ma la/ so thar dang / byang sems dang / sngags kyi sdom pa gsum mam/ yang na so thar dang / bsam gtan dang / zag med kyi tshul khrims gsum yo da pa ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i dbye ba dang /nyan sa las byung ba lta ra lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa skye ba'i rgyu dang bslab par bya ba'i gnas yen pas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang / yang na tshul 'chal gyi tsha gdung zhi bar byed pa dang / skyabs 'gro'i stobs kyis phyi rol ba las khyad par du 'phags pas na lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang / sa sde dang / bshes springs 'grel ba dang / 'dul mngon gyi gzhung las gsungs pa lta ra lhag pa myang 'das kyi ched du bya ba'i tshul khrims yi na pas na lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa zhes bya ba ni lhag pa tshu2 khrims kyi bslab ba'i sgra bshad pa'o/ /skyabs 'gro 'am nges 'byung gi bsam pas zin pa'i bsam gtan dang gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi dang nyer bsdogs ci rigs kyis bsdus pa'i ting nge 'dzin de/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa'i ngo bo dang / nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi gnyis las phyi ma la/ bsam gzugs brgyad dang / yang na/ 'jig rten pa'i zhi gnas dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhi gnas gnyis dang / zhi rags rnam can dang zag med bden pa'i rnam can gnyis yod pa ni lhag pa sems kyi ribaslab pa'i dbye ba dang / lhag ba'i shes rab skye ba'i rgyu dang bslab par bya ba'i gnas yin pas na lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa dang / yid dmigs pa la rtse gcig tu 'dzin par byed pa dang skyabs 'gro'i stobs kyis phyi rol ba las

— — 319khyad par du 'phags pas na lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa dang / lhag pa myang 'das kyi ched du bya ba'i bsam gtan yin pas na lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa zhes bya ba ni lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa'i sgra bshad pa'o/ /skyabs 'gro 'am nges 'byung gis zin pa'i rang yul bden pa gnyis po'i gang rung gi rnam pa rtogs pa'i bsgomasacibyung gi chos rab tu rnam 'byed de/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i mtshan nyid dang / mi rtag sogs rtogs pa'i lhang/mthong bcu drug dang / ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gnyis dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lhag mthong gnyis yod pa ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i dbye ba dang / nyon mongs spong ba'i rgyu dang bslab par bya ba'i gnas yin pas na lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dang / dam pa'i don shes pa dang skyabs 'gro'i stobs kyis phyi rol pa las lhag pas na lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa dang / lhag pa myang 'daṭasdo kyi ched du bya ba'i shes rab yin pas na lhag pa shes rab gyi bslab pa zhes bya ba ni lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'i sgra bshad pa'o/ /byang sems kyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni/ rab tu dbye ba'i khyad par dang / bslab pa thun mong ba dang thun mong min pa'i khyad par dang / rgya che ba'i khyad par dang / zab pa'i khyad par bzhis nyan rang gi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa las khyad par du 'phags pa dang / byang sems kyi sems kyi bslab pa ni/dmigs pas rab tu dbye ba dang / sna tshogs pas rab tu dbye ba dang /gnyen pos rab tu dbye ba dang / las rung gis rab tu dbye ba dang /mngon par sgrub pas rab tu dbye ba dang / las kyis rab tu dbye ba drug

380 gis nyan rang gi sems kyi bslab pa las khyad par du 'phags pa dang /byang sems kyi shes rab kyi bslab pa ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo dang / gnas dang / gzhi dang / dmigs pa dang / rnam pa dang / brgal lan dang / rten dang / grogs dang / rnam par smin pa dang / rgyu mthun pa dang / nges par 'byung ba dang / mthar thug par 'gro ba dang / phan yo na dang / rab tu dbye ba dang / dpe dang / bya ba sgrub pa dang / zab pa ste bcu bdun gyis nyan rang gi shes rab kyi bslab pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i tshul la sogs pa shes par bya'o/ /bsdu ba'i zin so 'ga' zhig la brten nas mi slob lam lam bden gyi 'khor tsam las lam bden dngos min par bshad pa'i bod kyi mkhas pa dag gi gzhung yod kyang lung rigs kyis mi 'thad par grub pa dang / lam la lam bden gyis khyab pa dang ma khyab par gsungs pa gnyis las phyi ma dpung 'thug pa dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa thams cad bslab pa gsum/ du 'du ya nga bslab gsum gang rung yin pa'i tshul du mi 'du ba dang / zhi lha ga sanyis thob pa'i rjes su so thar gyi sdom pa mnod pa dang / lta thog nas sgom pa 'tshol ba dngu / sgom thog nas lta ba 'tshol ba yod pa dang / lhag pa sems kyi bslab pas lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa skyed pa dang / lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pas lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa skyed pa yod par bshad ba'i rgya gzhung che ba yod kyang bslab gsum la go rim ma nges pa'i skyon med pa dang / bslab pa gsum gsar du skye ba'i go rim de ltar yin yang skyes zin mngom du bya ba la de 'dra'i go rim ma nges pa dang / srung sems

— 381'khor bcas tshul khrims kyi bsgab pa dang / 'jog sgom gyi rigs su gyur ba thams cad sems kyi bslab pa dang / dpyad sgom gyi rigs su gyur ba thams cad shes rab kyi bslab pa la 'jog pa dang / bslab pa gsum la rid+dha/ ba'i/na tshul khrims dang / zhi gnas dang / lhag mthong gis khyab par 'dod pa gnyis las phyi ma la sgrub byed dpag tu med pa dang / tshangs bas zhus/ pa las gsungs pa ltar tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la yan lag drug so so'i ngos 'dzin/ sems kyi bslab pa la sems gnas pa bzhi so so'i ngo bo / shes rab kyi bslab pa la bden bzhi'i rnam pa bzhi rtogs pa'i rang bzhin rgya gar paṇa chen gyi gtsug lag tshad mar gyur ba rgya mtsho lta bu las ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul dang / tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la yan lag drug ldan dang / sems kyi bslab pa la sems gnas pa bzhi gang rung dang / shes rab kyi bslab pa la bden bzhi'i rnam pa bzhi bo'i gang rung rtogs pas khyab pa ma nges pa dang / lta sgom spyod gsum dang bslab gsum phyogs 'dra yangadon gcig min pa sogs dka' ba'i gnas la daphyod pa'i sgo mang du yod kyang phyogs tsam mtshon pa'o/ /ci'i phyir zhen/ ding sang bslab pa gsum gyi tha snyad kun gyi kha na rlung ltar grags shing bka' pod lnga bslab pa gsum gtan la 'bebs byed yem/ par sgrogs pa can las bslab gsum gyi grangs nges ge rim ngo bo sgra bshad so so'i bslab tshul theg pa che chung gi bslab gsum gyi mchog dman re re'i thad du 'phags bod kyi gzhung che ba so so na sa gung bsgrigs te rtsar bcad nas don dpyis phyin par shes pa nyin skar las kyang dkon pa'i tshod du snang ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /

382 —lnga ba ni/ spyir bo/ rims la/ thos pa'i sa las/ go rims gang zhe na/ tho/ rims rnam pa drug ste/ 'jug pa'i go rims dang / bya ba sgrub pa'i gi rims dang / bstan pa'i go rims dang / skye ba'i go rims dang / mngon par rtogs pa'i go rims dang / snyoms par 'jug pa'i go rims so/ /zhes go rims drug dang / gzhan yang gzhung chen mo rnam sa la brtags na/ mdo rgyas dang / dka' sla dang / phra rags dang /mang nyung dang / mchog dman dang / brtag pa'i go rims sogs mang bo zhig 'byung ba las/ bden bzhi la/ brtso/da pa'i go rims dang / skye ba'i go rims dang / mdon rtogs kyi go rims gsum snang zhing / bcom ldan 'das kyis rgyu 'bras dang mi mthun par/ sdug kun 'gog lam bzhi'i tho/ rims gsungs pa ni mngom/ rtogs skye ba'i go rims dang bstun cing nyams len gyi gnad chen po yod do/ /mkhas pa gang dag mdo mang bor bden bzhi'i khyad chos bcu drug rim par gsungs pa dang / nyan sa dang / bsdu ba dang / rnam 'grel gyi sgras zin 'ga' zhig dang bstun pa'i lugs su mdzad nas stong bdag med gnyis kun 'byung gi rjes su rtogs dgos pa lung rigs gnyis ka dang 'gal bar gsungs nas rang lugs la khyad chos bcu drug go rims ma 'chol bar rtogs dgos par gsungs pa ni/ larme rim che chung / phar phyin dang rnam 'grel gnyis kyi dar ṭīkatshad ma'i brjed byang / tshad ma'i lam bsgrigs/ rnam 'grel ṭīka chen/sde bdun rgyan sogs rje yab sras kyis bden bzhi'i rtogs rim bshad pa'i gzhung thams cad dang 'gal zhing sdug bsngal las dang / las nyon mongs— —

383 dang / nyon mongs bdag 'dzin las byung ba'i tshul gyis 'khor bar 'khor ba'i 'jug rim shes nas de'i rjes su rtsa ba nas/ 'byin nus mi nus la dpyod pa zhugs dgos pa dang / khyad chos bcu drug rim par gsungs pa'ang phar phyin lam bsgrigs las gsungs pa ltar mi rtag sdug pasngal gnyis gsungs pa'i zla la sdug bden gyi khyad chos gzhan stong bdag med gnyis kyang bshad pa'i 'gros bde ba'i dbang gis byung ba tsam las rtogs rim de ltar min pa dang / rnam 'grel las sgom pa lhag ma zhes pa'i lhag ma la mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis las gzhan mi dgos par bshad pa mi 'thad pa dang / kun 'byung gi 'jug rim rtogs pa la bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa bar rtogs dgos kyang / de la bdag 'dzin 'khor ba'i rtsa bar song ba shes pas chog gi bdag 'dzin gyi zhen yul med pa nges pa'i sgo nas de spong nus su rtogs mi dgos pas kun 'byung rtogs pa la stong bdag med tegs mi dgos pas na/ bden bzhi'i khyad chos drus gi rjes su stong bdag med gnyis rtogs dgos tshul dang / stong bdag med gnyis rtogs pa'i sngon du mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis tsam rtogs dgos zer ba dang / rnam pa bcu bzhi bo rtogs pa 'gro dgos par 'dod pa dang / kun btags la mi dgos kyang bdag 'dzin lhan skyes kyi zhen yul bkag pa'i bdag med phra mo rtogs pa la de ltar dgos zer ba sogs la snying bo med pa dang / rnam 'grel las/ stong nyid lta bas grol 'gyur gyi/ /zhes sogs kyis smin grol gyi lam gnyis bstan kyang de sdug bden gyi khyad chos bzhi gzhir bzhag la smin grol gyi lam gnyis su phye ba las bden bzhi'i khyad chos bcu drug

384rtogs pa la min zer ba dang / bden bzhi'i khyad chos bcu drug rtogs pa la mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis dang kun 'byung gi bzhi ste drug rtogs pa smin lam dang / stong bdag med gnyis rtogs pa grol lam du 'dod pa dang /khyad chos bcu bzhi rtogs pa tsam du ma zad tshad med bzhi sogs thabs kyi cha thams cad smin lam yin 'ing de yang stong bdag med rtogs pa'i lam skyed pa dang sbyong ba'i cha ci rigs nas bshad pa gsum ga bshad pa'i rnam grangs su mi rigs pa med mod phyi ma ltar byas na khas blang bskyang bde ba dang / skad cig re rer 'jig pa'i mi rtag pa rtogs pa las skye rga na 'chi la rīsogs pa'i sdug bsngal rtogs sla rdzu5nga mi rtag sdug bsngal rga/nyis kyi nang nas sngon du sdug bsngal rtogs dgos pa'i thal ba mi 'jug pa dang / bden bzhi'i khyad chos bzhi tshan rnams dngos shugs ci rigs pa'i sgo nas cig car du rtogs par 'dod pa dang / rang rang gi ngos skal gyi bsal bya'i log rtog mi 'dra ba re yod pas rim can du rtogs par 'dod pa dag la sgrub byed btsan po dmigs su med pa dang / bden pa bzhi ga shes par bya ba dang / sdug kun gnyis spang bar bya ba dang / 'gog lam gnyis mngon du bya ba dang / bden pa bzhi ga bsgom par bya ba yi/na yang bden pa bzhi la mdo las rim par shes spong mngon sgom bzhis bstan pa'i rgyu mtshan sogs rtsar gcad par bya ba rgya mtsho lta bu yod do/ /de yang bden bzhi'i rnam par bzhag ba 'di la lung rigs dpe gsum gyi dpung gi rgyab dang bcas bkod na deb lnga brgyar bsdu mi nus pa'i sngon med legs bshad kyi ya mtshan/ ci yang ston par rngo thogs mod/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyul bos/

385 legs bshad 'bras bu'i khur gyis rab brjid cing / /rjod byed tshig gi yal 'dab rab rgyas na/ /rab rmongs byis pa'i tshogs kyis spong rig nas/ dpag d+nghabasam ljon pa'i tshal yang nyung ngur bsgrubs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ blo chung dag rgyas rngams che ba la sgyid lug dang skrag pa skye ba'i gnas spang ba dang yig tshogs la 'dzems nas blo gsal 'i/nga gzu bor gnas pa dag rgya gar paṇa grub dang rje yab sras kyi gzhung lugs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo yangs por grol ba dag rkari dpyod pa 'jug pa'i phyir bya gtong ba'i tshul gyis gter gyi kha byang tsam gzhung che ba dang gtugs nas smras par zad do/ /legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gling du phyin kyang gzhan skyon mching bu'i 'phreng rdog 'tshol ba lhur len pa dag ni/ rang dang rigs mthun gyi 'khor dbus mun khrod du gnas nas dgra med sar dpa' skad dang / lkog na mor ngan lab dang / dug rgyas pa'i 'khrul skad ma ṇir bzla ba'i gnas mchis mod/ de ni 'jig rten pas kyang pho shal du brtsi ba nyid kyi phyir rnam par brgal ba'i rol rtsed la 'jug par 'dod na thong zhog dang 'di rigs kyi tshig re re'i thad la'ang yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i drin las lung rigs kyi ral gri nam yang zad pa med do/ /de bas na mkha' lding dbyings su lding bas mig rgya rgyang du chod pa la bya tsha lis rang mal gyi nam mkha' la bltas te smra ba ma mang zhig ces bya ba yang tho/ bar bya ba'i gtam du brtse bas spras so/ /gnyis pa skabs don gyi gleng bslang ba dngos ni/ de ltar thar ba don gnyer gyi blo rgyud la sned pa dang theg pa gsum k+shi byang chub tu bgrod pa

386la/ mkhas pas bden pa ba'i/'i de nyid gtan la 'bebs pa med du mi rung ba'i gnas su grub gshis/ bdag gi tshe rabs kyi phreng bar me tog phog pa'i lha skal dpal ldan bla ma dam pa smra ba'i rgyal bo/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin rlabs 'od zer gyis mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo yongs su grol pas sa la bzhugs pa dag gis kyang gting dpog par mi nus pa'i ye shes kyi phung bor grub pa/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i 'khor lo mtha' klas pa la sbyangs pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pas rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha'i don mtha' dag gzigs pa dag pa'i spyan gyis mngon sum du dgongs pa/rgyu'i tshogs pa ma tshang ba med par rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin phyag tu blangs pas thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i rtogs pa thams cad— nam mkha' la mdung sbyor ba bzhin du gyur ba/ thos bsam sgom gsum ya ma bral bar gdan thog gcig tu sku nyams su bstar ba la brten nas shing rta chen po dang 'jam mgon tsong kha ba'i dgongs don 'byed pa la 'khrul ba'i dri ma ring du spangs pa/ skyon dang bral ba'i rigs pa'i gad rgyangs gcig gis kyang rtog ge'i gsang tshig la ngal ba brgya phrag lhur blangs pa'i rgan po dag gi don snying lkog ma'i bya skyibs su 'byin pa'i mthu dang ldan pa/ rnam pa thams cad pa'i gsung ngag gcig gis kyang blo'i nus pha che phra ma lus pa rjes su 'dzin pa la sgrin pas skal ba bzang po dang ldan pa rnams kyi mig tu gyur ba/ phun sum tshogs pa'i snyan tshig gcig gis kyang tshig gi mdzis rgyan bla na med pa'i snyan dngags kyi dbang phyug zil gyis gnon pa'i dpal la mnga' brnyes pa/ sgru dang / tshad ma dang / ngazo dang sango /

d+ngha — 387ba dang / snyan ngag dang / sdeb sbyor dang / skar rtsis dang / mngon brjod dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rdo rje theg pa la sogs pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i rang lugs ma lus pa gzigs pa la dus 'dir sa'i steng na zla med pa/ sngon gyi slob dpon chen po rnams dang yon tan gyi cha thams cad nas thams cad du mtshungs so zhes bya ba'i bsngags pas partsi ta rnams kyis bsngags par mdzad pa/ rtsod dus kyi paṇa chen ngag gi dbang bo sargyu snya blo bzang dpal ba'i zhal snga nas sam/ mtshan gyi rol mo gzhan thams cad mkhyen pa mi pham mtsho byung bzhad pa'i lang tsho zhes zhu ba de nyid/ rab tshes lcags khyi lo'i dgun chos skabs/ dpal bkra shis chos sdings zhes bya ba'i mdo smad byang rgyud kyi legs bshad sgrogs pa'i tshal chen por/ phar phyin gzhung gsar ba'i dbus su dam bca' la phebs par/ rigs pa smra bar zho'i 'jam bsam sogs kyis/ sgo mang yig cha gsar bar/ ngo bo'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum yod/ ces dang / ma dag pa'i snod phyi dang /nyer len gyi phung bo nang gi sdug bden du bshad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/zhes dang / nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig pa'i phyir/zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi tshig zin la brten nas sdug bsngal gsum 'gal dgos pa dang / nyer len gyi phung bo dang 'khor ba la nang gi sdug bden gyis khyab dgos pa'i bgro gleng phul lo/ /de'i tshe rtsod dus kyi phyogs kyi glang bo nyido/ nas/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba yim pa dang /de la rang rgyu nye bar len pa las byung bas khyab pa dang / rang rgyu sdug kun

388 gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thog med nas bar ma chad par 'ongs pa'i dngos po yin pas khyab pa nyid kyi phyir/ sdug bden la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang nyer len gyi phung bo dang 'khor ba gsum gyis khyab po/ /zhes bya ba'i dam bca' bskal ba'i mthar yang gzhig par mi nus pa'i rdo rje'i brag ri dgung du 'dzugs par mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i gnas skabs mngon du gyur ba na khong ba dag kyang phyag rdzas kyi dngos pos ci yang gtugs pa'i gnong ba khur du ma theg pa'i yus kyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mkhas pa chen po dzñā nas ra'i sku zhabs su dri rmed la zhugs so/ /'phral can la lha dga' ba'i gsung 'ga' thal ba la brten nas mkhas blun nang dbyer med par mtha' 3/chod pa'i gtam yi gar mi 'ong ba nor skyong 'phongs kyi bsul ba 'dra ba mang du byung bar gyur to/ /nam zhig na/ sngon ded dpon du gyur ba'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas 'od la nor bu rin po che rin thang med pa zhig phul nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing / bstan pa 'di la'ang 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub dpag tu med pa'i rnam par rol te bstan pa'i rtsa lag chen por gyur ba/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir yang pazhi ta chen po'i sa la mngon par bzhugs nas thub pa'i rang lugs nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ‘ sta bur mjad cing / ma 'ongs pa na stobs bcu mnga' ba rab gsal 'e/sa bya ba'i mchog gi sprul ba'i zlos gar lhur mdzad pa/gangs can rgyal pa'i dbang bo'i yongs 'dzin parnyi ta chen po khyab bdag mi bskyod sgeg pa'i rdo rje dpal bzang bo nas lam khrid kyi rting mnan te zag bcas la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa'i seṅge nga ro'i sgra dbyangs ches

389cher bsgrags pa na cal col smra ba'i lce rtse glog ltar g.yo ba rnams kyi lce rtsa rkan phug nas ldo ga pa'i dka' thub bsten par ma zad/ lug ril la ra phos ngo so byed pa'i dper song ba'ang ji snyed cig byung ngo / /dam bca' phyi ma ba/nyis kyi don la'ang gzu bor gan sa shing mkhyen spyan yangs ba du ma zhig nas dus phyis tshad thub kyi lung rigs chu thub pa dag zur tsam dgongs pa na phyi ru btang snyoms kyi spyod pa dgos dbang 'dra yang / nang du nyi 'od la phyogs pa'i lho lta'i rang bzhin ngom pa ni bsngag par bya ba'i gnas nyid du mthong ngo / /de lta na yang / shes rab sdong bu las/ sbrul la 'o ma blud pa ni//dug 'phel 'gyur ba kho nar zad/ /ngan pa rnams la gdams pa yang /tshig pa za 'gyur zhi mi 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ mi gtsang tshogs kyis lus byugs spre'u gang / /dri ngan nyes pa gzhan la sgo byed cing / /rigs pa'i sbar khyim mi bzad seṅge la/ rang nyams slad du co 'dri ci yang rtsom/ /sdang bas rab bskyo da phrag dog lce gnyis kyis/ /rnam rgyas rdzun gyi dug ni rab spro zhing / /dge ba'i srog 'phrog blo nyams gdug pa'i sbrul/ /mun pa'i khung bur lhu ra 'jug e ma mtshar/ /gzhung lugs don la 'thad dang mi 'thad ces/ /rnam par dpyod pa mkhas pa'i tshul mthong nas/ /blun po rang gi ngang tshul mi lta bar/ /dgag sgrub smyon pa'i zlos gar ci yang byed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar legs par bshad pa'i gtam thos pa na sbrul la 'o ma blud pa bzhin du sems rgyud rnam pa tham sarīcad du ma zhi bar byed pa/ rang gi nyes pa ngan pa'i tshogs gzhan la sgo ba la gcig tu brtson pas mi gtsang bas lus byubasani/

390pa'i spre'u'i ngang tshul 'dzin pa/ rang nyams la mi lta bar dpal ldan smra ba bla na med pa'i seṅge la klan 7/ 'tshol ba'i brtul zhugs la dga' mgur chas ba / zhe sdang dang phrag dog gis kun nas bslangs te tshogs par dbyung du mi rung pa'i gtam bab col du smra ba la mngon par spro ba/ mi shes pa'i mun pa rngams sanag pa'i khung bur dge ba'i srog ma lus pa 'phrog pa'i byed pa rlabs po cher 'dzem med du spyod pa/ gzhung don la brgal brtag byed pa ni mkhas pa'i bya ba yim/ pa la/ rang tshod mi zin par dgag sgrub skyon pa'i gar la dga' ba/ kha bshad stong 'ob kyi slob dpon rmongs rtul rgan zhugs 'gal 'du'i phung bo kha sgang bas dgag yig tu ming btags pa'i 'chal gtam log bshad 'ba' zhig gi bang mdzod kha phye ba'i shog byang kha shas lkog tu brims pas bla ma dang chos kyi sde chen po gang gi zhabs la tha gu nag po sum bsgril du 'debs par byed do/ /de la bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog gi rtsod pa'i zla bo pher ba ni 'ga' tsam yang dmigs su med pa dang / rmongs rtul rgan zhugs pa ni thal sgra tsam yang mi theg pa'i tshul rgyun myong thams cad la rtsod med mthun snang du grub pa dang / phyogs su lhung ba rnams mig ser shin tu che bas dge 'dun ris su 'byed pa'i nyen che ba dang / rgya mi'i kha khog kim pa'i 'bras bu'i gnas tshul du yod gshis/ zla med ngag gi dbang phyug chen po rang nyid nas lta ci nye ba'i bu chen dag la 'ang brgal brtag mi chog pa'i bka' khrims lci ba phab po /de'i phyir rtsod pa'i dus kyi paṇa chen gang gi gsung las skyes pa'i bu slob blo t+pas kyi nam/ langs pa/ lung rigs kyi rtsal byang ba/ rig gnas kyi

391dgongs don nges pa dag gis kyang btang snyoms su mdzad do/ /bdag gi dag ba'i bshes gnyen de nyid ni phyis byang rgyud bkras sdings kyi chos grwa nas btegs te dben pa'i ri sul nas dben pa'i ri sul du rgyu ba'i skabs su 'ang / ji skad du/ rang yul nye du longs spyod kun bor nas/ /rtse gcig dam chos bsgrub par dam bcas te/ /gzhan gyi yul du rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzi yis/ /dal 'byor don med byed pa smyon pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa thun dang thun mtshams su zhal nas bgrangs shing don thugs la dgongs nas bsam gtan gyi stegs bu la skyil mo krung gis bzhugs nas yongs su rdzogs pa'i lam gyi rim pa thugs nyams su bstar ba dang /mnyam par bzhag pa las bzhengs ma thag tshig gi na yam tsam ma yin par mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad rgya mtsho chen po gru bo ches gcod pa lta bu'i bshad sgrub zung 'brel lo zla sbrel bas dus 'das te lan gyi yi ge mdzad pa'i bzhed pa tsam yang gtong bar ma mdzad do/ /de yang tshigs/ su bcad pa brgya ba la sa/ gzhan la 'tshol zhing zas zhim 'dod/ /slong mos 'tsho zhing khengs pa 'dod/ bstan bcos mi shes rtsod par 'dod/ /'di gsum 'jig rten bzhad gad rgyu/ /zhes dang / dpal chos kyi grags pas/ ltar snang bcas sogs bkod pa dang / /lan ni 'brel med bzhad gad de/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dgag yig byed pa po ni bstan bcos mi shes par rtsod par 'dod pas dam pa rnams kyi /sbel sa/nas su snang ba dang / dgag yig/ ni 'khrul ba sha stag tu song bas rigs pa smra ba rnams kyi bzhad sa/da rkyu rgyu ru sa/da' ba dang / 'apobyu/sa/ tshul ni tra/'u/nga

()91skyi ————— lugs kyi brda chad rags pa tsam yang ma chags pa'i ltag chod 'ba' zhig tu song bas mkhas pa'i rkang 'dren pa nyid du gnas pa'i phyir lan bya ba'i 'os su ma mthong na yang / kho bo cag ni de dus bsdus grwa la gsar zhugs su song bas blo dang na tshod phra ba dang / ngan pa lang la shor ba rnams yan par btang ba yid la 'phrod po med pa'i bag chags a 'thas pa dang / dus phyis 'phags bod kyi gzhung khungs ma'i rgyab rten rnams yid la 'jags pa'i dbang gis/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ ji srid dus la ma bab par dgra ni phrag par bzod bya ste/ /de bzhin dus su phyin gyur na/ /rdo la rdza ma bsnun bzhin gzhom/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi dam bca' sngar nas yod pa rjes su bsgrub pa dang / bshad ma thag pa'i dgag bya rnams chung zhing dgos pa mang du yod par blo la chud nas/ bdag gi bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs de nyid nas lo drug gi bar du pha rol tu phyin pa'i gzab bshad dang / zhag lnga brgya lhag gi bar rgyun ma chad par byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i rgya che ba'i skor la rgya bod kyi gzhung gung bsgrigs pa'i 'byams bshad nam mkha' la mda' 'phangs pa lta bu'i gtugs pa med pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi dgyes bzhin stsal ba'i bka' drin mngon du gyur skabs tshul 'a di/ dag la 'ang lung rigs dpe gsum sbyar ba'i bshad pa rgyas par stsal pa dang / gzhan yang skabs skabs su tshul 'di'i don la ljags bshad kyi rim pa snga phyir mang du mnos pa rnams yid kyi bum par chud ma zos par dpal mi phasma/ dbyangs can dase/sa rngapre'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i sde snod 'dzin pa rga/nga zhig co dz+wa pari lan ga/dab pa la mngon par chas so/ /tshe/sa bya nga/ ni skyi

393gleng bslang ba'i gtam mdor bsdus pa'o/ /smras pa/ bden pa smra ba'i chos phung 'bum dgu'i bcud/ /brdun don rnam bzhi'i rang bzhin 'khrul med du/ /bden gtam dbyangs kyis mtshon la bdag gi mgon/ /bden gsung lung n+nigs zlos pa'i gar la chas/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin las chos char gyis/ /dus snyigs rgud pa gzhil ba'i gnyon gcig pu/ saṃ gha'i mtshan can 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na/ / rje dang mnyam pa'i sras kyi me tog rgod/ /ngo mtshar bkra shis chos kyi sdings chen por/ /yongs rdzogs smra ba'i nyi ma 'di bzhugs na/ /deng dus sa la gnas pa'i 'og min zhes/ /grags pa mkha' dang mnyam la su zhig tshom/ /lus med nyag phran rnon pos rma med par/ /zin pas phrag dog srog gi ka ba can/ /de dag yon po'i spyod la rgyal ba yang / rang mthu btang nas bshol las gzhan ci 'tshal/ /gzham du ma nulhas rdo rje'i ri bo'i gtos/ /dbyings su 'phyo ba'i gzi byin yi ga dang / /mi 'tshams na yang sen mo'i mtshon cha yis/ /dprad par brtson pa rang nyid nyon re mongs/ /snyigs ma'i khrag rgyun 'phyur ba'i rlabs phreng gis//kun gyi thod du ri mo ci yang bris/ /cher rlom phal cher ro 'dzin legs bshad la/ /mi g.yo dus kyi dmod pa lhur bzhes tshe/ /'jam pa'i kau rdi rdi btsun su dhīḥ'i zhabs/ /gtsug gi rgyan s+t+ri cwa mar mchod pa las/ /sngon med gsar bshad bshad pa'i ut+pal yang / /skal bzang 'gro kyān ku na dga' bskyed la sbings / /de lta bu ni bar skabs su ngal gsi ba'i chit+pa/ṭ+wāṃsro su bcad pa'i snya na ngag/ sku / tasbrur nyams myo/tsha ro du sbrengs

3 94 pa'o/ /gnyis pa sdug bsngal gsum gyi rnam gzhag spros te bshad pas nges shes kyi gzhung 'jugs pa la gsum/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang / khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bshad pa'o sgodang po ni/ ngo bo dang / dbye ba dang / sgra bshad dang / mtshan gzhi ste rnam pa bzhis ston par 'dod pas/ de la ngo bo ni/ nam skyes pa tsam nas lus sems gang rung sa/dung bar byed pa'i tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi cha nas bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi dngos po de/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ mdo las/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba ni skye ba na yang sdug bsngal/ gnas pa na ya/nga sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang / sar drangs pa las/ sdug bsngal ba ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba/ zhes dang / nyan sa las/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang /'dod pas phongs pa'i bar gyi sdug bsngal zhes gang gsungs pa des ni sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rten dang bcas pa bstan te/ de yang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin pas de ni sdu ga bsngal gyi sdug bsngal rnam par bzhag pa yim/ no//zhes dang / mdzod las/ yid 'ong yid du mi 'ong dang / /de las gzhan zag bcas rnams nyid/ /sdug bsngal nyid ‘ gsum ldan pa'i phyir/ /ci rigs ma lus sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes pa'i thad kyi rang 'grel las/ yid du mi 'ong ba rnams ni sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba nyid do/ /zhes dang / mchims mdzod chung ba las/// yid du mi 'ong ba sdug bsngal ni rang gi ngo bo gnod pa'i bdag nyid kyis sdug bsngal ba dang rkyen gyis mngon

395par 'du byed pas yem/ la/ zhes dang / spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis /rlung mkhris sogs kyi nad dang nad las byung ba'i tshor ba'i zug gzer lha bu sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba dang de yang rgyu rkyen gzhi dang gnas dang bcas pa la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zer/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye ba ni / ngo bo'i sgo nas tshor ba sdug bsngal dang / mtshungs ldan gyi sgo nas de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems sems byung dang / dngos rkyen rgyu'i sgo nas dmigs rkyen lnga sogs pa gsum yod de/ kun btus las/ ji ltar na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid yin/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid rnams ni du zhig ci'i phyir sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid du brtag ce na/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba'i rang gi mtshan nyid dang / sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyis kyang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid du blta'o/ /thams cad kyi phyos/sa gcig go /bdag sdug bsngal bar mngon par zhen pa spang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / de'i thad kyi rgyal sras ma las/ sdug bsnga la gyi tshor ba ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyi bdas/ nyid yin te/ rang gi mtshan nyid kho nas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid do/ /de 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur ba dbang bo dang / don rnams dang / de dang mtshungs par ldan pa rnams ni sdug bsngal myong bar byed pa'i phyir sdug bsngal gyi sduge bsngal nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / sa bzang ba'i kun btus 'grel ba las/ ji ltar du 'i/ga ci'i phyir sdug bsngal pyi sdug bsngal nyid du brtag cen/ lus sems la dngos su gnod pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba'i rang gi mtshan nyid can nam bdag nyid ni sdus/ bsngal dngos yin

396pa'i phyir dang / gang la brten nas sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos yul yid du mi 'ot+na ba dang / de dang phrad pa'i dbang bo dang / de dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems dang sems byung skye ba rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin pa nyid kyis kyang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid du blta'o/ /thams cad kyi phyogs gcig ni sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rgyu dang bcas pas bsdus pa dag go /de 'ang chos gsum gyi char bstan pas bdag sdug bsngal bar mngon par zhen pa spang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / red mda' ba'i kun btus ṭīk+ka las kyang / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rang gi mtshan nyid ni rang gi mtshan nyid kyis sdug ba sngal gyi sdug bsngal yin la/sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos dbang bo dang / don rnams dang /de dang mtshungs par ldan pa rnams ni sdug bsngal myong bar byed pa'i phyir sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal du blta 'o/ /thams cad kyi phyogs gcig ni sdurna/ bsngal gyi tshor ba sa/nas dang bcas pa'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal chos tsam du shes pas bdag der mngon par zhen pa spong ngo / /zhes dang / lam rim las/ de yang tshor ba de kho na ma yin gyi/ de dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems sems byung gzhan rnams dang / gang la dmigs nas skye ba'i yul zag bcas rnams kyang / zhes dang / kun btus dar ṭīka las/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal la du ma yod de/ tshor ba sdug bsngal dang / de myong 'gyur gyi chos yid du mi 'ong ba dang / de dang phrad pa'i dbang bo sogs dang / de dag dang mchungs ldan gyi chos rnams yod pa'i phyir thams cad kyi phyogs gcig tshor ba sdug bsngal gnas

397 dang bcas pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sgra bshad ni/ mchims mdzod chen mo las / yid du mi 'ong ba rnams ni 'du byed dang sdu ga bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ba yin te/ khag bcas yin pa dang skyes pa nyid nas sdug bsngal du ma myong ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nam skyes pa tsam nas lus sems gang rung la sdug bsngal skyed pas na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zhes bya ste drangs ma thag pa'i lung de dag gis kyang shes nus so/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ 'bras tshab 'gyur byed kyi reg bya dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal dang mkhal ma'i zug gzer lta bu ste/ rtog bcas dpyod bcas kyi sa las/lus de la sdug bsngal gyi chor ba 'byung ba ji ltar ba‘ p+ta zhe na/ dper na phol mig kun nas tsha ba la sman 'gyur byed babs pa lta bu'o/ /zhes dang /nyan sa'i gtan la dbab pa bsdu pa las/ dper na la la zhig gi 'bras yongs su gdung ba dang bcas pa la 'gyur byed kyi reg pa phrad pas ni sdug bsngal gye 'du shes skyed par byed de/ /de bzhin du nyon mongs pa dang las kyis bskyed pa'i 'du byed gnas ngan len du gtogs pa gnas pa 'bras yongs su gdung ba'i gnas lta bu de la yang 'gyur byed kyi reg pa dang 'phrad pa'i gnas lta bur ni sdug bsngal gyi tshor bar blta bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / lam rim chen mo las/ 'bras tsha bas gdungs pa de tshwa tshu la sogs pa'i 'gyur byed kyi reg pa dang phrad pa na ches sdug bsngal ba bzhin du tshor ba sdug bsngal shes par bya ste/ nam skyes pa tsam nas lus sam sems gdung bar byed pa'i phyir sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal te/ mkhal ma'i zug gzer bzhin no/ /zhes bka' stsal ba ltar ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar

398ltar rnam pa bzhis stan pas/ de la ngo bo ni/ nam zhig pa na sdug bsngal skyed pa'i tshor ba bde ba'i cha nas bzhag ba'i zag bcas kyi dngos po de/'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid yin te/ mdo las/ bde ba'i tshor ba ni skyes pa na'ang bde/ gnas pa na'ang bde/ 'gyur ba ste zhig pa na sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang / sar drangs pa las/ bde ba'i tshor ba ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba/ zhes dang / nyan sa las/de'i mi mthun phyogs kyi chos 'di lta ste/ rga ba'i mi mthun pa'i phyogs lang tsho dang / na ba'i nad med pa dang / 'chi ba'i gson po dang / mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug pa dang phrad pa dang / sdug pa dang bral ba'i sdug pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / 'dod pas phongs pa'i 'dod pa phun sum tshogs pa gang dag yin pa rnams dang / sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rten dang bcas pa la zhugs pa'i nyon mongs pa gang dag yin pa rnams dang / nad med pa la sogs pa bde ba dang mthun pa'i chos rnams la zhugs pa'i nyon mongs pa gang dag yin pa rnams dang / de las skyes pa'i tshor ba la zhugs pa'i nyon mongs pa gang dag yin pa de dag ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nes bya'o/ /de la bde ba'i tshor ba rten dang bcas pa ni mi rtag pa nyid kyis/ rnam par 'gyur zhing gzhan du 'gyur ba'i dbang gis na sdug bsngal bar 'gyur ro/ /nyon mongs pa rnams ni thams cad du zhugs pa yin pas kun nas dkris pa'i sgo kho na nas sdug bsngal ba yin no/ /'gyur ba ni sems pa dang bcas pa'i yin pas de'i phyir 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang nyams shing 'gyur ba'i sems kyis bud med kyi lag pa

399 nas bzung ngam zhes rgya cher ji skad gsungs pa lta bu dang / yang bcom ldan 'das kyis 'dod pa la 'dun pas kun nas dkris pa ni 'dod pa la 'dun pas kun nas dkris pa'i rkyen gyis de dang 'byung ba'i sems las byung ba sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba so sor myong pa'i 'gyur ro/ /gnod — sems dang / rmugs pa dang / gnyid dang / rgod pa dang / 'gyod pa dang / the tshom gyis kun nas dkris pa yang de dang 'dra'o zhes ji skad gsungs pa lta bu ste/ yid ches pa'i lung mchog tu yid ches pa des ni nyon mongs pa rnams la sdug bsngal gyi don dang / 'gyur ba'i don kyang snang ba yin te/ de'i phyir nyon mongs pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa de ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi rnam par bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes dang /mdzod rang 'grel las/ de la yid du 'ong ba rnams ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsnga 'ge ba nyid do/ /nes dang / mchims mjod chung ba las/ yid du 'ong ba nga/de ba ni mi rtag pa nyid kyis 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal ba/ zhes dang / rje blo gres gya la mtshan gyis/ sha thong la sogs pa'i 'dod yon dang / nad med pa dang / khams gong ma'i ting nge 'dzin dang / de rnams las skyes pa'i tshor ba lta bu tshor ba bde ba gzhi dang gnas dang bcas pa la 'gyur ba'i sdug bsnga la zer te/ 'gyur ci/nga mi rtag pa dang / nyon mongs pa 'dod chags skyed pa la sogs pa dang /gong 'og tu 'chad pa ltar sgo du ma nas sdug bsngal skyed pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye ba ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas tshor ba bde ba sogs ngo bo mtshungs ldan rgyu gsum gyi dbye ba sngar ltar yod de/ kun

44//du//༷/ ———— —btus las/ ji ltar 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid yin/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal rnams ni du zhig ci'i phyir 'gyur ba'i sdug bsnga' nyid du brtag ce na/ bde ba'i tshor ba 'gyur ba rang gi mtshan nyid dang / bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos 'gyur ba rang gi mtshan nyid dang / de la yang rjes su chags pas sems 'gyur bas kyang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid du blta'o/ /thams cad kyi phyogs sa/cig go /bdag bde bar mngon par zhen pa spang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / de'i rgyal sras ma las/ bde ba'i tshor ba dang / de myong bar byed pa'i chos rnams 'gyur bas yid mi bde ba 'byung ba'i phyir de 'gyur ba ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid do/ /de la yang rjes su chags pa'i sems 'gyur ba ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid du rig par bya ste / ji skad du zhe na nas 'gyur ba'i sems kyis zhes gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / mdzod 'grel chos mngon pa'i rgyan las/ tshor ba de dag gi dbang gis de dag dang mtshungs ldan gyi sems dang sems byung gzhan rnams dang / mtshungs ldan ma yin pa bdag rkyen dang dmigs rkyen rnams kyang yid du 'ong ba la sogs pa'i ming du brjone do/ /zhes dang / paṇa chen ma ti bas/ ji ltar du zhig ci'i phyir 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid du brtag ce na/ lus soms la phan par snang ba bde ba'i tshor ba 'gyur ba dang bcas pa'i rang gi mtshan nyid dam bdag nyid dang / gang la brten nas bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos yul yid du 'ong pa dang de dang phrad pa'i dbang bo la sogs pa 'gyur ba dang bcas pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ de dag 'gyur ba las yid mi bde 'byung bas sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yim/ pa'i phyir/

4(/ 1bde ba zag bcas rgyu dang bcas pa de la yang rjes su charga/sa shing zhen pas 'di dag 'gyur na mi rung ngo snyam du sems yid mi bde bas 'gyur ba dang bcas pas kyang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid du blta'o/ /de ltar chags pa'ang sdug bsngal gyi ngo bor brjod de/ ji skad du/ zhe na nas 'gyur ba'i sems kyis lag pa nas 'dzin pa'am lan bu nas 'dzin pa la sogs pas yongs su gdung bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /thams cad kyi phyogs gcig ni bde ba zag bcas kyi tshor ba rgyu dang bcas pas bsdus pa dag go /de 'ang chos gsum du 'du bas bdag bde bar mngon par zhen pa spang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / rje btsun red mda' bas/ bde ba myong ba'i tshor ba dang / de myong ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i chos rang mtshan pa dbang bo dang don rnams 'gyur na chags can rnams la slar yid mi bde skye ba'i phyir dang / bde ba dang bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba de la yang chags pa'i cisems sngar gyi gnas skabs las mi 'dra bar 'gyur ba'i phyir 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yin no/ /thams cad kyi phyogs gcig bde ba dang bde ba myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos rnams so/ /'gyur ba'i sdug pasngal chos tsam du shes pa na bdag der mngon par zhen pa spang ngo / /zhes dang / lam rim las kyang / tshor ba gcig pu min par mtshungs ldan dmigs rkyen dang bcas pa 'jog pa sdug bsngal gsum ga la 'dra bar gsungs pa dang / kun btus dar ṭīka las/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsnga la du ma yod de/ 'gyur na sdug bsngal skye ba'i tshor ba bde ba dang / dbang bo dang / don dang / de dag la rjes su chags —4'i nyon mo/ngas mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa yod pa'i phyir/

402 thams cad kyi phyogs gcig tshor ba bde ba gnas dang bcas/ pa'o/ /zhes gsungs paciltar ro/ /sgra bshad ni/ mchims mdzod che ba las/ 'gyur ba dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba yin te/ ngo bo bde ba yin yang 'gyur ba na sdug bsngal ba dang zag bcas yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar skyes pa dang gnas pa na bde la zhig pa na sdug bsngal skyed pas na 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya ste drangs ma thag pa'i nyan sa'i lung sogs kyis kyang shes nus so/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ 'bras tsha ba la chu bsil ba btab pa'i bde ba lta bu ste/ rtog bcas dpyod bcas kyis las/lus de la bde pa'i tshor ba 'byung ba ji ltar blta zhe na/ dper na phol mig kun nas tsha ba la bsil ba'e reg pa babs pa lta bu'o/ /zhes dang /nyan sa'i bsdu ba las/ dper na la la zhig gi 'bras yongs su gdung ba dang bcas pa la bsil ba'i reg pa dang phrad pas ni bde ba'i 'du shes skyed par byed la de bzhin/ du nyon mongs pa dang las kyis bskyed pa'i 'du byed gnas ngan len du sa/togs pa gnas pa 'bras bu yongs su gdung ba'i gnas lta bu de la yang reg pa bsil ba dang phrad pa'i gnas lta bur ni bde ba'i tshor bar blta bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / lam rim las/ phol mig gam 'bras shin tu tsha ba de la chu bsil ba btab na bde bar snang ba lta bu ni 'khor ba ba rnams kyi tshor ba bde ba ste/ 'di ni nam zhig pa na'ang sdug bsngal skyed pas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes bka' stsal ba ltar ro/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal la bde ba rang mtshan pa med pa'i don ni/lam rim las/ chags pa rgyas par 'gyur ba'i da lta'i tshor ba bde ba ni

403phal mo che sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa la bde ba'i blo skyes pa yin gyi/ sdug bsngal bsal ba la ma ltos pa'i ngo bo nyid kyis bde ba ni med de/ dper na 'gro ba drags pas sdug bsngal ba na bsdad pas bde ba'i blo 'byung ba de snga ma'i sdu ga bsngal che rim nas 'gags pa'i tshe bde ba rim gyis skyes par snang ba yin gyi/ ngo bo nyid kyis bde ba ni min te/ slar yang bsdad drags na snga ma ltar sdug bsngal skyed pa'i phyir ro/ /ngo bo nyid kyis bde ba'i rgyu yi na na sdug bsngal gyi rgyu ji ltar bsten pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal rdze 'phel du 'gro ba bzhin du/ 'gro 'dug dang nyal ba dang bza' btung dang nyi ma dang grib ma bsten pa sogs kyang ji tsam ring du bsten pa de tsam du bde ba je 'phel du 'gro dgos pa la/ ring drags na sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig skyed par snang ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes mngal 'jug gi mdo khungs su byas nas gsungs pa dang mthun par/ bzhi brgya ba'i dar ṭīka las/ phyug po 'ga' zhig gser gyi snod du skyugs pa na bran pho sa'i snod du skyugs pa mthong nas skyugs pa la bde ba med par khyad par med kyang bdag ni dbang thang phun sum 4tshogs pa'o snyam du ji ltar phyug po 'ga' zhig dga' bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa shugs chung du song ba'i gnas skabs kyi tshor ba sim pa la rang mtshan pa'i bde bar bzung nas bde'o snyam du sems par byed pa yin gyi bde ba rang mtshan pa med do/ /zhes dang / des na 'jig rten pa rnams la sdug bsngal rang mtshan pa yod la bde ba rang mtshan pa med ces bya'o/ /tha snyad du tshor ba bde ba med ces khas blang du mi rung ste/ skur 'debs su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /dper na sngon po de ser

404po dang bsgrigs kyang sngon po'i blo skye yi ser bo'i blo mi skye ba dang / ring bo de de bas ches ring ba dang bsgrigs na thung ngu'i blo skye ba'i khyad par ltar shes par bya yi/ rtags kyi dgag bya'i chos kyi rang mtshan dang 'dra bar go bar mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / rin chen phreng ba'i dar ṭīka las/ lus kyi tshor ba bde ba ni— sdug bsngal phyir ni bcos pa tsam ste/ sdug bsngal cung zad shugs chung du song ba'i gnas skabs kyi tshor ba sim pa de la bde ba rang mtshan par zhen pa yin gyi sdug bsngal phyir bcos kyi bde ba tsam ma gtogs 'jig rten na sdu ga bsngal rang mtshan pa yod kyang bde ba rang mtshan pa cung zad kyang med do/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug dar ṭīka las/ 'jig rten 'dir ni sdug bsngal phyir bcos kyi bde ba tsam zhig yod kyi sdug bsngal rang mtshan pa yod pa ltar bde ba rang mtshan pa ni med do/ /de 'ang dper na grang bas nyen pa nyi ma la bsdad pa'i tshe grang ba'i sdug bsngal cung zad shugs chung du song ba'i gnas skabs der sim par myong ba'i myong byed de tshor ba bde ba yin gyi/ de'i tshe yang grang bas nyen pa'i sdug bsngal yod de sdug bsngal de zad ma thag bar ma chad du tsha ba'i sdug bsngal gyi mgo brtsams 'ong ba'i phyir/ des na bde bar gdags pa'i gzhir sdug bsngal dgos la sdug bsngal gyi blo skye ba'i gzhir bde ba mi dkos pas so/ /dper na sngon po dang ring thung bzhin no/ 1zhes dang /sher le'i zin bris las kyang de bzhin 'byung pa ltar zag bces kyi tshor ba bde ba phal cher ni sdug bsngal bsal ba la ltos pa dang / bsten ring na sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba ste ltos 'gyur gnyis dang bcas pa'i phyir bde ba

— 40byerang mtshan pa med do/ /dper na pha ri de tshu ri la ltos pa dang phar ngos su song na pha ri ma yin par 'gyur ba'i ltos 'gyur gnyis kyis pha ri rang mtshan pa med pa bzhin no/ /sdug balngal rang mtshan pa yod de/ bde ba bsal ba la ltos pa dang bsten ring na bde bar 'gyur ba gang yang ma yin— pa dper na sngon po de ser bo la ltos pa dang ser bo dang gshibs na gzhan du 'gyur ba ma yin pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na lam rim du/chags pa rgyas par 'gyur ba'i da lta'i tshor ba bde ba ni phal mo che sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa la bde ba'i blo skyes ba yin gyi/ zhes dang / sdug bsngal che rim nas 'gags pa'i tshe bde ba rim gyis skyes par spang ba yin gyi/ zhes dang / mngal 'jug gi mdo las/ sdug bsngal gsar ba ba/zhan dang gzhan 'byung ba la bde ba'i 'du shes 'byung ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i don sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa dang de'i skabs la btags pa'i tshor ba bde ba btags yod pa zhig chags pa rgyas par 'gyur ba'i tshor ba de la ngos 'dzin dgos pas de 'dra'i tshor ba de bde ba min zhes pa'i tshig zin du ma 'byung ba ni ngo bo nyid kyis bde ba'am bde ba rang mtshan pa min pa dang /sdug bsngal zhes tshig zin la 'byung ba 'ang de ma thag sdu ga bsnga la 'dren pa'i 'gyur ba'i sdu ga bsngal gyi don du bya dgos kyi/ bde ba mtshan nyid pa min la sdug bsngal mtshan nyid pa yin pa'i don du 'khrul mi rung ste/ pha ri de pha ri rang mtshan pa min par bshad kyi pha ri de pha ri tsam yang min par bshad pa med pari phyir ro/ /de bas lam rim gyi thad 'dir mngal 'jug gi lung gnyis dang bzhi brgya pa'i lung gcig ste lung gsum drangs pa

406 — thamaca/ cad chags pa rgyas par 'gyur ba'i tshor ba bde ba ngos 'dzin nga/ dang de nyid bde ba rang mtshan pa min pa'i ched du drangs pa yin pas phyogs gcig tu 'grel dgos shing / grub mtha' 'og mas zag bcas kyi bde ba dang / zag bcas kyi bde ba rang mtshan pa dang / ngo bo nyid kyi zag bcas kyi bde ba gsum ga yod par khas len la/ klu sgrub yab sras kyis zag bcas kyi bde ba yod la/ zag bcas kyi bde ba rang mtshan pa dang /zag bcas kyi ngo bo nyid kyis bde ba med par bzhed pas/ klu sgrub yab sras kyis zag bcas kyi bde ba mi bzhed pa'i log 'dzin mi bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngar ltar rnam pa bzhis ston pas/ de la ngo bo ni/ nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal skyed pa'i gnas ngan len rjes su 'brel ba'i zag bcas kyi dngos bo de/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid yin te/mdo las/ gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang / sar drangs pa las/ sdug bsngal yang ma yin/ bde ba yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba'o/ /zhes dang / nyan sa las/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni nye bar len pa'i phung bo rnams la thams cad du 'gro ba yin te/ zhes dang / phung bo gang dag mi rtag pa/'byung ba dang 'jig pa dang ldan pa/ len pa dang bcas pa tshor ba gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba/ gnas ngan len dang ldan pa / grub pa dang bde bar gtogs pa ma yin pa/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal las rnam par ma grol ba/ rang gis dbang bsgyur ba med pa de dag ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyisasasdug bsnga'/ zhertsa4 bya ste/ de ni

407 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rnam par bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes dang /mdzod rang 'grel las/ de dag las gzhan pa rnams ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis sdug bsngal ba nyid do/ /zhes dang / mdzod 'grel legs bshad rgya mtsho las/ de nyid rkyen gyis mngon par 'du byed pa'i phyir 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis kyang sdug bsngal la/ zhes dang / gzhan phan snying bo las/ tshor ba bde sdug gang yang dngos su mi skyed kyang btang snyoms su 'jug pa'i phyi nang gi dngos po la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zer te/ las nyon gyis bcings shing rang dbang med pa yin pas so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dbye ba ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas tshor ba btang snyoms sogs ngo po mtshungs ldan rgyu gsum gyi dbye ba gsum yod de/ kun btus las/ji ltar na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yin/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid rnams ni du zhig ci'i phyir 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du brtag ce na/sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yim/ pa'i tshor ba'i rang gi mtshan nyid dang / sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos kyi rang gi mtshanarkanyid dang / de gnyis ka'i gnas ngan len yongs su 'dzin pa dang / de gnyi ga las ma thar ba mi rtag pa nyid kyis rjes su bcings pas grub pa dang bde ba ma yin pas kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du blta'o/ /zhes dang / de'i rgyal sras ma las/ sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yi na pa'i tshor ba ni kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa dang / de myong bar byed pa'i 'du byed rnams dang / sdug bsngal dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid kyi gnas ngan

408 len dang ldan pa dang / sdug bsngal de tha/nyis las rnam par ma grol bas res 'ab/'a ni bde ba'i gnas skabs la brten/ res/ 'as/'a ni sdug bsngal gyi gnas skabs la brten te/ rtag tu khor mor sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa'i gnas skabs su 'gyur ba ni ma yin no/ /de lta bas na mi rtag pas rjes su bcings pas grub pa dang bde ba ma yin pa'i phyir 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du rig par bya'o/ /phung po rnams dang khams gsum ni yid dang chos dang yid kyi rnam par shes pa 'i khams rnams so/ / skye mched gnyis ni yid dang chos kyi skye mched do/ /phyogs gcig ma gtogs pa ni zag pa med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /thams cad do zhes bya ba ni de las gzhan pa dag go /zhes dang / kun 'grel shes bya rab gsal snang ba las/ ji ltar du zhig ci'i phyir 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du brtag ce na/ dngos su phan gnod du mi snang bas sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms pa gtso cher kun gzhi dang mtshungs par ldan pa dang / kun gzhi las de ltar skyes pa'i rnam shes gzhan dang yang ldan pa'i rang gi mtshan nyid dam bdag nyid dang / gang la brten nas sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa btang snyoms myong bar 'gyur ba'i chos yul tha mal ba dang de dang phrad pa'i dbang bo la sogs pa dang / bzhi ba yan chad kyi mi g.yo ba'i las la sogs pa btang snyoms skyed byed kyi rang gi mtshan nyid dang / de dag sduge bsngal du 'jog pa'i rgyu mtshan yang sdug bsngal dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal de gnyis ka'i gnas ngan len sa bon kun gzhi la yongs su 'dzin pa dang / bag chags

409yongs su bzung bas sdug bsngal gnyi ga las mi thar zhing ma grol bar res bde ba dang res sdug bsngal du 'gyur zhing btang snyoms de yang mi rtag pa —nyid kyis rjes su bcings pas mtha' gcig tu mi 'gyur ba'i grub pa dang bde ba'i bdag nyid ma yin pas kyang zwag bcas thams cad la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du blta 'o/ /zhes dang / kun 'grel legs bshad rgya mtsho las/ sdug bsngal dang bde ba gnyis ka ma yin pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms dang / de myong bar 'gyur ba'e chos dang / sdug bsngal dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal de gnyis ka'i gnas ngan len yongs su 'dzin pa dang / sdug bsngal de gnyis ka las ma thar bas res ni bde ba'i gnas skabs la brten/ res sdug bsngal gyi gnas skabs la brten te/ rtag tu khor mor btang snyoms zhaba' zhig gi ga nas/ skabs la gnas pa ni ma yin no / /de lta bas na mi rtag pas rjes su bcings pas grub pa dang bde ba ma yin pa'i phyir zag pa dang bcas pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms gzhi dang bcas pa rnams 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang / lam rim chen mo las kyang tshor ba mtshungs ldan dmigs rkyen dang bcas pa 'jog par gsungs pa dang / kun 'grel chos mngon rgya mtsho las/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du ma yod de/ tshor ba btang snyoms rten dang bcas pa ste/ gtso bo kun gzhi'i 'khor gyi tshor ba btang snyoms dang / tshor ba btang snyoms myong 'gyur gyi chos zag becas kyi tshogs bdun 'khor bcas dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis kyi gnas ngan len 'dzin pa'i chos dang / de gnyis ka

410 las ma thar ba mi rtag pa'i dbang du gyur ba grub pa tshor ba btang snyo mas skye ba dang bde ba sanas nga/'i ngang gcig la brten pa ma yin par/ res 'ga' bde ba'i skabs la brten/ res 'ga' sdug bsngal gyi skabs la brten pa'i chos rnams yod pa'i phyir dang / phung bo dang / khams tha ma gsum dang / skye mched tha ma gnyis kyis bsdus pa zag med bor ba rnams yo/da pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /sgra bshad ni/ mdzod 'grel chos mngon rgyan las/ gnyis po de las gzhan pa'i 'du byed zag bcas rnams ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal kho nas sdug bsngal ba yin te/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can yin pas 'phags pa rnams dang me mthun pa'i phyir dang / skad cig ma nyid kyis gnod pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar nyon mongs pas 'du byas shing nyon mongs pa 'du byed pa sdug bsngal gyi ga nas ngan len dang bcas pas na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes bya ste drangs ma thag pa'i lung de dag gis kyang shes nus so/ /sdug bsngal gong ma gnyis kyi sgra bshad du mchims ṭīka drangs pa'i sgras zin la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang skabs kyi sdug bsngal de'i sgra gnyis ka bshad la/ 'dir ni tha ma kho na'i sgra bshad pa'i zhib cha'ang shes dgos so/ /mtshan gzhi ni/ 'bras tsha ba reg pa gnyis dang smyo 4 phrad pa lta bu ste/ rtog bcas dpyod bcas kyi sa las/ lus de la sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba 'byung ba ji ltar blta zhe na/ dper na phol mig kun nas tsha ba de nyid la bsil ba dang / sman 'gyur byed kyis reg pa ma yin pa rang bzhin gyis kun naṭaṭa tsha ba lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / nyan sa'i

411bsdu bar/ 'bras yongs su gdung ba dang bcas pa de la reg pa de gnyi ga med na ni de'i tshe na 'bras de nyid kyi sdug bsngal tsam gsal ba dang mngon par 'gyur ba de bzhin du nyon mongs pa dang las kyis bskyed pa'i 'du byed gnas ngan len du gtogs pa gnas pa 'bras yongs su gdung ba'i gnas lta bu de la yang reg pa de gnyi ga med par 'a bras tsam gyi gnas lta bur ni sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa'i tshor bar blta bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / lam rim las/ reg pa de gnyis ka/ dang ma phrad pa'i dus kyi 'bras tsha ba lta bu ni zag pa dang bcas pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms te/gnas ngan len rjes/ su 'brel bas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes bka' stsal ba ltar ro/ /lam rim du 'de dag mtshan gzhi la sbyar ba mi gsal yang / lam rim gyi bla ma gong ma rnams mgrin gcig tu mtshan sa/zhi la sbyar ba'i gsung bshad mdzad pa nyid tshad mar byas so/ /khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi 'du byed tshul dang khyab pa'i don ni/ lam rim las/ khams gsum gyi 'du byed thams cad ni nyon mongs pa'i phyogs dang mthun pa'i gnas ngan len dang ldan pas las su mi rung ba dang dbang bsgyur ba ma yi na la/ khams gsum gyi sems can gyi 'du byed mngon par 'grub pa na'ang nyon cho/ngas pa'i phyogs dang mthun pa'i gnas ngan len dang rjes su 'brel/ ba ste/ mdor na nyen mongs skye ba dang gnas pa dang 'phel ba'i sa bon rjes su 'brel bas dge ba la bkol bzod pa'i las su rung ba 'ang med/ ci 'dod 'dod du dbang sgyur du 'ang mi rung ba'o/ /zhes dang / phung bo krādi la sdug bsngarlosga dang nyon mo ngas kyi sa/nas ngan len

412 — rī — brtan chags par yod pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ zhes gsungs pa ltar nyon mongs dang sdurge bsngal gnyis byed pa'ang 'du byed du ba༅/da pa yin no/ /bsdu ba las kyang / de la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid gang zhe na/yang 'byung ba'i las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i 'du byed rnarma sa kyi lus de dang de dag la nyon mongs pa dang sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba dang mthun pa kun tu 'akro ba'i gnas ngan len du gtogs pa gnas pa gang yin pa de ni gnas ngan len zhes bya ste/ de ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yim no/ /zhes kun 'gro'i gnas ngan len dang ldan pa dang gtogs pa thams cad la nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang mthun pas khyab par bstan pa'ang rang 'bras sdug kun skyed pa'ang 'du byed pa'i don yin no/ / nyan sa las/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni nye bar len pa'i phung bo rnams la thams cad du 'gro ba yin te/ zhes dang / bsdu ba las/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid de'i dbang du mdzad nas bcom lda na 'das kyis mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga bo dag sdug bsngal ba zhes pa gsungs te/ zhes dang / sgom rim las/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid ni/las dang nyon mongs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi rgyus gzhan gyi dbang gi ngo bo nyid dang / skad cig re re la 'jig pa'i ngang can gyi mtshan nyid de 'gro ba thams cad la khyab pa yin no/ /zhes dang / lam rim las/ 'du byed kyi// sdug bsngal ni sdug bsngal thams cad la khyab pa dang / zhes dang /mdo smad sgrub brgyud kyi bstan ba'i shing rta ba chen po rnam 'dren bla ma skal ldan rgya ma tshos/ sdug bsngal gzhan thams cad dang khams yo/sum sa/ra khyab

rdzo —————— — — 413pas sdug bsngal thams cad kyi rtsa bar 'dug la/ zhes gsungs pa ltar nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal ba thams cad kyi khyab byed dam nye bar len pa'isprephung bo thams cad la khyab pa'am khams gsum dang sdug bsngal sa/sum ga la rang yin pa'i tshul gyis khyab pas na khyab pa zhes bya ba gzhung de dag gis bstan pa yin no/ lam rim sogs su 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis kyi rtsa bar gsungs pa ni skyo ba bsgom pa'i thabs las khyab pa'i go don ston byed min par snang la/ dge ba dang ci 'dod la bkol du mi ster zhing nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis kyi'ang rtsa ba byas te 'du byed pa ni 'du byed kyi don du byas kyang rung ngo/ /rje dge legs rgya mtshos/ khyab pa ni a ma'i go don yin pas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gnyi ga skyed par byed pas na khyab pa zhes bshad pa yen gsungs pa dang / rje ngag dbang byams pas/ sride rtse nas mnar med kyi bar gyi snod bcud thams cad la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis dper na sha la khrag 'dres pa bzhin du dbyer med du khyab pas na khyab pa/ zhes gsungs pa dang / khams gsum gyi snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas na khyab pa dang / srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar la khyab pas na khyab pa dang / spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar du khyab pas na khyab pa dang / sdug bsngal gzhan sa/nyis skyed pas na khyab pa zhes go don len lugs 'dra mi 'dra khungs dang 'brel ma 'brel sna tshogs shig sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gis kyang gsu ngas pa ni/ de dag r+sha/sa kyang tshor ba btang snyoms kho na khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngar pa 'jog pa dang / sdug bsngal skyed

———mu 4 — — pa'i gnas ngan lem kho na 'jog pa dang / zag bcas kyi dngos po thams cad 'jog pa'i bzhed phug gtod sa mi 'dra ba byung ba'i dbang gis yin mod/ mkhas pa chen po dag gi gsung la 'ang shing rta chen po dang rje yab sras kyi dgongs par song ma song mang du snang na ding sang gi mkhas rlom rgyu mtshan ma mthong bar sbal ba'i rang skado 'don pa la dga' ba dag lta ci smos/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rnam par bzhag pa las brtsams te dpyad par bya ba rnams ni 'og tu rgyas par ston par 'gyur ba nyid kyis/'dir ni de las gzhas pa'i skabs 'di dang 'brel ba'i dka' ba'i gnas blo gros dang ldan pa dag la tshom pa 'byung b.ri skabs rnyed pa che long tsam zhig mi'i zur phud lnga ba mtshan brjod par dka' ba de nyid kyi bka' drin las skal ba bzang bo dang ldan pa rnams la rna ba'i dga' ston du sbyin par byas pas/ shes rlom rang mthong can rnams bag 'khums par byos shigade la/kha cig na re/ bde sdug la tshor ba dang de dang mtshungs ldan dang dngos rkyen gsum ga yod par thal/ sdug bsngal kyi sdug bsngal sogs gsum la de sa/su ma po re re nas yod pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal sogs gsum po re re la tshor sogs gsum re yod pa ni sngar bsgubs pa ltar gyushing rta chen po dang rje yab sras kyi gsung ngag rnam par dag pas gsal par gsungs pa'i phyir dang / bde sdug la tshor ba kho nas khyab ste/ nyan sa las/ de la skye ba'i sdug bsngaspa zhes bya ba ni skye ba'i tshe na lus dang sems kyi sdug bsngal si tshor ba 'byung ba la bya yi/ skye ba nyid ni sdus/ 7

415 bsngal ma yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ni de yen no/ /de bzhin du 'dod pas phongs pa'i bar gyi sdug bsngal zhes bya ba yang 'dod pas phongs pa'i lus dang sems kyi sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba 'byung ba la byadza/ 'dod pas phongs ba nyid ni sdug bsngal ma yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi sa/zhi ni de yinano zhes snga ma bzhin du sbyar ro/ /zhes skye ba nyid skye ba'i sdung/ bsngal yin yang sdug bsngal min pa dang de'i skabaṭaṭa kyi tshor ba chi/ sdug bsngal du gsal bar bshad pa dang / kun btus las/ ji ltar na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid yin/ zhes pa nas/ sdug bsngasmu gyi tshor ba'i rang gi mtshan nyid dang / zhes dang / de'i rgya'1 sras ma las/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyi bdag nyid yim/ te/ zhes sogs sngar drangs pa dang / sa bzang dang / red mda' ba dang / rgyal tshab sogs kun btus ṭīk+ka mkhan po dag gis tshor ba sdug bsngal ni rang gi mtshan nyid kyi sdug bsngal dang / gzhan ni sdug bsngal myong bar byed pas sdug bsngal du gsungs kyi rang gi mtshan nyid kyi sdug bsngal du ma gsungs pa'i phyir dang / kun btus rtsa 'grel rnams su bde ba la'ang de ltar 'byung ba dang / mdzod rang 'grel las/ yid du 'ong ba ni gang dag yin/ zhes pa nas/ bde ba myong bar 'gyur pa la sogs pa'i 'du byed rnams kyang yid du 'ong ba la sogs pa'i ming thob po/ /zhes dang / de'i thad kyi mdzod ṭī7/ sngar drangs pa rnams dang ma drangs do mang bo las byung ba dang /spyan snga ba'i lam rim swā/sa/ sdug bsngal ni dngos su tshor ba la bya dgos mod kyang / sdug bsngal gyi gzhi dang gnas dang rten 'i na pas gzhan

416rnams la'/nga sdug bsngal zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / blo gros chem po'i bshes ṭīka tu/ 'dod pas phongs pa la sogs pa ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu yin pa'i phyir sdug bsngal zhes bshad kyi/ tshor ba'i rang bzhin yen pa'i phyir ni ma yin no/ /zhes bde sdug dngos ni tshor ba la gsungs kyi/ /gzhan ni bde sdug mtshan nyid par ma gsungs pa dang / /rta nag rnam 'grel las/ sems byung yin par thal/ sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir/ 'e/sa sdug bsngal la sems byung gis khyab par gsungs pas de'i sems byung ni tshor ba las ma 'das pa'i phyir dang / kun gzhi'i mtha' dpyod las/ bde ba myong zhes pa'i bde ba'ang tshor ba nyid yi na gyi/ phyi'i chos ma kyi pen pa'i phyir/ zhes bde ba ni tshor ba nyid la gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bya ba ni lung gis bsgrubs pa yin la/ der ma zad rigs pas kyang 'grub ste/ gzhan du na lha'i dpal 'byor bde sdug gnyis kar thal ba'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir snyam na/ lha'i dpal 'byor gyis lha'i rgyud la tshor ba bde ba dang lha min gyi rgyud la tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi dmigs rkyen byed pa nyid kyis so/ /gzhan yang / tshor ba bde ba chos can/ khyod sdug bsngal yin par thal/ tshor ba sdug bsngal kyi dmigs rkyen byed pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas blangs la song ngo / /de bas na mdo smad bshad pa'i shing rta ba chen po kun mkhyen bla ma'i dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod las/ zag bcas kyi bde ba de tshor ba kho na min la de mtshungs kyi sems sems byung yul zag bcas thams cad de'i mtshan gzhir 'jog pa'i phyir/ zhes sa/sungs pa'ang gzugs la sogs pa ni myang bya yul sdi bde ba yin zhes pa'i don

417yin yang / myang bya yul gyi bde ba la bde bsam khyab pa ni/ dper na/tshor ba la gang gis tshor ba dang gang tshor ba gnyis yod pas phyi ma la tshor bas ma khyab pa bzhin no zhes zer ram/ yig chas kun btus rtsa 'grel dang lam rim sogs dang bstun pa'i lugs mdzad nas de ltar gsungs kyang / kun btus rtsa 'grel dang lam rim chen mo las sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal sogs gsum la yul zag bcas dang bcas pa 'jog par gsungs pa las bde sdug la de ltar 'jog pa'i zur tsam yang ma mthong bas tshad mar gyur ba'i gzhung gi rgyab rten gsal bo ma rnyed par khas blang dka'o zhes zer te brtag go /gang dag nyan sa dang bshes ṭīka sogs kyi don rga ba'i sdug bsngal sogs la'ang tshor ba las yul zag bcas dang bcas pa mi 'jog pa'i don yin zhes zer na/ de ni ma yin te/ de ltar na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal sogs la'ang tshor ba mtshungs ldan dmigs rkyen dang bcas pa mi 'jog dgos pa la de 'jog dgos ba thing rta chen bo dang rje yab sras kyis yang yang gsungs pa'i phyir dang / gzhung rang du'ang skye ba nyid sdug bsngal min par gsu ngas pa las skye ba ni skye ba'i sdug bsngal yang ma yin par ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar na rnam smin bde ba la'ang bde bas ma khyab bar der gyur ba'i phung bo lnga ga 'jog dgos pa dang / bde sdug la tshor bas khyab kyang btang snyoms la des ma khyab pa'ang shes dgos so/ /kho na re/ bde ba la tshor bas ma khyab par thal/ trī chos mngon pa las/ shin tu sbyangs pa bde ba ste/ /zhes shin sbyangs bde bar bshad nga 'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ chos mngon pa las— shin stangs bde bar bshad pa

418ni bsam gtan gyi yan lag brtsi ba'i bde dbang du bzhag pa tsam laspo bde ba dngos la bzhag pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /spyir dran nye la ngo bo'i de dang / mtshungs ldan mide gle/nyis 'byed pa'i phyi ma'ang dran pa nyer bzhag tu khas len dgos mod/ kun btus sogs las bshad pa'i mtshungs ldan sdug bsngal ni sdug bsngal du khas blang mi rung ba nyan sa sogs kyis gsal bar gsungs so/ /kha cig zag bcas la sdug bsngal dang po gnyi gas khyab par thal/ de dang de'i rgyu rnams kyang der 'jog pa'i phyir zer na/ma grub ste/ dbye ba'i skabs su rgyu'i dbang du byas nas bzhag pa ni rgyu tsam la mi byed par tshor ba bde sdug gnyis kyi bdag rkyen dbang bo sogs la byed pa gzhung de dag tu gsal ba'i phyir dang / shes pa de'i nyer len dang lhan cig byed rkyen yin na bdag rkyen sogs gsum po'i gang rung yin pas ma khyab par rkyen gsum la dngos rgyu dgos par sde bdun chen mo sogs tshad thub kyi gzhung las byung ba'i phyir ro/ /yang kho na re/ bde sdug mi 'gal bar thal/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal mi 'gal ba'e phyir na ma khyab po/ /rtags grub ste/ kun btus las/ sdug bsngal nyid gsum po dag gis sdug bsngal rnam pa brgyad bsdus sam/ sdug bsngal rnam pa brgyad kyis sdug bsngal nyid gsum bsdus she na/ gcig gis gcig bsdus te/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang / rga ba'i sdug bsngal dang /na ba'i sdug bsngal dang / 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang / mi sdug pa dang phrad pa'i sdug bsngal gang gsungs pa 'dis ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid yo ngas su bstan to/ /sdug pa dang bral ba'i n+tig bsngal dang / gang

— — — — 419 'dod pa bcol te ma rnyed pa de yang sdug bsngal zhes gang gsungs pa 'dis ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to/ /mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo k+ṣ-ilnga sdug bsngal lo nes gang gsungs pa 'dis ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to/ /zhes sdug bsngal gsum gyis sdug bsngal brgyad bsdus tshul gsal bar gsungs pa dang / de'i thad kyi 'grel ba rnams las kyad de ltar gsungs pa dang / nyan sa dang bsdu ba'i lung sngar drangs pa dag dang / bsdu bar/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang / rga ba'i sdug bsngal zhes bya ba nas rgyas par mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga sdug bsngal ba zhes bya ba'i bar gyi rnam pa brgyad kyis rnam par dbye ba mdzad pa de la rnam pa du dag gis sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan la/ du dag gis ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan/ du dag gis ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan ce na/ dang bo lngas ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to/ /bar ma gnyis kyis ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan te/ sdug pa dang bral bas ni mi sdug pa dang phrad par 'gyur la/ 'dod pas phongs pas ni ma thob pa nyid kyis 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /tha ma mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga sdug bsngal ba zhes bya ba gcig bus ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to/ /zhes sogs de dag kun gyis sdug pa dang bral ba dang 'dod pa btsal bas ma rnyed pa gnyis 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du gsungs pa gang zhig nyan sa las/ skye ba'i sdug bsngal dang / 'dod pas phongs pa'i bar

420 — ju— ri — byu — gyi sdug bsngal zhes gang gsungs pa des ni sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rten dang bcas pa bstan te/ de yang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal yin pas de ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal rnam par bakhyo/ga pa yin no/ /zhes sdug bsngal dang po bdun po sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bsdu bar/ 'gyur ba'i dbang las byung ba'i yid mi bde ba ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid du blta bar bya yi/ 'gyur ba tsam nyid ni ma yin te/ yid mi bde ba dang bral ba rnams la yang de dmigs pa dang gnod par mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam pa gang gis sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid bsdus she na/ smras pa/ mi sdug pa'i rnam pas so/ /rnam pa sa/nga gis 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid bsdus she na/ smras pa/ grub pa dang bde ba med pa'i rnam pas so/ /zhes 'gyur ba'i dbang las byung ba'i tshor ba sdug bsngal 'gyur — ba'i sdug bsngal du gsungs pas de sdug bsngal dang po gnyis ka'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir dang / de nyid las/ de dag gi gnyen po dge ba rnams dang / nyon mongs pa rnams kyis ni 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal —nyid bsdus so/ /zhes 'gyod pa'i rnam can gyi zag tshor dge ba thams cad 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal du gsungs pas na ri'agyur ba'i sdug bsngal la dmigs rkyen gyi dbang du byas na bde sdug gnyi ga yod par ma zad ngo bo'i ri dbang du byas na'ang de gnyis ka yod par grub cing / de yang tshor ba bde ba dang de 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gnyis las snga ma 'gyur na sdug bsngal 'dren pa dang / phyi ma 'gyur nas dngos su drangs pa'i sdug bsngal yin pas na de gnyis 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal yin pa la khyad par med do/ /de

421bas na 'gyur ba'i sdus bsngal dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal ga/nyis ka la bde sdug btang snyo/mas gsum re yod pan khas blangs na shing rta chen po dang rje yab sras kyi dgongs pa gting phug pa yin yang dus 'dir kho bo cag gi rje thams cad mkhyen pa su bhā ཿ'i zhabs ma gtogs legs par shod pa su zhig 'dzam gling na yod/ /ba cig zag bcas kyi bde ba bde ba ma yin par thal/ mdo las/ gang ci tshor yang rung de ni 'dir sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang / bde ba'i tshor ba ni sdug bsngal du blta bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / sdug bsngal la bde ba'o snyam du 'dupashes phyin ci log go /zhes dang / sdug bsngal kho na so sor myong bar 'gyur ci/nga / zhes dang / bde ba'i 'du byed 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / sdug bsngal gsar ba gzhan dang gzhan 'byu nga ba la bde ba'i 'du shes 'byung ste/zhes dang / 'byung ba na 'ang sdug bsngal 'di kho na 'byung la/ 'gag pa na'ang sdug bsngal kho na 'gag ces sogs lung sna tshogs las zag bcas kyi tshor ba thams cad sdug bsngal du gsu ngas pa dang / rin chen phreng ba las/ sdug bsnga' phyir ni bcos pa tsam / /sems kyi 'du shes rang bzhin te/ /rtogs pas byas pa kho nar zad/ /'jig rten bde ba'i bdog pa kun/ /sdug bsngal phyir ni bcos tsam dang / /rtog tsam nyid yin de yi phyir/ /de ni don du don med do/ /'e/sa dang / bzhi brgya ri ba las/ gser gyi snod du skyugs pa la/ /ji ltar 'ga' zhig dgar 'gyur ba/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa/ /bde'o snyam du sems par byed/ /ces dang / 2 ma rem las/ da lta'i tshor babyubade ba

— 422ni phal mo che sdug bsngal phyir bcos pa la bde ba'i skyes pa yin gyi/ zhes dang / 'gro ba drags pas sdug bsngal ba na bsdad pas bde ba'i blo 'byung ba de snga ma'i sdug bsngal che rim nas 'gags pa'i tshe bde ba rim gyis skyes bar snang ba yin gyi/ zhis gsungs pa sogs la dpags na sdug bsngal la bde bar 'du shes pa tsam las zag bcas kyi bde ba la bde pa gtan nas med pa'i phyir/ des na bde ba yin na zag med kyi bde ba yin pas khyab po zhis smra'o/ /de la mdo snga ma'i don ni/ mdo las/ 'phags pa kun dga' bos bcom ldan 'das la bcom ldan 'das kyis bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang bde pa yang ma lags sdug bsngal ba yang ma lags pa dang chor ba 'di gsum yang gsungs la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gang ci tshor yang rung de ni 'dir sdug bsngal lo nes kyang gsungs na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ci la dgongs nas gang ci tshor yang rung de ni 'dir sdug bsngal lo zhes gsungs/ zhes zhus pa na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/kun dga' bo/ gang ci tshor yang rung de ni 'dir sdug bsngal lo zhes bya ba ni ngas 'du byed mi rtag pa nyid dang 'du byed rnam par 'gyur ba nyid la dgongs nas bshad do/ /zhes bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis nyid kyi dgongs ba gsal bar mdzad pa ltar dang / mdo gnyis pa'i don ni/dge slong ma chos sbyin gyi mdo las/ bde ba'i tshor ba ni skyes pa na yang bde/ gnas pa na yang bde la 'gyur ba na sdug bsngal lo/ ji/tsug bsngal gyi tshor ba ni skyes pa na yang sdug bsngal la sa/nas pa na yang sdug bsngal 'o //zhes dang / phye mched drug gi tshogs kyi mdo las/ gang mi rtag pa de ni

— 423 sdug bsngal ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi dbang du byas nas bde ba'i tshor ba ni sdug bsngal du blta bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs par bshad pa mdzod rtsa 'grel ltar dgongs pa len tshul dang / gtan la dbab pa bsdu ba las/ de la bde ba'i tshor ba la lhag par chags pa'i byis pa ni gzhi des tshe 'di la lus kyis nyes par spyod pa dang ngag dang yid kyis nyes par spyod pa spyad nas lus zhig ste shi ba'i 'og tu ngan song ngan 'gro log par ltung ba sems can dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ba dang / zhes pa nas/ de nyid las dgongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bde ba'i tshor ba ni sdug bsngal du blta bar bya/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba ni zug rngur blta bar bya/ sdugatrebasngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba ni mi rtag pa dang 'gog pa'i chos can du blta bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs te/ mi rtag par lta bas ni rim gyis phyin ci log thams cad spong bar 'gyur ro nes gsungs pa ltar bde ba'i tshor ba la chags pas 'as bsasas/ de las sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ba la dgongs nas bde ba'i tshor ba sdugahobasngal du bltatrebar gsungs ba'i don du bkral bas sdis mdo'i dgongs pa len tshul te lugs gnyis ka'ang gnas so/ /mdo gsum pa'i don ni/ mdzod ltar na/mchims ṭīka chen mo las/ sdug bsngal la bde ba'o snyam du 'du shes phyin ci log go zhes pa ni 'jig rten pa rnams tshor ba dang 'dod yon dang skye ba la sdug bsngal yang yod pa la gcig tu bde bar shes pa ni 'du shes phyin ci log yin te/ de dag phal cher sdug bsngal b.ri phyir ro zhes dgongs pa ni

44/tswa///4spre / —————— ——de yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs rtu/ ltar/ zag bcas 'dod yon dang tshor sogs ba mtha' gcig tu bde bar 'dzin pa ni phyin ci log yin pa'i don dang bde ba rang mtshan pa yod par 'dod la/ dbu ma ba ltar na bde pa rang mtshan pa med pa'i don du bzhed do/ /mdo lung lhag ma dang bstan bcos gnyis kyi don yang de ltar shes par bya khya/nga / bstan bcos gnyis kyi don sngar dar ṭīka gnyis drangs pa'ang shin tu gsal ba ltar ro//sdug bsngal gsum gyi khungs su sngar drangs pa'i mdo dang / kun btus las/ bde ba'i tshor ba 'gyur ba rang gi mtshan nyid dang / zhes dang /de'i thad kyi 'grel ba rnams dang / lam rim las/ 'khor ba ba rnams kyi tshor ba bde ba ste/ zhes dang / chags pa rgyas par 'gyur ba'i da lta'i tshor ba bde ba ni/ zhes sogs bde ba zhes pa'i tshig zin mang du snang zhing 'a/gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba de rnams 'gyur ba na sdug bsngal skyed pa ma gtogs/ rang skye ba na sdug bsngal gyi ngo bor skye yi/ bde tsa min zhes ma gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gang dag zag bcas kyi bde ba yin na khyod kyi gdags gzhir sdug bsngal yod pas khyab par thal/ rin chen phreng ba dang / bzhi brgya ba dang / spyod 'jug gsum gyi dar ṭīka so so nas drangs zin pa de'i phyir zhe na/ de ni phal che ba'i don las ma 'das te/lam rim las/ chags pa rgyas par 'gyur ba'i da lta'i tshor ba bde ba ni phal mo che/ zhes phal cher zhes pa'i tshig nus btod pa'i phyir dang / bsam gtan dang po gsum gyi zag bde la phyir bca' rgyu'i sdug bsngal dang gdags sa/zhi'i sdug bsngalu mi rnyed pa'i phyir ro/ /bsdo/ma ba/tan gyi zagaji

rna — sna 11༷: —bde de dag la gong du bshad ma thag pa'i ltos 'gyur gyi khyad chos dngos su mi tshang yang rang mtshan gyi bde ba yin par mi 'gyur te/ lam rim las/'du byed kyi sdug bsngal las ma 'das pas/ de la rang bzhin gyi bde bar 'dzin pa phyin ci log yin pas yang dag par na bde ba med la slar yang ngan 'gror nges par ltung bas mtha' ngan pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar sdug bsngal gyi gnas ngan len dang bcas pa'i 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang / mtha' ngan pa gnyis 7/ yin pa'i phyir ro/ /la la na re/ klu sgrub yab sras kyi lugs la zag bcas kyi bde ba med par thal/ bzhi brgya ba'i rab byed gnyis par de med par yang yang bsgrubs pa'i phyir na/ de ni ngo bo nyid kyi bde ba'am bde ba rang mtshan pa med pa'i don yin pa dar ṭīka dang lam rim du gsal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na tshor ba bde ba la rdzas btags gnyis yodacipar shes par bya la/ ltos 'gyur gyis khyad par du byas pa'i tshor ba rnams bde ba rang mtshan pa min par bshad kyi/ bde ba rang mtshan pa min na ltos 'gyur gnyi ga tshang mi dgos te/ bsam gtan gyi tshor ba de la de chi5 tshang na'ang bde ba rang mtshan pa min pa'i phyir ro/ /des na gzhung 'di dang lam rim las phal cher smras don yang ltos 'gyur gnyis mi tshang ba yod pa la go dgos so/ /bzhi brgya bar bde ba rang mtshan pa med par gsungs ba'i rang mtshan dang / bslab btus rtsa bar/bdag dang gzhan nyid ltos pa ste/ /pha rol tshu rol ji bzhin brdzun/ /ngogs te rang gis pha rol min/ /gang la ltos na tshu rol 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i skopres kyi bdag phe /zhan rang mtshan pa med ces ba'i rang mtshan dang /

426 — lam rim las/ bdag dang gzhan ngo bo nyid kyis so sor ris su chad pa med de/ phan tshun ltos nas bdag la 'ang sa/zhan gyi blo skye la/ gzhan 'a 'ase bdag gi blo skye ba'i phyir te/ pha ri dang tshu ri bzhin no/ /dper na pha ri la 'di ngos nas pha ri'i blo skye yang / pha rir phyin na tshu ri'i blo skye ba bzhin no/ /des na sngon po kha dog su la ltos kyang sngon po nyid kyi blo skyeyi/ zu/ dog gzhan gyi blo mi skye ba dang mi 'dra'o/ /zhes sogs kyi don gong du drangs pa'i bzhi brgya ba'i dar ṭīka tu rtags kyi dgag bya la byed mi rung bar gsal bar gsungs pa ltar/ lam rim gyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyis tha snyad rags pa'i dbang du byas pa'i rang mtshan la gsungs ba ltar go bar bya'o/ /'on kyang rin chen phreng ba dang / bzhi brgya ba dang / spyod 'jug dang / de dag gi dar ṭīka sogs las rang mtshan 'gog pa'i dbang du byas ba'ang yod pas bzhi brgya ba sogs kyi dngos bstan gco bo tha snyad rags pa'i rang mtshan la byas na bskyang bde'o/ /'phagarurna —ga yab sras kyi lugs la zag bcas kyi bde ba med par khas len pa dag ni/ rin chan phreng ba las/ dge la rtag tu 'jug bya ba/ /'di ni chos rnam gsum du bshad/ /chos 'dis dmyal ba yi dwags dang / /dud 'gro dag las rnam grol zhing / /lha dang mi yi nang dag tu/ /bde dpal rgyal srid rgyas pa 'thob/ /bsam gtan tshad med gzugs med ni/ /tshangs sos/sa bde ba myong bar byed/ de ltar mngon mtho'i chos 'di dang //de yi 'bras bu mdor bsdus pa'o/ /zhes zag bcas dge ba dang de'i 'bras bu bde ba yod pare nga/sungs pa dang / bzhi brgya ba'i rab byed bdun

sa 44//tswa//rdo/kā//par/ bsod nams 'bras bu phyug pa ste/ /zhes dang / yu'/ ni dge bas yid 'ong na/ /zhes dang / gla ba lta bu'i bsod nams ni/ /zhes dge ba bsod nams dang de'i 'bras bu so so nas gad par gsungs pa dang 'gal bar 'gyur 'ing / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshor ba gsum dang /tshor dbang lnga dang / phan gnod dang / bde mi bde dang / dge mi dge dang / gnas dang gnas ma yin pa gsungs pa sogs dang 'as/la ba'i phyir ro/ /bzhi brgya ba'i rab byed gnyis par bde ba rang ma/tshan pa med par gsungs pa dang / mdzod gnas drug ba'i rang 'grel du bde ba rang ma tshan pa med na dge sogs med pa'i thal ba rgya cher 'phangs pa dang / zla ba'i zhabs kyis bzhi 'grel du de la skyon spangs ba sogs 'dir bshad na mang bar 'gyur bas gzhung de dag tu bltas pas shes par bya'o//bde sdug myong ba'i tshor ba gnyis gang zag gcig gi rgyud la dus rme nyam du yod na'ang ga/nga zag de rgyud tha dad par mi 'gyur ro/ /cis rme ngon zhe na/ 'di ltar/ dus gcig la lus kyi cha gcig nas bde ba dang cha gcig nas sdug bsngal myong ba dus mnyam pa dang / lus kyi cha so so nas tsha reg dang grang reg gnyis dus mnyam du myong ba dang / phung bo'i kha gting nas bde sdug gnyis sam tsha grang gnyis lta bu dus mnyam du myong ba mngon sum du babs pas so/ /des na/ sems can rnams ni rnam par shes pa rgyud re re ba'o/ /zhes dang / rtog gnyis cig car mthong ba med/ /ces gsungs pa sogs dang 'gal bar mi 'gyur ram zhes rgol na/ ma yi na te/ lung de'i don kun spu/zhi 'dod pa dag ltar na/ rje bstan pa'i
