428 —sgron mes/ lung dang 'gal bar thal ba'i rtsod spong / /zhes pa nas/ snernam shes du ma cig car du skye ba yod par thal/ gzugs mthong bzhin pa'i dus kyi de la 'jug pa'i yid shes gsal ba gcig dang / de 'das jos su dro/ pa'i rnam shes mi sa/sal ba gcig dang gnyis yod par myong bayogrub pa'i phyir/ ri khyab ste/ rnam shes du ma cig car med na mig shes mngon du gyur dus kyi yid shes gsal ba de med dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar kun gzhi gnyis dus mnyam du med pa'i don dang / kun gzhi mi 'dod pa ltar na/ rnam pa gcig dmigs nas 'dra ba'i rnam shes dang rtog pa gnyis dus ma nyam du 'byung mi rung bar gsungs pa sogs bshad tshul sna tshogs yod do/ /bde ba myong badza don yang / dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod chen mo las/ shes pa de la grags pa dang / shes pa de la snang ba dang / myong ba'i tha snyad don gcig yin pas/ zhes gsungs pa'i tshig zin la brten nas rtogs pa la byid pa dang / snang ba la byed pa sogs du ma snang yang / kun gzhi'i mtha' dpyod las/ gzhan yang /tshor bas myong ba dang tshor bde la snang ba gnyis gtan mi 'dra bar thal/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam po bas sems rten byas pa'i bar chad med lam dang mtshungs ldan gyi tshor ba des myong ba dang / de la snang ba gnyis 'asal ba'i phyir/ der thal/ de bde ba'i ngo bor skyes pas bde spu myong bar 'jog kyang bde ba kun rdzob yin pas de'i snang yul du mi rung / chos nyid de'i snang yul yin yang chos nyid myong ba'i tha snyad med pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa khas len pa'i phyogs su blangs na/ dbu ma

429 dang spyod 'jug —gi rang rig gog pa'i thad du ma dang mthun no zhes bdag gi yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs bla ma gsungs so/ /'on kyang mngon sum du cisnang nas rtogs pa la myong stobs kyis rtogs pa dang / rnam pa shar ba la myong bar bshad pa sogs myong ba'i tha snyad 'jug pa mang ba dang / rang myong dang gzhan myong myang bya dang myong byed gcig tha dad las brtsams te blo gros zhib mos brtag par bya ba mang ngo zhes gzu bor gnas pa dag la snyan sgron bya'o/ /mdor na bde sdug la sems byung tshor bas khyab kyang sdug bsngal gsum la tshor bas ma khyab pa dang / skye rga sogs de dang de'i sdug bsngal yin yang spyir sdug bsngal ma yin pa dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal la dmigs rkyen gyi dbang gis bde ba dang btang snyoms kyang yod pa dang / 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal la rnam par 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang rnam par 'gyur ba las byung ba'i sdug bsngal ga/nyis yod pa dang / sdug bsngal drug dang / brgyad dang / brgya rtsa sogs bshad pa thams cad sngar ltar sdug bsngal gsum du 'du ba'i tshul dang / sdug bsngal dang po gnyis mi 'gal 'i/nga de gnyis la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa'i tshul dang / zag bde la bde ba rang mtshan pa med kyang zag bde la bde ba mtshan nyid pa yod pa dang / 'dir bstan rang ma tsha na gyi don mtshan nyid pa dang rtags kyi dgag bya'i rang mtshan la mi byed pa dang /sdug bsngal rang mtshan pa yod kyang dgag bya'i rang mtshan yod mi dgos pa dang / bde ba rang mtshan pa min pa'i 'jog rgyad ltos 'gyur gyi khyad par gnyis la byas kyang / de'i 'jog byed yin na khyad chos de ri nyis yin mi

430dgos pa dang / khams gong gi bde ba la khyad chos de gnyis mi ldan yang bde ba rang mtshan pa yin mi dgos pa dang / zag bde phal cher sdug bsngal chung rim la btags pa yin yang sdug bsngal yin mi dgos shing —btags yod rdzas yod kyi sems byung mang du yod tshul dang / bde sdug myong ba'i don dpyis phyin pa sogs shing rta chen po'i gsung rab gsal du btang nas bshad pa 'di lta bus mig byas nas skabs thams cad du tshad mar gyur ba dag la yid brtan par bya yi/ rang gi zhe 'dod dang mi mthun pa tsam gyirnga sdo legs par bshad pa gser gyi phung bo dag kyang khyi lud bzhin du 'dor ba'i ngang tshul rilhur bya mi rigs pas tshod zin par bya'o/ /de ltar sdug bsngal gsum gyi rnam par gzhag pa las brtsams te legs par bshad pa'i dga' ston cung zad spros pa yang / sdug bsngal gsum gyi don 'khrul ba dang bral ba khong du chud pa dang / ji ltar khing du chud pa'i don yang dag par bas mas te srid pa las nges par 'byung ba'e bsam pa brtsol med skyed par 'dod pa'i skrul ba bzang bo dang ldan pa/ gzu bor sa/nas shing rnam dpyod bkra ba re ga/nyis la phan pa 'ang srid dam snyam pa dang /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas/ bdag gi legs bshad dri ma med pa 'di/ /'gran 'dod phrag dog sdang sems kyis bsgribs nas/ /gzur gnas yid ches gnas su su zhig len/ /len pa med kyang dam chos bdud rtsi yis/ /rang gi yid kyi zug rngu cis mi sel/ /zhes sa/sungs pa ltar rang blo don yang dag pa la goms pa'i phyir/ — shing rta chen po dang 'jam ṇa/petre/na bla ma'i dgongs pa pyo na med par mtshon pa la grol ba don du

— — 4bye1 gnyer ba dag gi mig tu gyur ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsi la rang bzos lhad ma bcug par yi ge ris su spel ba ste/ gzhan du na/ yang dag pa'i gtam thos pa na sbrul gdug pas gla ba'i—rtsi snom pa bzhin du phrag dog dang rmongs ba'i gdon gyis myos te lab rdowodabyangs su byas pas lus med kyi rgyal mtshan phrag par len pa dag gis ni rnam par dag pa'i don cha tsam yang mthong mi nus pa nyid kyis dgos don mi snang ngo / /smras pa/ lnga rig shes bya'i ri mo ma 'dres par/ /dri med blo yi me long la 'phos shing / /bsdung bo'i legs mdzad gom ba'i stabs ༷gcig gis/ /dpardzu ༈na mkhas dgu'i zur phud la chags pa/ /de yi zhabs skyes gser gyi 'o rgyun can/ /gtsug skyes 'khri shing yal ga'i nor gcig tu/ /bzung las kho bo rgyu la ma brten par/ /rang byung smin—rnga/'i 'bras bu ma yin zhing / /na tshod me tog gang bu gsar ba'i dus / /rang dang 'tshams min grags pa'i bsung zhim can/ /kho lag phyogs su rdzogs pa dga' ba'i tshal/ /'gengs pa'i dus la bab tshe shing kog tshul/ /ma yin 'phags bod legs bshad bsil ba'i sman/ /'thungs pas rnam byed bzhin gyi ku mu ta/ /don bzang li khri'i thig le 'khyil legs pas// /gtsug lag nam mkha'i mtha' yang mthong la chas/ /de phyir ris su ma bcas skal ba bzang / /dpag yas gzhung lugs khrus kyi rdzing yangs por/ rtsen la sngon med gtam gyi mā li ka /thos pa 'dzin gang sgeg pa'i dpyid du byas/ /'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan mchog de dang des/ /bla

4bye3 ca med mkhas par rlom pa'i nga rgyal gzhu/ /tshod med 'gus/sa pa'i yon tan phung bo zhig /e ma bdag gi gtsug na lhan skyes phyir/ /gang gis gang zhig smras pa'i gtam 'di yang / /mang thos mang du bsags pa'i mkhas rnams kyis/ /brtags shing brtags na 'khrul ba'i go skabs ni/ /chos mthun chos kyis dpyad na yod re skan/ /de lta bu ni rang gi ngang tshul gtam du bya ba'i snyan ngag gi me tog sil ma nyams mtshar du spel ba'o/ / gsum pa log par rtog pa'i mtha' bye brag tu dgag pas smra ba ngan pa tshar gcod pa la gsum/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang /zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo dang / 'khor ba la log par rtog pa dgag pa'i sgo nas smra ba ngan pa tshar gcod pa'o/ /dang bo khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la log par rtog pa dgag pa'i sgo nas smra ba ngan pa tshar pocod pa ni/ de yang gangs can rgyal ba'i dbang bo bcu gsum pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho'i rigs kyi cod pan/ dge ldan bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' bdag snyigs ma'i dus kyi sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ rje btsun dge 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i lam khrid chen mo dge legs 'od snang 'gyed pa'i nyin byed du/ zag bcas kyi tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum dang /de dag dang mchungs ldan kyi sems sems byung rnams dang / bdag rkyen dbang bo rnams dang / dmigs rkyen yu la gsum bcas thams cad la sdug bsngal skyed pa'i nus ba'am sa bon yod pas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du 'jog pa la dgongs nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zag bcas thams cad

rko 4bye3 sdug bsngal du gsungs/ zhes bka' stsal spu'i rting mnan te/ mdo— sngags yongs su rdzokegs pa'i sde snod rgya mtsho lta bu'i dgongs don dngos po stobs shugs kyis 'byed pa la dus 'dir 'gran pa'i zla thams cakau nas thams cad du bral ba/ 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos/ mi pham mtsho byung bzhad pa'i lang tsho dpal bzang bo nas/ nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab bo/ /zhes bya ba'i bka' mchid gzhom du med pa'i dam bca' mdzad do/ /de la/ kha cig na re/nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la khyab nga/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis ma khyab ste/ phar phyin mtha' dpyod las/ ngo bo'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum yod/ ces sdug bden la ngo bo'i sgo nas sdug bsngal gsum du dbye ba gang zhig ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba la nang phan tshun 'gal dgos pa rigs smra'i spyi lugs yin pa'i phyir dang / rta nag rnam 'grel las/ dzānyer len gyi phung bo yin na khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab zer na/ so skye tha mal ba'i rgyud kyi sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal chos can/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin par thal/ nyer len gyi phung bo yin pa'i phyir/'dod na/ de chos can/ sdug bsngal bden —pa phra mo yin par thal/'dod pa gang zhig sdug bsngal bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin na sdug bden rags pa ma yin pas khyab par gsungs pa dang / sde bdun rgyan las/ phung bo gang las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can yin pa ne 'du byed kyi phung bo'i don ldog yin la/

4bye4 ———— go — — — — — — — — — —— zhes 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang nyer len gyi phung bo don gcig tu gsungs shing / nyer len gyi phung be+e la rgyud kyis bsdus pas khyab pa/ phar phyin mtha' dpyod las/ nyer len gyi phung bo nang gi sdug bden du bshad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ 'e/sa gsungs pa dang mthun par sde bdun chen mo las kyang / sdug bsngal bden pa la ma dag pa'i snod bcud kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag gis bsdus pa'i sgo nas mtshan gzhi rgya cher bshad du yod kyang /'dir zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo kho na sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan gzhir dngos su smras pa ni/ gang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du ma shes na 'khor pa la 'dor bar 'dod pa'i nges 'byung dang / thar pa don gnyer gyi blo rnal ma skye ba'i thabs med cing / gang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes pa—las 'khor ba la 'dor 'dod ngang gis 'byung ba ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyer len gyi phung bo 'di nyid yin pas/ de'i phyir gtso bor rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas te/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan gzhi 'dzin pa na/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung bo/ ༈zhes gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / zag bcas thams cad 'durtsobyed kyi sdug bsngal yin na/ bla ma'i sku tshab las/ bde ba can gyi so skye'i rten la nyon mongs pa'i sa bon yod kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal med/ ces bde ldan so skye'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs kyi sa bon 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal min par gsungs pa dang 'gal la/ kun btus las/ yongs su dag pa'i 'jig rten gye khams de dag ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ma yin par blta ste/ de dag las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa ma yin/ las

435 gedang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba ma yin gyi/ smon lam dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i dbang gis byung ba dag go /zhes dag zhing na sdug bden med par gsungs pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir dang / phar phyin mtha' dpyod las/byang 'phags rgyud kyi 'dod sred chos can/ mtshan nyid der thal/ kun 'byung bden pa yin pa'i phyir te/ nyon mongs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ des nyon mongs kyi nyes pa mi skyed pa' phyir/ zhes byang 'phags rgyud kyi nyen mongs kun 'byung du gsu ngas la/ de 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal min pa/ bla ma'i sku tshab las/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud la nyon mongs pa'e sa bon yod kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal med/ ces gsungs nga ri phyir dang / 'a sa nyon gyis skye ba blangs pa'i rgyun zhugs sogs zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung dang 'brel bas zag bcas yin par grub la/ de 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ma yin padz+ra ma zad sdug bden cam yang ma yin pa/phar phyin yig cha las/ khon re/ de gang rung la spang bya mi dbo/sa par thal/ sdug bden du gyur ba'i 'phags pa yod/ kun 'byung bden par gyur ba'i tshogs sbyor yod pa'i phyir/ dang bo grub ste/ las nyonagyis 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i 'bras gnas dang bo gsum yod pa'i phyir na ma snyokhyab/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir dang / skyabs gnas yin pas spang byar mi rung ba'i phyir dang / yul khams sogs 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin na rtsa 'phrul tsam gyis 'da' nus par thal ba'i phyir dang / dkon ba rdu gas 'od spungs le'u las/ 'od srungs 'di lta ste/ dper na sngags dang sman gyis yongs su zin pa'i dug gis ni 'chi bar byed mi nus so/ /'od sru ngas de

436bzhin du ye shes dang thabs mkhas pas yongs su zin pa 'e byang chub sems dpa' ni nyon mongs pa 'i dug gis kyango log par ltung bar byed mi nus so/ / zhes dang / dper na sngags kyis yongs su zin pa'i dug /skye bo rnams la nyes pa byed mi nus/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes can/ /nyon mongs rnams kyis log ltung byed mi nus/ /zhes dang /'od srungs 'di lta ste/ dper na grong khyer chen po rnams kyi lud gang yin pa de mi/ bu ram shing gi zhing dag dang / rgun gyi zhing dag la phan par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'od srungs de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs nga/'i lud gang yen pa de yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la phan par 'gyur ba yin/ no/ /zhes dang / dper na grong khyer rnams kyi mi gtsang lud/ /de ni bu ram shing gi zhing la phan/ /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa'i nyon mongs lud/ /de ni rgyal ba'i chos la phan pār byed/ /ces dang /kun btus las/ sa bcu rnams su sgom pa'e lam la shes bya'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po'i lam sgom gyi nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa'i gnyen po ni ma yin te/zhes pa nas/ des nyon mongs ma spangs su zin kyang sngags dang sman gyis bsad thazu 'i dug lta bu dang / dper na/ de spangs pa'i dgra bcom pa ltar sa thams cad du nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa mi skyed do/ /zhes dang / rgyud bla dar ṭīka las/ srid pa'i zag pa mngon gyur yod kyang sngags dang sman gyis bsad pa'i dug lta bu nyon mongs pa'i nyes pa mi skyed pa yin no/ /zhes byang 'phags kyi nyon mongs ni zag pa'i ngo bo yin pas zag bcas yin yang / sdug bsngal skyed pa'i nus pa med pa sngags dang sman gyis bsad

— 43bhāpa'i dug bzhin yi na/ par gsungs pa'i phyir dang / las nyon gyis skye ba blangs tshad 'du byed kyi sdu ga bsngal du 'jog na so skye dang lus rten gcig gis bsdus nga 'iri byang 'phags mthong lam pa dang / lhag bcas dgra bcom pa sogs 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas spang byar thal ba dang / phar phyin mtha' dpyod las/ tshogs lam du gyur ba'i sems pa dang sbyor lam du gyur ba'i setre ṭas pa/ zhes pa nas/ de yang dge ba zag bcas yin pas/ zhes chu+ogs sbyor gnyis zag bcas su gsungs pas de dag kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal dang spang byar thal ba'i phyir/ zhes bya ba ni nyon cho/ngas kyi zag bcas la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis ma khya/ ba pa'i sgrub byed mthar thug pa ltar snang ba'i lung rigs kyi rdzong btsan po skad pa yin no/ /'on kyang bdag gi rje bla ma gang la bgro gleng byed pa bo dang / de'i rjes su cal 'drogs byed pa dag gis ni 'di lta bu'i lung rigs kyang ma rnyed par rang gi yig cha'i ngo gdong tsam dang ma mthun pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas nam mkha'i mthongs la mi lta bar mdzub rma/'i rtse mo la lta bar byed do/ /da ni lung rigs de dag las 'thad mi 'thad dang / 'thad nga rnams kyi don phyin ci ma log nga ro bshad pa'i sgo nas rtsod pa ji ltar spong ba dang / 'khrul bral rang lugs kyi sgrub byed rnam par dag pas sba ba'i lung rigs kyi tshogs zad du med pa rnarma sa mthar chags su dgod par bya yi/ gzu bor gnas pa dang / blo gros dang ldan pa dang / tshul 'di shes par 'dod pa'i don gnyer rnam sa mngon du byos la nyon cig yig cha dang rta nag pa'i rnam 'grel gnyis su / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal mi

438 — — —'jog pa ni/ mdo las/ gang mi rtag pa de thams cad sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang / mdor na nyer len gyi phung bo lnga sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang /gang ci tshor yang rung de thams cad sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa sogs mdo mang bo dang 'gal zhing / sa'i dngos gzhir/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gyis bsdus pa gang yi na pa dag ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis bsdus pa yang de dag yin no/ /zhes sdug bsngal dang po gnyis kyis bsdus pa ya nga sdug bsngal tha ma yin pa ra gsungs pa dang / drangs zin pa dang 'dren par 'gyur ba'i bstan bcos mang po las/ sdug bsngal dang po gnyis kyis bsdus tshad la phyi mas bsdus pas khyab par bstan pa dang / lam rim las sdug bsngal thams cad la khyab pa dang sdug bsngal gzhan gnyis kyi rtsa ba yin par gsungs pa dang dngos su 'gal bas mi 'thad par rtogs sla la/ dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod las/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba zhes khas len dartso/sa pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / mdzod mtha' daphyod sogs su kun mkhyen bla mas zag bcas la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab pa mang du ba sgrubs pas skabs dang po'i yig cha'i de kun mkhyen bla ma'i rang lugs rnal ma ma yin pa'i phyir dang /sde bdun chen mo las/ phung bo gang las dang nyon mongs pa'i gzhan dbang can yin pa mi/ 'du byed kyi phung bo'i don ldog tu gsungs pa gnod byed du mi 'gro bar ma zad sgub byed du 'gro ste/ sdug bden yin na 'du byed kyi phung bo yin panu/ khyab pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sdug bden thams cad phung bo geng / las nyon gyi sa/zhan dbang can yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa sde

439bdun chen mo'i lung la song / yig cha sogs su nyer len gyi phung bo la rgyud kyis bsdus dgos par gsungs pa ni khas blang du mi rung ba'i tshul 'og tu sdug bden dang nyer len gyi phung bo don gcig tu ston par 'gyur bas shes shing / sde bdun rgyan las sdug bden la snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i mtshan gzhi mang ya nga nyer len gyi phung bo blangs par gsungs pa ni/ zag bcas la de yin min gnyis 'byed pa min par nyams len gyi gnad chen po go ba'i phyir yin te/ de nyid las/ 'dir zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo kho na sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan gzhir dngos su smras pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ gtso bor rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i dbang du byas te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dper na/ bstod 'grel bstan pa'i de nyid snang ba las/ rje bla mas/ zhes par bya ba'ang kun rjob dang don dam pa'i bden pa gnyis su zad do/ /zhes yab sras mjal ba las gsungs pa khungs su drangs te shes bya bden gnyis kyi dbye gzhir bsgrubs pa'ang /yod pa dang gzhi grub bden gnyis kyi dbye gzhir bzhag pa dang mi 'dra bar blo ba nang du bskor te rnam grol don du gnyer ba la med mi rung du shes par bya dgos pa bden pa gnyis su nges pa'i don yin pas shes bya zhes nga 'i ming tsam la'ang nyams len gyi gnad go rgyu zhig yod pa rigs lam smra ba rnams kyis dgongs par mdzod cig ces bden gnyis kyi dbye gzhi la yod pa sogs mang du yod kyang shes bya blangs pa la nyams len gyi po/nad che+on po yod par gsungs pa bzhin/ 'dir yang ka ba dang bum pa so gas mtshan gzhir ma bzung bar nyer len gyi phung bo bzung ba ni de'i ming gi

440 steng nas kyang nyams len gyi gnad che shos shig go rgyu yod par gsu/ngas pa yin pa'i phyir dang / bla ma'i sku tshab sogs su bde ldan so skye 'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs kyi sa bon 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal min par gsungs ba ni gang dang bstun te gsung yul kun btus dang 'gal te/ de nyid las/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis byung ba thams cad sdug bden du gsungs pas nyon mongs kyi sa bon rang rgyu nyon mongs las byung bar rigs pa smra ba gsar bu dag gis kyang the/sa pa'i phyir dang / kun btus su sdu ga bden min pa la sgrub byed gnyis bkod pa las bde ldan so rngu 'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa'i sa bon de sdug bden ma yin pas sgrub byed gnyis po gang gi dbang du byas kyang mi rigs te/ las nyon gyi dbang gis byung ba ma yin par mi 'grub la/ smon lam dang dge ba'i rtsa ba'i dbang gis byung ba sangs/ rgyas kyis kyang mi 'grub pa'i phyir dang / bde ldan so skye'i rgyud kyi nyon mo/ngas pa'i sa bon zag bcas yin la sdug bden min pa mi 'thad pa mi/ / gser phreng las zag bcas mtshan nyid pa thams cad sdug bden du bshad pas grub nga/'i phyir ro/ /dag zhing na sdug bden med par yang mi 'grub ste/ mi 'khrugs nga/'i zhing mdo las/ shā ra dwa ti'i bu/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na gang gi tshe skyes pa dag kun tu chags pa'i sems bskyed pa na de song ste kun tu chags pa'i sems kyis bucid med la yud tsam zhig blta sa pa tsam gyis skyes pa de'i 'dod chags rab tu zhi bar gyur te/ shin tu yid byung zhing spangs nas mi sdug pa la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob po/ /zhes shar phyogs mngon dga' na chags pa skyes pa

441yod par gsungs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dbang bo'i tog gi zhing gi bkod pa ston pa'i skabs su/ de bzhin gshegs pa dbang bo'i tog gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu gyur te yongs su dag cing ngan song dang mi khom pa thams cad yongs su zad pa ste/ zhes de bzhin gshegs pa dbang bo'i tog gi zhing de dag nga 'i zheng du gsungs la/ de na sdug bsngal gzhan med kyang khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yod de/ /de nyid las/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i sems can de dag la ya nga ba ma spangs pa med de/ zhes pa nas/ 'di ltar de na sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba rgyu ba med pa'e phyir ro/ /gzhan du na 'du byed kyi sdu ga bsngal gcig bu yod de/ 'di lta ste/ mi rtag pa'i sdug bsngal nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / kun gzigs kyi zheng mdor/ gang dag der sangs rgyas lta ba'i yid la ba gyi ba skyes ma thag tu de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu gzigs pa byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs pa de de nyid na bzhugs par mthong bar gyur cing mthong nas kyang bcom ldan 'das de mthong ma thag tu de dag gi the tshom mam nem nur ram yid gnyis nu/ma chos kyi som nyi gang ci mchis pa yongs su chad par gyur te bstan mi 'tshal bar chos kyi tshig de'i don yongs su 'tshal bar gyur cig ces bgyi bar smon lam btab po/ /zhes sangs rgyas kun gzigs kyi zhing na the tshomyog carlo yo da rī /ra gsungs la/ de rnams kyis sangs rgyas kun tu sa/zigs yid k+ṣ-ir ngachis5/ sa ma thag de das/ gi masdin nyid na bzhugs/ par

442mthong nas chos bstan mi dgos par the tshom gcod nus pa/ zhes 'o skol gyi ston pa tshad ma blo bzang rgyal bas kyang mdo de sgra ji bzhin par bkral ba'i phyir dang / the tshom la mthong spang nyon mongs kyis khyab pa kun la rlung ltar grags pa'i phyir ro/ /des na dag tshi/nga rnams la gdul bya'i dbang gis snod bcud kyi bkod pa la rgya che chung sna tshogs yod pas mtha' gcig tu nges bzung mi rung mod/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing mdo las/ 'jig rten gyi khams de na mi dge ba'i ming yang med do/ /sgrib pa'i sgra yang med do/ /ngan song ngan 'gro rnam par ltung ba'i sgra yang med do/ /sdug bsngal gyi sgra yang med do/ /kun dga' bo/ de na sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa'i tshor ba'i sgra yang med na sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi sgra yang lta ga la yod/ ces gsungs pa ni 'i/nga der so skye'i rgyud na sgrib pa mngon gyur ba med pa'i don nam/ 'jug ṭīka chen mo/ stong thun skal bzang mig 'byed/ phar phyin rtogs dka'i snang ba gsu ma gar rang rgyud nga/'i lugs la mthong lam bar chad med lam pa'i rgyud la rten zag bcas kyi rnam shes ldog stobs kyis brten pa sgom spang gi sa bon log par bshad pa bzhin/ rten zag bcas kyi rnam shes ldog stobs kyis brten pa zag bcas ldog pas sgrib pa med par khas len pa 7—nga rigs las ma 'das so / / de bas na dag zhing sdug bden min pa dang dwag zhing smon lam las grub pa dang / dag zhing gi sdug bden med par don la gnas mod/dag 'ing na sdug bden yod chog ste/ dag zhing na sdug bden yod pas de dag nga/'i zhi nga du 'gyur dogs med pari phyir/ dper na/ ma dag pa'i

443 zheng du yod na sdug bden dang ma dag pa yin mi dgos pa 'dzam gling gi sangs rgyas byang sems dang 'bras gnas bzhi sogs kyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan bzhin no/ /gzhan du na/ khyed cag gis bde ldan so skye'i rgyud la nyon mongs pa'i sa bon bzhag pa de yang smon lam gyi dbang gis byung ba dang zag med yin par thal khyi/nga / bdag cag gi ston pa nas bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi bar gyi 'phags chen de snyed chos can/ ma dag par thal ma dag pa'i ri/nga na gzhi grub kyi dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/mdor na las nyon gyis grub pa'i ma dag pa'i zheng du yod pa la ma dag pas khyab pa dang / dag pa'i zhing na yod pa la dag pas khyab par khas len spro ba su zhig yod/ lam zin dang ser byes yig cha sogs las byang sems 'phags rgyud kyi sred pa zag bcas yin yang sdug bden dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ma yin par gsungs mod/ bsdu ba las/ kun 'byung ba'i bden pa gang yin pa de ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ya nga yin mod kyi/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa yin la kun 'byung ba'i bden pa ma yin pa yang yod de/zhespodang / gser phring las/ kun 'byung la sdug bden gyis khyab la sdug bden la des ma khyab ste/ dper na kun gzhi dang snod kyi 'jig rten dang dbang bo lnga dang gzhan yang ma bsgribs lung ma bstan zag bcas rnams lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / mdor na zag bcas mtshan nying pa gang yin pa de tsho snethams cad sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'o/ /zhes dang / phar phyin skabs dang po'i mtha' dpyod las/ kun 'byung bden pa la sdug bden gyis khyab kyang sdug bden la kun 'byung bden pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ zhes kun

444 —— 'byung la sdug bden gyis khyab par gsungs pa dang / byang sems 'phags rgyud kyi nyon mongs kun 'byung du gsungs pa sngar drangs pa ltar yin pas na rgyu mtshan de gnyis kyis byang sems 'phags rgyud kyi nyon mongs sdug bden du 'grub la/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa ni nyon mongs pa'i lag rjes las byung ba'i zag bcas kyi phung bo yin pas grub pa'i phyir ro/ /ma dag pa'iri yul khams sdug bden dang zag bcas su khyed cag gis kyang khas len pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul tsam gyis sdug bden dang zag bcas las 'da' nus pa'i thal ba khyod rang dag gis gtsug tu longs shig 'od srungs kyi le'ur byang sems 'phags rgyud kyi nyon mongs sngags dang sman gyis bcom pa'i dug bzhin du gsungs pa ni/ drangs zin pa ltar mdo rang nyid las log par ltung mi nus pa dang / gzhan don byed pa la phan 'dogs byed du gsal bar gsungs pa dang / rgyud bla ma'i dar ṭīka las/ srid pa'i zag pa mngon gyur yod kyang sngags dang sman gyis bsad pa'i dug ltar nyon mongs pa'i nyes ba mi skyed pa yin no/ /nyon mongs pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ sems kyi rgyud rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa yin la/ de yang sems kyi chirgyud —rab shetu zhi ba mi/ mya ngan las 'das pa la brjod la/ de'i ldog phyogs ma zhi ba ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang / de byed pa ni nyon mongs yin/ yang / byang5chub sems dpa' 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud la yod pa'i nyon mongs la nyon mongs kyi sgra 'jug pa yod kyang bshad pa ltar gyi sgra bshad du med do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nyon mongs la byed las mang du yod pa'i nang nas sems rgyud ma zhicib dang 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i byed las gnyis bcom pa'i cidon

44lhayin gyi/ sdug bsngal skyed pa'i nus pa bcom rnga/'i don ma yin pa'i phyir dang / sdug bsngal skyed pa'i nus pa yod kyang sdug bsngal skyed mi dgos te/byang sems 'phags rgyud kyi bdag 'dzin lhan skyes 'khor rtsa yin yang /slar 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gtan nas mi byed pa bzhin yin pa'e phyir ro/ /phyi rol gyi dpe la'ang skad cig gnyis par bya rog gis 'don nges kyi sa bon la myu gu skyed pa 'i nus pa yod kyang myu gu mi skyed pha dmigs pa'i phyir ro/ /las nyon gyis skye ba blangs pa'i rgyun zhugs sogs sdug bden min pa phar phyin mtha' dpyod dang / bden bzhi'i mtha' dpyod dang / rta nag pa'echornam 'grel sogs su gsungs kyang / ser 'bras kyi yig cha gzhan du de dag sdug bden du gsungs la/ 'og tu shes byed rgyas par 'god pas kyang sdug bden du dpog go /de dag chos can/ spang bya yin par thal/las nyon gyis bskyed pa'i sdug bden yin pa'i phyir na/ sbyor lugs skyon can te/ dper na/ rnam 'grel le'u dang bo'i mtha' dpyod du/ longs sku'i yid kyi rnam shes chos can/ khyod kyi 'khor du gyur ba'e byang 'phags yod par thal/ khyod longs sku yin pa'i phyir na sbyor lugs skyon can te/zhes longs sku la nges pa lnga ldan gyis khyab par khas blangs pa la mtshon gzhi'i yid kyi rnam shes skyon du 'phangs pa la sbyor lugs skyon can gyi lan mdzad pa bzhin no/ /'o na khyod rang la/ rgyun zhugs dang lhag bcas dgra bcom pa'i sku gdung chos can/ mchod na phan yon med par thal/sdug bden dang spang bya gnyis ka yi na ba'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grigs/ ded+kuchos can/ spang byar ngazung na nyes pa med par thal/ sdug bden yin

446 — — pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grigs/ ding sang gi sku 'dra dang glegs bam 'di rnams chos can/ mchod na mchod sogs sangs rgyas dang mnyam pa mi 'byung bar thal/ sdug bden yi na pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grigs/ de chos can/ spangs na nyes pa med paracithal/ sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grigs/ de dag rten yin pas sdug bden min na/ byang 'phags mthong lam thob ma thag pa dang lhag bcas dgra bcom gser gyi ri bo 'dra ba dag gi lus rten de bsamodzekyang sdug bden min par khas len dgos te/de dag 'phags pa dngasa'aphags lam gyi rten yin pa'i phyir/ pha ma chos can/ sbang rung bar thal/ sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grigs/de bas na/ spyir btang dmigs kyis bsal ba ni/ /bstan bcos kun la rab tu gces/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di go dgos so/ /las nyon gyis skye ba blangs pa'i so skye dang lus rten gcig gis bsdus pa'i byang sems mthong lam pa ya nga zag bcas su thal bar mi 'gyur te/ rgyud bla dar ṭīka las/ blo ldan byang sems 'phags pa las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba dang 'chi ba dang na ba dang rga ba las grol ba yin te/ spyod pa rgya chem/ pos khyad par du byas nas khams 'di'i rang bzhin ji lta ba bzhin nyid du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / byang sems 'phags pas las/ nyon gyi dbang gis 'chi ba dang na ba dang rga ba'i sdug bsngal rtsad nas spangs nas de la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal de med de/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis skye ba de med pa'i phyir/ theg pa dman pa'i 'ophags pa slob pa rnams stong ba nyid kyi don mngon sum du rtogs kyang / thabs khyad par

44lha can gyis ma zin pas las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba len pa yod la byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnam sa ni de ltar skye ba ma yin no/ /zhes dang /thabs rgya chen pos khyad par du byas nas stong ba nyid kyi don mngon su ma gyis rtogs pas las nyon gyi dbang gis nying mtsham sa sbyor ba'i skye ba snang ba med pasacigacig shos 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi me gsum gtan 'bar ba med par rtogs pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar thabs rgya chen pos khyad par du byas pa'e stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pas zag bcas gnas gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /grub mtha' chen mo las/ rgyud bla ma'i lung la 'khrul nas theg chen 'phags pa la las nyon gyis skye 'chi gang yang med pas khyab par 'dod pa ni 'khrul ba shin tu rags te/ theg chen sbyor lam pa so skye dang lus rten gcig gis bsdus pa'i theg chem mthong lam pa chos can/ las nyon gyi dbang gis nyer len gyi phung bo 'dor dgos ma yin par thal/ theg chen 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ las nyon gyi dbang gis blangs pa'i 'khor ba rags pa rgyud ldan yin pa'i phyir te/dper na/ nyer len gyi phung bo rgyud ldan gyi lhag bcas dgra bcom bzhin yin pa' phyir dang / las nyon gyis skye 'chi gang yang mi byed pa la theg chen 'phags lam tsam gyis mi chog gi yid kyi lus gsum po gang rung thob pa'i byang sem/sa rnams la dmigs kyis bsal ba ltar dgos la/ de 'dra ba'i mthong lam pa nyer len gyi phung bo 'khor ba ma dag pa'i rgyun la gnas pa'i phyir/ zhes de 'dra'i byang 'phags las nyon gyis 'chi yang slar skye 'chi mi byed pa rgyud bla ma'i lung don du bshad pa'ang khas blang sdo mi rung

448 ngo / /ci'i phyir zhe na/ blo bzeng rgyal ba'i legs par bshad pa dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar na 'di ltar/ sngags rim las/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'phags pas 'chi dang rga ba dang / /nes pa nas/ theg chen —'phags pa rnams kyis las kyi dbang gis 'chi ba spangs par gsungs pa dang / byang sar sa thob nas yo byad kyis phongs pa mi srid par gsungs la/ 'dir las dbang gis 'chi ba ma spangs shing yo byad ma tshang bas de ltar byed par gsungs pas sgyu lus ma thob pa'i so so skye bo yin no/ /zhes dang / rim lnga gsal sgron las/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'phags pas 'chi dang rga ba dang / /zhes pa nas/ phar phyin gyi theg chen 'phags pas kyang las dbang gis 'chi ba spangs par gsungs na/ sngags kyi theg chen 'phags pas spangs pa lta ci smos/ zhes rten de la byang serma sa 'phags pa thob pa la'ang las nyon gyis 'chi ba med par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /phyis kyi rtog ge ba kha cig de 'dra'i byang sem sa 'phags pa las nyon gyis 'chi la/ las nyon gyi dbang gis mi 'chi zer ba'i zhib cha 'don khul byed pa'ang yig cha'i dgongs pa tsam la'ang mi gnas na gzhan lta ci smos pa'i phyir ro/ /kun btus las/ ji ltar na spang bar bya ba ma yin/ spang bar bya ba ma yin pa rnams ni du zhig ci'i phyir spang bar bya ba ma yinapyipar brtag ce na/ zag pa med pa ni spang bar bya ba ma yin pa ra blta'o/ /nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa ma gtogs par phung bo rnams dang /kham sa gsum dang / skye mched gnyis kyi phyogs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don la/ de'i red ṭīka las/ nges par 'byed pa'i cha dang mthun pa ni

449rjes su mthun pa'i zag med yin yang spang bya ma yin nga 'i zag med kyi khongs su sa/togs pa ma yin te/ zag nga/'i gnas/ ngan len gyi rjes su 'brel bas sgom pas spang bar bya ba yin ngasto'i phyir ro/ /zhes tshogs sbyor sgom spang du gsungs ba dngatsho/ de'i dar ṭīka las/ nges 'byed cha mthun ma gtogs zhes smos pa la dgos pa yod de/ zag med 'phel ba dang rjes su mthun zheng srid pa la rgyab kyis phyogs pas rjes su mthun pa'i zag med yin zhing spang bya ma yi/na nam snyam du dogs pa bsal ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ zag pa'i gnas ngan len rjeṭa4 su 'brel zhing / de'i tshe yang nyon yid mngon gyur yod pas sgom pas spang bar bya bas bsdus nga/ yin gyi ngo bo'i sgo nasu spang bya ma yin te/ bdag med rtogs pa'i blo gang gis kyang spang dudze mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ ci /zhes spang byas bsdus par gsungs pa dang bstun te/ skabs dang po'i mtha' dpyod du tshogs sbyor zag bcas su bshad pas sems tsam pa'i lugs la tshogs sbyor zag bcas dang zag bocas thams cad sdug bsngal ba dang spang byar rgya bod kyi shing rta ba dag gis gsungs pa'i phyir co 'dri bar 'dod na mtho tshad la gyis shig dar ṭīlo/ ltar na tshogs sbyor spang byas bsdus pa tsam du zhal gyis 'ches pas rgyun zhugs sogs kyang de bzhin dmigs bsal byed dgos pa de'i rigs 'gres 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /dbu ma ba'i lugs la tshogs sbyor nyon mongs pa'e zag bcas ma yin te/ zag pa ni nyon mongs dang de'i lag rjes su byung ba'i dngos po la nyon mongs pa'e zag bcas su khas len pas nyon mongs kyi lag rjes la grub pa'i tshogs sbyor med pa'i phyir ro/ /de lhar

450rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pas las dang nyon mongs kyis lag rjes bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi phung bo gang yin pa thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te/ zhes gsungs so/ /thal 'gyur ba'i lugs la shes sgrib kyi zag pa dang bcas na'ang zag bcas su bzhed mod/ zag bcas thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin zhes pa'e zag bcas ni nyon mongs pa'e rgyu las byung ba'i nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la bya dgos so/ /de lta bas na rang rgyu nyon mongs pa las byung ba'i nyon mongs nga 'i zag bcas yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas khyab pa/ snyigs ma'i dus kyi paṇa chen saṃ gha'i zhabs yab sras kyis zhal gyis bzhes pa la yang dag pa'i lung rigs kyi gnod byed sna gcig kyang kun gsal yangs pa'i me tog gi tshal du nyal na mang du rnyed nga 'i skabs ga la srid/ da ni nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab po zhes bdag gi pha bla ma yab sras kyis gsung ngag rnam par dag pa seṅge'i nga ro ci yang bsgrags pa la lung dang rigs pa rnam par dag pa 'i sgrub byed nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye ba lta bu las phyogs tsam brjod pa la chas pas/ rtog ge ba dag sems rnal du zhog la nyon cig dang / bshad par bya'o/ /de yang 'di ltar/ 'o skol gyi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bden pa smra ba des 'di skad du/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba/ zhes dang / 'du byed thams cad sdug bsngal lo/ / zhes dang / gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal lo / /zhes dang / mdor na nyer len gyi phung bo lnga sdug bsngal lo/ /nes dang / de ni gang ci tshor yang rung de ni 'dir sdug bsngal lo/ /

— — 451zhes dang / 'khor ba khab kyi rtse mo na/ /bde ba nam yang yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs te/ mdo'i tshig zur gyi 'du byed dang sdi rtag pa zhes gang gsungs pa de thams cad 'du byed dang mi rtag pa yin tshad la ni ma yin te/sa gsum brnyes pa 'phags pa thogs med kyis gtan la dbab pa bsdu bar/gang mi rtag pa de ni sdug bsngal ba'o/ /zhes bya ba ni rgyu lngas rig par bya ste/ yongs su 'dzin pa las kyang yin te/ 'du byed mi rtag pa rnams kyis gnas ngan len yongs su 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /chos nyid las kyang yi na te/ skye ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rjes su 'brel ba las spyang yin te/ sdug bsngal gsum dang rjes su 'brel ba nyid kyi phyir ro/ /rgyu las kyang yin te/ rmongs pa'i spyod pa'i rgyu nyid yin pa'i jir ro/ /mngon par zhen pa las kyang yin te/ phyin ci log tu dmigs pa'i gzhi nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes sdug bsngal gyi sa bon 'dzin pa dang / skye ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal brgyad po gang rung gi chos nyid can dang / sdug bsngal gsum ci rigs dang 'brel ba dang / rmongs pa'i spyod pa'i rgyu byed pa dang / jin ci log tu dmigs pa'i rkyen du gyur ba'i mi rtag pa thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin zhes gsungs tshul gcig dang / yang bsdu bar/ mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba gang yin pa de thams cad ni mi rtag pa nyid kyi phyir sdug bsngal ba yin nam zhe na/ mi rtag pa nyid kyi phyir sdug bsngal ba yang yod/ rang bzhin gyis sdug bsngal ba yang yod de/ 'du byed gang dag 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid kyis sdug bsngal ba de dag ni mi rtag pa nyid kyi phyir sdug bsngal ba yin no/ /gang

452 dag sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid kyis sdug bsngal ba de dag ni rang bzhin gyis sdug bsngal ba yin te/sku gnod pa'i bdag nyid yin pa dang sdug bsngal bar ga nas pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes rang gi ngo bo mi rtag pa de 'gyur nas sdug bsngal dngos su 'dren pa rnams sdug bsngal bar gsungs tshul gcig dang / kun btus las/sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ sdug bsngal nyid gsum dang / sdug bsngal rnam pa brgyad ni sdug bsngal zhes bya ba'o/ /ci'i phyir gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal zhes gsungs she na/ mi rtag pa nyid ni gnyis kyi char gtogs pa ste/ skye ba'i char gtogs pa dang / 'jig pa'i char gtogs pa'o/ /skye ba'i char gtogs pa'i mi rtag pa nyid la brten nas sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid rab tu shes so/ /'jig pa'i char gtogs pa'i mi rtag pa nyid la brten nas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nyid rab tu shes so/ /de gnyi ga'i char gtogs pa'i mi rtag pa nyid la brten nas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid rab tu shes so/ /de la dgongs te bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ngas 'du byed mi rtag pa nyid dang / — 'du byed 'gyur babyunyid la dgongs nas/ gang ci tshor yang rung 'di ni 'dir sdug bsngal du gsungs so/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /yang skye ba dang 'jig pa'i chos nyid dang rjes su 'brel ba'i 'du byed rnams la skye ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal brgyad mngon te/ de'i phyir sdug bsngal zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / sa bzang pas/ ci'i phyir mdo las gang mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal du gsungs she na/zhes pa nas/ de'i phyir mi rtag pa de sdug bsngal zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang /

ma ba sna//༷/()red mda' bas/ sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid ni sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal nyid la sogs pa gsum dang / zhes pa nas/ de tsam la dgongs nas mi rtag pa la sdug bsngal du gsungs/ zhes dang / rgyul tshab thams cad mkhyen pas/ dri ba ni ci'i phyir zhes so/ /mdo las mi rtag pa sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid du gsungs pa dang 'gal lo/ /zhes pa nas/ de la dgongs nas gang mi rtag pa thams cad sdug bsngal zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs ba ltar sdug bsngal gsum po ci rigs sam brgyad po ci rigs dang 'brel ba dang / de ci rigs gsal ba'i mi rtag pa thams cad sdug bsngal bar gsungs ba'i tshul gcig dang / bzhi brgya ba las/ mi rtag pa la res bar gnod/ /gang la gnod yod de bde min/ /de phyir mi rtag gang yin de/ /thams cad sdug bsngal zhes byar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / zla ba'i zhabs kyis/ gang phyir 'dus byas gang de kun/ /mi rtag nyid kyis 'dir gnod pa/ /de phyir byas pa thams cad ni/ /sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig 'o nar 'gyur/ /zhes dngos brgyud ci rigs nas lus sems la gnod phu can gyi mi rtag pa thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du gsungs te/ 'di'i tshig zur gyi gnod pa yang / bzhi brgya ba'i zla 'grel las/ sdug bsngal ni gnod pa'i mtshan nyid can yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa ltar go dgos pa/ 'du byed thams cad ni dngos dang brgyad pas de skyed pa'i ciganas ngan len dang bcas pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bshad tshul gcig dang /mchims mdzod las/ gal te mi rtag pa nyid kyis 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin na ni lam bden yang sdug bsngal du 'gyur ro zhe na/ ma yin te/ lam

————pho/5dze/ ———— ni sdug bsngal thams cad 'gags pa'i bde ba 'dren pa'i rgyu zag med yin pa'i phyir 'phags pa dang mthun pas sdug bsngal du mi brjod de/ sdug bsngal gyi don ni zag bcas gang zhig mi rtag cing 'phags pa dang mi mthun pas gnod pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes zag bcas gang mi rtag pa thams cad sdug bsngal du bshad tshul gcig sto du ma yod pa'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang nyer len gyi phung bo lnga sdug bsngal du gsungs ba'i don la/ bsdu bar/ tha ma mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga sdug bsngal ba zhes bya ba gcig pus ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to/ /zhes nyer len gyi phung bo la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab par bkral ba dang /nyan sa las/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni nye bar len pa'i phung bo rnams la thams cad du 'gro ba yin te/ zhes dang / phung bo gang mi rtag pa 'byung ba dang / zhes pa nas/ de ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rnam par bzhag pa yen no/ /zhes dang / bsdu ba las/ de la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid gang zhe na/ yang 'byung ba'i las dang nyon mongs pas bskyed pa'i 'du byed rnams kyi/ zhes pa nas/ de ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yin no/ /zhes dang / tha ma mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga sdug bsnga la ba zhes bya ba gcig pus ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to/ /zhes dang / rnam pa gang gis 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid bsdus she na/ smras pa/ grub pa dang bde ba med pa'i rnam pas so/ /zhes dang /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid de'i dbang du mjod nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lngabyubo dag sdug bsngal ba/ zhes

— — rī — — — — 455pa gsungs te/ zhes dang / kun btus las/ ji ltar na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin/ zhes pa nas/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du blta'o/ /zhes dang / mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga sdug bsngal lo zhes gang gsungs pa 'dis ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid yongs su bstan to/ /zhes dang / kun btus rgyal sras ma las/ mi rtag pas rjes su bcings pas grub pa dang bde ba ma yin pa'i phyir 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang / kun 'grel shes bya rab gsal snang ba las/ zag bcas tham/sa cad la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal nyid du blta'o/ /zhes dang / kun 'grel legs bshad rgya mtsho las zag pa dang bcas pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms gzhi dang bcas pa rnams 'du byed skyo sdug bsngal nyid du rig par bya'o/ /zhes dang / mdzod rtsa bar/sdug bsngal nyid gsum ldan pa'i phyir/ /ci rigs ma lusna sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes pa'i thad kyi 'grel ba 'grel bshad rnams las spyange de ltar 'byung ba dang / la ma rica/ las/ lha mi'i go 'phang thob kyang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal las ma 'das/ zhes dang / mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga sdug bsngal/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ zhes pa nas/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du gyur ba ste/ zhes dang / nyer len gyi phung bo grub tsam gyis 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du skye/ zhes dang / las dang nyon mongs pa snga ma'i gzhan gyi dbang du gyur ba'i 'du byed thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni sdug bsngal thams cad la khyab pa dang / zhes dang / gnas

44///rdo/rdo — — — ————— — — —————rwa ngan len rjes su 'brel bas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes dang /— gser 'phreng las/ 'du byed kyi sdugani bsngal gyis khyab pas sdug bsngal ba dang / zhes sogs 'phags bod kyi sde snod rgya mtsho lta bu las nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas thams cad la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab par— gsungs so/ /gzhan yang / bzhi brgya ba'i dar ṭīka las/ khyab pa 'dzu byed kyi sdug bsngal bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ gal te lus mi rtag pa yin mod kyi bde ba yod do zhe na/ min te/ rnam smin gyi lus la sogs pa gang mi rtag pa la 'jig byed kyis nges par gnod pas yid 'byung bar byed la / rigang la yid 'byung skye ba'i mtshan nyid can gyi gnod pa yod pa de bde ba — min pas/ de'i phyir zag pa dang bcas pa'i mi rtag pa gang yin pa thams cad sdug bsngal zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / rnam bshad snying bo'i rgyan las/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal chos can/ sdug bsngal ba yin te/ las nyon spyo gzhan dbang can yen pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / sde bdun rgyan las kyang / de chos can/ gzhan dbang can yin te/ las nyon gyis 'dus byas pa yin pa'i phyi ra/ zhes las nyon gyis 'du byas pa le sdug bsngal ba dang gzhan dbang can gyis khyab par gsungs pa dang / de ji bzhin du rnam 'grel thar lam gsal byed/ kun btus chos mngon rgya mtsho/ phar phyin dang tshad ma'i lam bsgrigs/ tshad ma'i brjed byang sogs las kyang sdug bsngal ba'i sgrub byed la las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin pa bkod cing / de nyid khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid bye— lem rim dang / sde bdun tshen mos grub pa'i phyir dang / rgyal tshab rje 'i rnam

'a 44 khyo1〉rte —'grel dang phar phyin ṭīk+ka gnyis kar las dang nyon mongs kyi lag rjes/ su bzhag pa'i zag bcas kyi phung bo yin pa thams cad 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal te/ zhes dang / sde bdun rgyan las/ phung bo gang las dang nyon mongs ba'i gzhan dbang can yin pa ni 'du byed kyi phung bo'i don ldog yin la/zhes dang / spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis/ phyi nang gi dngos bo la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zer/ zhes dang / kun mkhyen bla ma'i dbu ma'i mtha' dpyod las/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal ba zhes khas len dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / mdzod mtha' dpyod las/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo chos can/ sdug bsngal ba zhes brjod de/ sdug bsngal gsum ci rigs dang ldan pa'i sdug bsngal ba'i phung bo yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / rje ngag dbang byams pas/ srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar gyi snod bcud thams cad la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis dper na sha la khrag 'dres pri bzhin du dbyer med du khyab pas na khyab pa/ zhes gsungs pa'i don dang mthun par/ kun mkhyen dbyig gi gnyen po dang / slob dpon seng ge bzang bo la sogs pa'i sku'i phreng bar rgyal ba'i bstan pa gzugs can bzhin du phrag par bzhes pa/ bdag cag gi pha gcig gyidage 'dun bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos lam khrid chen mor nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas thams cad la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab po zhes bya ba'i bden gsung mi slu ba'i dbyangs su mdzad pa la/ bdag gi tshe rabs kyi phreng bar me tog phog pa'i lha skal/ snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa/ blo bzang dpal ba'i zhal snga nas las go/zhan/ srol dri ma med pa de nyid gzhung btsugs nas —

4tsaskye d+ku'adzin pa su zhig byung / zhes bya ba ni/ ji skad du/ bde gshegs bstan pa rab tu 'jig byed pa/ /bdud kyi gnyen gyur dge sbyor mang bo dag /rnyed phyir dam pa'i spyod pa rnam spangs nas/ /phrag dog me yis rang rgyud 'bar byas te/ /zhes gsungs ba'i 'u nga bstan steng du babs nas bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma yab sras kyi legs bshad kyi rgyab dpung ma mthong ba dag la lung gi sgrub byed mdo tsam bstan pa ste/ lung drangs so cog la zhib 'grel dang bcas bshad na sngon ma byung ba'i legs bshad kyi gter chen po zhig 'byung na'ang mig gi khur la 'jigs nas ma spros so/ /gzhan yang / nyon mongs kyi zag bcas yin na 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin phas khyab par thal/ de yin na las nyon gyi gzhan dbang can yin pas khyab ba'i phyir dang / nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal skyed pa'i gnas ngan len dang ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / sdug bsngal gsum ci rigs dang ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal 'du byed pa'i nus ba dang bcas pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / 'jig byed kyi gnyen po'i gnod pa dang bcas bas khyab pa'i phyir dang / sdug bsngal gyi gnod pa skyed pa'i sa bon dang bcas pas khyab ba'i phyir dang / zag bcas mi rtag pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / 'phags pa rnams dang mi mthun pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / dmigs rkyen byed ba'i sgo nas zag pa rgyas rung gi nus pa dang bcas pas khyab pa'i phyir dang / sdug bsngal gsum mam sdug bsngal brgyad ci rigs dang 'brel ba'i zag bcas kyis khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /rtag khyab re re nas grub ste/ gong du drangs pa'i lung rnams re re

459 nas dpyad gsum gyis dag pa'i lung yin pa gang zhig de dag gis grub pa'i phyir zhes bya ba ni sgrub byed kyi rigs pa rgya mtsho lta bu las phyogs tsam ngag tshig nyung ngus mtshon par byas pa ste/ rtog ge spyi lugs kyis thal phyir gyi spros ba brdal na ha cang mang bar 'gyur ro/ /kho na re/ nyon mongs pa'i zag bcas la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis ma khyab ste/ nyan sa las/r+ṣa mi nga mdor bsdu na sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal gang yin pa dang / kun nas nyo na mongs pas yongs su zin pa'i 'gyur ba'e sdug bsngal gang yin pa dang / de ba'i tshor ba rten dang bcas pas yongs su zin pa'i 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gang yin pa de dag ma gtogs pa de las gzhan pa'i phung bo sdug bsngal yang ma yin bde ba yang ma yin pa di dang ldan pa de las nges bar skyes pa/ de 'byung ba'i rkyen du rgyur ba/ de byung ba gnas pa'i gzhi gang yim pa de dag ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal zhes bya ste/ zhes sdug bsngal dang po gnyis la ma gtogs pa'i zag bcas rnams 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal tu gsungs pa'i phyir na/ de ni mchims gyi mdzod ṭīka las/ gnyis po di las gzhan pa'i 'du byed zag bcas rnams ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal kho nas bsdus ba yin te/ zhes sngar sgra bshad kyi skabs su'ang drangs zin pa ltar/ sdug bsngal gsum du phye ba'i 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal dang po gnyis mu mi gtogs pa zhig dgos pa'i don yin gyi/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal dang po gnyis dang bcas pa 'jog dgos pa/ nyan sa rang las/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni nye bar len pa'i phung bo rnams la thams cad du 'gro ba yan te/ zhes dang / phung bo gang

460dag mi rtag pa 'byung ba dang / zhes pa nas/ rang gis dbang bsgyur ba med pa de dag ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal zhes bya ste/ zhes sogs gong du drangs pa dang / gzhan rgya bod kyi gzhung chen mo'i lung drang zin pa de dag gis grub cing / de yang nyan sa kho na la ma yin kyi gzhung chen mo gang du skabs nam du ya nga 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal dang po gnyis mi 'jog par sa/sungs ba ltar snang ba gang yin pa'i don de ltar bkral bar bya'o/ /yang kho na re/ zag bcas thams cad sdug bsngal du bshad pa mi 'thad de/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin na sdug bden phra mo yim/ pas khyab pa'i phyir te/ lag mthil spu nyag gcig 'dug pa / /mi rnams kyis ni mi rtogs la/ /de nyid mig tu song na ni/ /mi dga' ba dang gnod skyed ltar/ /byis pa lag mthil 'dra ba yis/ /'du byed sdug bsngal spu mi rtogs/ /'phags pa mig dang 'dra ba ni/ /de yis shin tu yid kyang 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/ de ni sdug bsngal dang po gnyis mngon sum du rtogs pa'i so skye yod la zag bcas 'du byed rnams sdug bsngal bar mngon sum du rtogs pa 'phags pa las glu med pa'i don las/ gzhan du na/ so skye la 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal mi rtogs pas khyab par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zag bcas thams/ cad 'du byed kyitresdug bsngal yin yang de dang de rtogs tsam gyis de de'i sdug bsngal bar rtogs mi dgos te/ bum pa sgyu ma lta bu yin yang bum pa sgyu ma lta bur rtogs pa rten 'brel phra mo ma rtogs par mi yong ba'i phyir ro/ /kho na re/gong du khyab pa'i go don bshad pa mi 'thad de/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug

461bsngal yin na sdug bsngal thams cad la khyab bas ma khyab pa'i phyir zer na/ —'o na khyod rang la/ tshor sogs kun 'gror btsod pa mi 'thad par thal/tshor ba yin na sems kun gyi 'khor du 'gro bas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ de bzhin du/ shes bya ni yod pa thams cad la khyab byed ma yin par thal/ shes bya yin na yod pa thams cad la khyab pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ khyab pa 'grigs/ sgra bshad la khyab pa rtsi ba ni mtshan nyid pa'i rkang 'dren mthar thug pa ste/ 'di la ji skad du/ spyi khyab nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor dang / /sgos khyab rtsig pa'i bu ga gnyis/ /mtshungs bar rlom pa'ang mkhas yin na/ /'di na mi mkhas su zhig yin/ /zhes gsungs ba'i bka' rdo rje'i thog kyang thod du 'bab pa yin no/ /des na dam pa dag nyo na mongs skye gnas 'phel ba'i sa bon tsam khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal du gsungs pa dang / chags sdang gnyis las gzhan gti mug skyed pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms kho na khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la bzhag nas khyab tshul yang sna tshogs shig gsungs pa ni/ mtshan gzhi re'i steng nas nyam/sa myong la dpags pa'i gsungs tshul go rgyu can re las zhib bshad kyis 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la khyab pa 'dzin pa'i dbarnga du byas na song ma thag pa'i lung rib/sa kyi gnod byed de dag 'bab par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /mdor na zag bcas kyi snod bcud thams cad la khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis khyab po zhes zhe la bcags nas sa sdes mtshon pa'i rgya bod kyi snga phyi'i gzhung tshe ba dag la lta shes pa'i sgo nas ltos dang nges pa rngams chen 'drong bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar sdug bsngal gsum dang / khyad par 'du

462byed kyi sdug bsngal la rgya cher rnam par dpyad pa de yang / dpal ldan zla bas/ bstan bcos las dpyad rtsod la chags pa'i phyir/ /ma mdzad rnam grol phyir ni de nyid bstan/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rtsod pa 'ba' zhig gi phyir ni ma yin gyi/ gtso bo ni thar ba don du gnyer ba dag gis nges 'byung gi bsam pa sha thag pa nas bskyed de rnam par grol pa'i go 'phang phun sum tshogs pa'i grong du bde blag nyid du 'dzegs pa'i ched du byas pa yin no/ /de'i phyir 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa la sdug bsngal dang bo gnyis kyang bsam dgos mod/ bye brag khyab pa'i 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsams nas skyo bar bya dgos te/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal la yid 'byung ba tsam dud 'gro la'ang yod/ zag bcas kyi bde ba la yid 'byung ba tsam phyi rol ba la'ang yod pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du rgyal ba 'jam dpal snying bos/gnas dben par lus drang bor bsrangs nas blo nang du phyogs te legs par bsams pa'i tshe/ zhes pa nas/ des na shing bzo mkhas pa'i 'degs bzhin du dmigs pa gzhan ma gcig gi gnad dam sa gcig nas bsgoms na byin g.yos yongs yod pa de gang yin/ zhes bsam gtan pa dag la bka' mchid gnang bar/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pas/ shing bzo mkhas pa'i 'phrul 'degs 'dra'i/ /thar 'dod shugs drag skyed pa'i thabs/ /rgyal tshab dam pas gsungs pa bzhin/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyis kyang / /sdug bden nyes dmigs ma bsams na/ /thar 'dod ji bzhin mi skye gsu ngas/ /'khor ba'i nyes brgya sems pa'i tshul/ /mang ya/nga sdug bsngal sdug bsngal gyis/ /'jigs nas thar

6 dzha 463'dod phyugs la'ang yod/ /zag bcas tshor ba bde ba las/ /yid 'byung phyi rol pa la'ang mchis/ /des na 'du byed rang bzhin gyi/ /zag bcas nyer len phung bo 'di/ /sdug bsngal 'grub dang grub pa'i snod/ /nad dang 'bras dang zug rdzu ltar/ /dmigs nas bsgoms na byin g.yo lags/ /zhes rje'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i lan phul cing /de nyid rnam 'grel gyi don yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ 'du byed sdug bsngal la dgongs nas/ /sdug bsngal bsgom par gsungs pa yin / /zhes dang / de'i dar ṭīka las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sdug bsngal bsgom par gsungs pa ji ltar yin zhe na/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal tsam la dgongs nas gsungs pa ma yin te/ srid pa mtha' dag gis yid 'byung ba'i ched du khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la dgongs nas sdug bsngal bsgom par gsungs pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / ṭīka chen las/bcom ldan 'das kyis sdug bsngal bsgom par gsungs bas khyed rang gi ston pa'i lung dang 'gal lo zhe na/ tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal tsam zhig bsgom par gsungs pa ma yin gyi/ 'a du byed sdug bsngal la dgongs nasasdug bsngal bsgom par gsungs pa yin la/ nged kyi 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal de yang khyod 'dod pa ltar bdag rtag pa la brten pa ma yin te/rang rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa'i rkyen las skyes pa'i phyir/ zhes dang /thog mar phung bo 'de nyid skye ba dang na ba dang rga ba dang 'chi ba la sogs pas yongs su 'gyur ba'i rags pa'i mi rtag pa ming la bya zhing / de ltar yid la byas te skyo bar 'gyur ba'i myong ba skyes pa na skad cig re re zheng chu'i

4/41kyisna/ — —— — rba rlabs ltar g.yo ba'i phra ba'i mi rtag pa dang / de yang las dang nyon mongs ba'i gzhan dbang can gyi ngang tshul las ma 'das pa ste/ chos gnyis po 'dir yid la byas pas nam gyi tshe goms pa khyad par du gyur ba na/ chos gnyis po 'di gang la yod pa'i phung bo thams cad yod brtan du rung ba'i bde bar 'dzin pa'i blo bor nas yid brtan mi rung ba'e sdug bsngal gyi phung bor nges te 'bral bar 'dod pa'i blo bcos ma ma yin pa skye bar 'gyur bas chos gnyis po 'di dang ldan pa'i kham/sa gong ma'i lha'i bsam gtan gyi bde ba dag kyang me'i 'obs dang 'dra bar rtogs nas 'khor ba la dga' ba'i blo ming gi lhag ma tsam du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de'i phyir 'khor ba spyi la 'bral 'dod kyi blo bcos ma min pa skye ba la ni phra ba'i mi rtag pa dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal sgom pa nges par dbo/sa kyi/ sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal sgom pa tsam zhig gis ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sogs la yid 'byung pa tsam skyed par nus pas phyi ma lha mi'i go 'phang thorkadhe phyir du dge sdig la blang dor byed pa tsam 'byung yang / sdug bsngal gyi sdug— bsngal mngon gyur nye bar zhi ba'o lha'i bde ba lta bu la yid 'byung skye mi srid do/ /zhes dang / sde bdun chen mor/ dang bor 'khor ba la yid 'byung nas 'bral bar 'dod pa'i blo mtshan nyid pa gcig ma skyes na thar ba la thob 'dod mi skye zhing / de ma skyes na thar lam la slob par mi 'gyur bas/ zhes pa nas/ de bas na 'khor ba spyi la yid 'byung sha thag pa nas skye ba la ni 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid legs par rtogs dgos pas nyer len gyi phung bo 'di nyid sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin —du bsgom dgos pa yin po

tre ge — —— — —pa—— — — — —— 46byino / / zhes gsungs pa ltar 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsgom pa gal che zhing nyams su len ṅge'i tshe na'ang sdug bsngal dang po gnyis ji skad bstan pa ltar bsam thar bya zhing / 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal ni chos mngon pa'i mdo las byung ba ltar zag bcas sogs lnga dang / bsdu ba las byung ba ltar mngon par 'grub pa'i sdug bsngal gyi snod du gyur ba sogs lnga dang / sdug bsngal gyi sa bon 'dzin pa sogs lnga dang / khyad par du bsdu pa las/ de ni yang dag par sdug bsngal gyi bden pa'i dngos bo yin te/ 'phags pa 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis de gzigs pa rnams ni srid pa'i rtse mo ba'i phung bo mchog tu rab tu zhi ba dag la yang dga' ba mi 'thob na shin tu deman ba dag la lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes dang / mdzod rang 'grel las/ gang gi tshe 'di dag la bde ba yang yod pa de'i tshe ci'i phyir sdug bsngal— kho na 'phags pa'i bden pa zhes bya zhe na/ kha cig na re/ ba de ba myong ba'i phyir te/ mon sran de'u la sogasabyupa yod bzhin du mon sran gre'u rbe phung bo zhes ston pa bzhin te/ mkhas pa su zhig chus btab pa'i bde ba chung ngus 'bras bu bde ba yin no snyam du sems par 'gyur/ zhes gosu ngas pa ltar 'phags pa rnams kyis gzigs pa dang mi mthun pa'i tshul dang / bde 'gro ba dag kyang / rgya mtsho'i klong du nub la khad pa'i ded dpon dang / klung chen pos dbang med du khyer ba'i byis pa dang / yan lag bcings te g.yang chen po la 'phen pa'i skyes bu dang / pha rol gyis gsod par nges ba'i dmag dpon dang / zas kyis brid nas gcong du 'phen la khad pa'i khyim bdag dang / rgyal srid nyams pa la mngon du phyogs

44//rdo 49) — pa pa'i rgyal bo dang / gshed mas gsod pa la mngon du phyogs pa'i btson ma bzhin du 'du byed kyi gzhan dbang du gyur pa dang 'du byed nyid la sdug bsngal skyed pa'i nus pa 'bral mi rung du yod pa'i mtha' ngan pa'i tshul bsam/sa nas tshangs pa'i bde ba dang mnar med kyi sdug bsngal gnyis la 'jigs skrag 'byung ba la khyad par med pa'i myong ba 'don pa la 'bad dgos so/ /de ltar 'bad na ji skad du/ sdug bsngal gyi ni rgyu phyir dang / /sdug bsngal mang bos skyed phyir dang / /sdug bsngal yod na bde 'dod phyir/ /bde ba sdug bsngal zhes rtog go /zhes dang / bzhi brgya ba las/ mkhas pa rnams la mtho ris kyang / /dmyal ba dang mtshungs 'jigs skyed 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa lta bu'i myong ba rtsol ba med par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar skyon med pa'i lung dang rigs pa bgrang bar mi spobs pa dag gis grub na'ang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ rmongs pa'i 'gro ba 'ga' zhig ni/ /tshes kyi de nyid ma rtogs par/ /log pa'i chos kyis rab mgu ba/ /blun po nor bu len pa bzhin/ /zhes dang / legs bshad rin po che'i gter las/ cho ga log par sgrub pa 'ga'/ / yang dag cho ga byed la gshe/ /skyes bu khyi yi mge can rnams/ /bzhin bzang bud med yin zhes brnyas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar log pa'i chos la nor bur 'khrul nas mching bu len pa bzhin shin tu rmongs pa rnams legs pa dang nyes par bshad pa la rang nyid mun nag 'dom 'jal las ma byung ya nga / gzhung gang la'ang rtog pa hol tsam bcug nas kha zin sna zin re 'ol nges byung tshe rang gi skyon things pa la dmod pa bor pa bzhin du kun

467gyis zhe khrel dang 'phya ba'i gnas su byed pa mang du byung ste/ rje rol ba'i rdo rjes/ phyogs re'i gzhung la 'chal bor sbyangs ba dang / /drang nges 'byed pa'i blo yi mthu bral yang / /yin min mgo ltag 'byed pa'i khur len pa/ /de dag mi smra gyur na cis mi legs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phyogs re'i mig can gyi rgol ba ngan pa dag dgun dus kyi khu byug gi ngang tshul la gnas na rang gzhan la rma 'byin par mi 'gyur ro//smras pa/ sku yi phring bar goms pa'i yon tan rdogs/ /tshosas dbus zla ltar g.yo ba'i grags snyan dbyadwas/ /dbyāngs kyi rgyal mo'i snyan pa'i ba dan bzhun/ /bzhin bzang phyogs kyi bu mo'i mthar g.yo ba/ /bdag gi 'dren pa sras bcas rgyal ba'i tog /rtsen pa'i thal ngag bzod pa'i dpung ba can/ /rigar+sā pa smra ba gang zhig rgyal ba yi/ /kun gzigs tshad ma'i longs su spyad bya min/ /lung rigs tsha ba'i zer phreng rgod pa'i gzis/ /rgyu skar zil gyis gnon la chu sgrog mig /shar ba'i mdzes sdug ma theg nyin mor 'jigs/ /bstan la ltas ngan hūṃ sgra rna bar gzan/ /de lta na yang me zhal lam gyi nor/ /rtse dga'i ri bo'i zur phud—las 'dzum nas/ /bla med 'od kyi dga' ston spyo ba la/ /ser skya'i mig can rnams kyis ci byar yod/ /mun pa'i khung bur log pa'i phud sgra can/ /gdug pa'i lce gnyis rgyong ba mtshams byos shig /lung rigs 'dab zung rdzogs pa'i khyung chen zhig /lho rgyud ri bo'i sul na bag yangs rgyu / /'on kyang col chung sngangs pa'i mig skya yi/ /bung ba kem kem g.yo rnams/ bag phebs shig /smra ba sto bas su rdzogs pas gzhom bya ni/ /

468mkhas las rmongs pa'i bran du bkol rnams min/ /gang gi dgag sgrub be con 'bar ba'i shugs/ /gang la babs pa rgol ba'i lhug phran ma/ /gang zhig srog gi rtsa chen 'dar ba'i mod/ /gang tshe thod pa'i me tog cis mi 'thor/ /de lta bu ni khengs gtam dri za'i nga ro nyams mtshar du glur blangs pa'o//gnyis pa zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo la log par rtog pa dgag pa'i sgo nasru smra ba ngan pa tshar gcod pa ni/ phyis kyi cal 'drogs pa kha cig na re/ zag bcas kyi phung bo la nyer len gyi phung bos ma khyab ste/ phar phyin skabs dang bo'i yig cha las/ de la kho na re/ de chos can/ nyer len gyi phung bo yin par thal/ sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ rnam 'grel las/ sdug bsngal 'khor ba can phung bo/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na shin tu ma khyab ste/ sdug bden la snod bcud gnyis yod kyang yid 'byung ba'i ched du nyer len gyi phung por bshad pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / de dang mthun par sde bdun yid kyi mun sel las/ sdug bsngal bden pa la ma dag pa'i rnod bcud kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag gis bsdus pa'i sgo nas mtshan gzhi rgya cher bshad du yod mod kyang / zhes sogs gsungs pa dang /gzhan yang / yig char/ ma dag pa'i snod phyi dang nyer len gyi phung bo nang gi sdug bden du bshad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ zhes sdug bden la nyer len gyi phung bos ma khyab par gsungs pa'i phyir dang / nyer len gyi phung po la rgyud kyis bsdus pa zhig dgos pa lam rim gyi skabs du mas shes pa'i phyir dang / nyer len gyi phung po yin na skyes bu'i las nyon gyi nye bar

— 46spre blang bya yin dgos bas na nyer len gyi phung bo zhes brjod pa yin pa'i phyir/zhes cal gyi rang bzhin ma shes pa'i smra ba 'dzer to/ /de la kho bo cag gis 'di skad ces dbugs dbyung bar bya ste/ phar phyin yig char de ltar gsungs pa kun mkhyen bla ma'i bzhed pa mthar thug min pa 'god par 'gyur ba'i shes byed dag gis rtogs la/ khyed cag gi 'grel tshul ltar na/sde bdun chen mo las/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud sa/nyis las logs su nyer len gyi phung bo 'jog par bzhed dgos na/ de ltar ma yin te/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud gang rung ma yin pa'i nyer len gyi phung po med pa'i phyir/gzhan du na/ yig char ma dag pa'i snod phyi dang nyer len gyi phung bo nang gi sdug bden du bshad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa 'brel med par thal/ ma dag pa'i 'jig rten phyi snod kyi sdug bden dang nyer len gyi phung po nang bcud kyi sdug bden ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ma dag pa'i nyer len kyi phung po la snod bcud gang rung ma yin dgos pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ de bas na sdug bden gyi mtshan gzhi mang yang ming gi steng nas yid 'gyu nga lhag par skye ba'i nyams len gyi gnad yod pas nyer len gyi phung po zhes mtshan gzhir bzung ba yin par sngar yang bshad pa ltar yin no/ /lam rim sogs gzhung chen mo du mar nyer len gyi phung bo la rgyud kyis bsdus pa lta bu gsungs pa ni res skabs der rgyud skyus bsdus pa gzhir bzhag dang / res 'gar yid 'byung skye ba'i gnas kyi gtso bo rgyud kyi nyer len gyi phung po ngos bzung ba tsam yin pa'i phyir dang / nyer len gyi phung po zhes pa skyes bus las nyen gyis blang bya'i char btags pa min te/

sna rdoṇi() — — skyes bu rang dang de'i las nyon gnyis kyang nyer len gyi phung po yen yang skabs de'i nye bar blang byar mi 'jog pa'i phyir te/ skyes bu nye bar len pa po/ nyer len nyid nye bar len byed/ rnam smin gyi phung po nye bar blang bya yin pa'i phyir dang / skabs de'i nyer len gyi phung po yin na skyes bu de la ltos te nye bar blang bya yin pas khyab na/ rtsa she'i rab byed bcu ba dang nyer bdun par blang bya dang len byed gcig tu thal bar gsungs ba rnams kyang khas len dgos bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na zag bcas kyi phung po la nyer len gyi phung pos khyab par 'dod pa la gnod byed med par ma zad sgrub byed kyi tshogs mang du yod do/ /ji ltar na/ 'di ltar/ mdo las/phung po dang / 'thab bcas dang / sdug bsngal dang / kun 'byung dang / 'jig rten dang / lta gnas dang / srid pa/ zhes pa nas/ de dag ni zag bcas kyi ming gi rnam grangs so/ /zhes dang / chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ gang dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /phyang po 'ang de dag 'thab bcas kyang / /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'jig rterno dang / /lta gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin/ /zhes dang / de nyid kun mkhyen dbyig gnyen gyis mdzod rtsa bar bkod pa dang / mdzod rang 'grel las/phung po dag kho na yin la nye bar len pa'i phung bo ma yin pa dag kyang yod de/ 'du byed zag zhwa med pa rnams so/ /de la nye bar len pa dag ni nyon mongs pa rnaca/sa so/ /de dag las byung ba'i phyir nye bar len pa'i phung bo dag ste/ dper na rtswa dang sog ma'i me bzhin pa'am de dag la rag lus pa'i phyir rgyal bo'i mi bzhin no/ /yang na de dag las nye bar len pa

471rnams 'byung bas nye bar len pa'i phung bo rnams te me tog dang 'bras bu'ijishing ljon pa zhin no/ /zhes dang / rgyal sras ma las/ nye bar len pa las byung ba'i phung bo dag ni nye bar len pa'i phung bo dag ste/ zhes dang / sgo/nga spel las/ 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams kho na la nye bar len pa'i phung po'i ming gis btags te/ zhes pa nas/ de dag las byung ba'i phyir na nye bar len pa'i phung po dag go /zhes dang /mchims ṭīka chen mor/ 'dus byas gang dag zag bcas su bshad pa de dag ni nye bar len pa'i phung po'ang yin te/ nye bar len pa ni nyon mongs pa yin la de las byung bas na nye bar len pa'i phung po ste rtswa dang sog ma'i me bzhin no/ /zhes dang / de'i mchan las/ ya nga na nyer len la rag lus pas na nye bar len pa'i phung po ste rgyal bo la rag las pa'i mi rgyal bo'i mi zhes pa bzhin no/ /zhes dang / mchims ṭīka chung ba las/ nyer len ni nyon mongs pa yin la de las zag bcas kyi phung po byung ba'i phyir de skad du brjod do/ rtswa las byung ba'i me la rtswa'i me zhes pa lta bu'o/ /zhes dang / mdzod ṭīka thar lam gsal byed las/ zag bcas kyi phung po chos can/ nye bar len pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ nye bar len pa ni nyon mongs pa yin la/ de las byung ba'i phung po yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta las/ zag bcas kyi phung po lnga dag chos can/ nyer len gyi phung po zhes bya ste/ rang gi nyer len nyon mongs pa de dag las byung ba dang / de dag la rag las pa dang / di dag las nye brngo len pa nyon mongs pa rnam sa 'byung ba'i phyir/ zhes dang /

472sgo mang mdzod kyi yig char/ zag bcas kyi phung po chos can/ nyer len gyi phung po zhes bya ste/ nyer len ni nyon mongs yin la/ de las byung ba'i phyir/ zhes sogs/ rang re dge ldan pa'i mdzod kyi yig cha thams cad zhal mthun par ma zad/ gnad sgron sogari+ori mdzod kyi gzhung rgya bod du gang byung thams cad mthun par snang na yang tshig don ba/nyisarīka phal cher 'dra bas so so nas 'dren pa'i ngal ba ma byas so/ /de ltar gzhung de dag las zag bcas su gyur pa'i 'dus byas kyi phung bo mtha' dag nyer len gyi phung por bshad cing de la nyer len zhes rgyu mtshan mi 'dra ba gsum gyis btags jipa'i phyir byas pa la/ kho na re/ de ni bye brag smra ba'i lugs yin gyi/ gong ma'i lugs la zag bcas thams can nyer len gyi phung bo ma yin no zhes grub mtha'i khyad par gyi zhib cha byas pa skad du mjing ba bsrangs nas smra'o/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ gong ma'i lugs nye bar len pa la nyon mongs thams cad 'jog pa dang mi 'jog pa'i tshig zin gnyis snang ba ma gtogs sgra bshad tshul dang nyer len gyi phung bo la zag bcas thams cad 'jog pa la khyad par med de/ mkhan chen ngag dbang rab brtan gyis/ nye bar len pa ni 'dun pa dang 'dod chags te/ rim pa ltar ma 'ongs pa'i lus la dmigs nas thob 'dod da nga da ltar gyi lus la chags pa'o/ /de gnyis phung bo 'grub pa'i rgyu yin la/ de gnyis las byung ba'i phung po la nye bar len pa'i phung po zhes bya ste/ zhes pa nas/ zhes lugs 'di'i bla ma snga ma rnams kyis bshad pa'o/ /zhes sgra bshad tshul dang de dag las byung ba'i zag phung nye bar len pa'i phywang por 'jog pa mdzod ji

473 lta ba bzhin du gsu ngas pa dang / pha bla ma mchog gi lam khrid chen mor/mdzod 'grel laṅge/ sog ma'i me bzhin du nyer len nyon mo/ngas pa rnams las byung bas nyer len gyi phung po zhes rgyu ming 'bras bu la btags pa spyodang / yang na 'bras bu'i ljon shing bzhin du phung po las nyer len nyon mongs rnams 'byung bas nyer len gyi phung po zhes 'bras ming rgyu la btags par sa/sungs/ zhes mdzod ji lta ba bzhin nyer len gyi phung po'i sgra bshad pa ltar lam rim gyi zin bris tshad ldan rnams su nyer len gyi phung po'i don mdzod ltar gsungs pa las bshad pa zur ba zhig mdzad pa med pa'i phyir dang / zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i phung po lnga'i rab byed dbu ma'i gzhung las/ nye bar len pa ste nyon mongs pa dag las rab tu byung ba'i phyir nye bar len pa'i phung po ste rtswa da nga phub ma'i me zhes bya ba bzhin no/ /nye bar len pa la rag las pa nyid kyis kyang nye bar len pa'i phung po ste rgyal bo'i skyes bu bzhin no/ /nye bar len pa rnams de dag las byung ba nyid kyis nye bar len pa'i phung po ste/ me tog dang 'bras bu'i shing bzhin no/ /zhes nyer len gyi phung po'i don mdzod ltar gsungs pa dang / kun btus las/ci'i phyir nye bar len pa'i phung bo rnams zhes bya zhe na/ nye bar len pa dang ldan pas de'i phyir nye bar len pa'i phung po rnams zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / de'i rgyal sras ma las/ nye bar len pa ni 'dun pa dang 'dod chags te/ zhes pa nas/ de bas na 'di sanye ga yang nye bar len pa zhes bya'o/ /de la phung po bzhin du bshad do zhes bya ba ni nye bar len pa dang ldan pa ste/ de'i phyir nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams su rig

474 par bya'o/ /zhes dang / kun 'grel shes bya rab gsal snang ba las/nye bar len pa rnams dmigs byed dang mtshungs ldan du ldan pa'i phung po yin pas de'i phyir bar gyi tshig mi mngon par byas nas nye bar len pa'i phung po rnams zhes bya/ zhes dang / kun 'grel legs bshad rgya mtsho las/ 'og nas 'chad pa'i nye bar len pa dag dang ldan pa de'i phyir zag bcas kyi gzugs la sogs pa rnams la nye bar len pa'i phung po zhes bya ste/ba lang dang ldan pa'i shing rta la ba lang gi shing rta zhes pa bzhin no/ /ldan pa'i tshul ya nga nyer len gyi bdag nyid dang nyer len gyi rgyu las byung ba sogs sgo drug dang 'brel pa la bya ste/ zag pa'i rgyu las byung ba sogs la zag pa dang bcas pa zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /zhes dang / kun 'grel chos mngon rgya mtsho las/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po la nye bar len pa'i phung po zhes gdags pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ nye bar len pa dang ldan pas de ltar btagartsarga pa de'i phyir/ zhes nyer len mjod dang mi mthun par 'dod sred gnyis la bshad pa tsam ma gtogs rgyu ming 'bras dang 'bras ming rgyu dang grogs ming grogs can la btags pa sogs mdzod ltar bshad pa'i phyir ro byas pa la/ kho na re/ de dag gis gong ma'i lugs la rgyud kyis bsdus pa rnams nyer len gyi phung por 'dzog tshul mdzod ltar bshad dgos par 'grub kyang phyi'i zag bcas kyi phung po rnams nyer len gyi phung por mi 'grub po zhe na / drangs ma thag pa'i lung de dag gis kyang rgyud kyis bsdus ma bsdus kyi zag bcas thams cad nyer len gyi phung por 'grub bzhin snyon par byed na snyon pa dang lhan cig rtsod don med mod/ da dung brjod par bya ste/ phyi nang

— — sna 1rto(2gi zag bcas thams cad nyer len gyi phung po yin par thal/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul rnam par 'phrul ba'i mdo las/ nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga bo de dag nyid nye bar bzung ste/ sems can gyi 'jig rten dang snod kyi 'jig rten gdags pa lags so/ /zhes dang / chos mngon pa'i mdo sngar drangs pa las kyang zag bcas dang nyer len gyi phung po rnam grangs su gsungs pa dang / kun btus las/ ci'i phyir khams dang skye mched rnams nye ba ra len pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams zhes bya zhe na/ de la phung po bzhin du bshad do/ /zhes zag bcas kyi khams dang skye mched thams cad nyer len gyi phung bor gsungs pa dang / rigs pa drug cu ba'i zla 'grel las/ sdug bsngal zhes smras pa ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga rnaca/sa bsdus par mngon te/ 'dir sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung ba dang 'jig rten zhes bya ba la sogs pa ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga rnams kyi rnam grangs su bzhag pa'o/ /zhes sdug bsngal gyi bden pa dang / rang 'bras sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'i nus pa can dang / ma dag pa'i 'jig rten rnams ni nyer len gyi phung po'i rnam grangs su gsungs pa dang / de nyid las/ 'jig rten ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga rnams so/ /zhes ma dag pa'i 'jig rten dang nyer len gyi phung po don gcig tu gsungs pa dang / sngon gyi dkar chag chu thub pa rnams dang / khyad par kun mkhyen bu ston zhabs dang / rgyal tshab thanu/sa cad mkhyen pa sogs kyis zla ba'i zhabs kyis mdzad par bzhed pa'i phung po lnga'i rab byed dbu ma'i gzhung las/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung po ni nye bar len pa'i phung po'o/ /

44////41) —— zhes zag bcas kyi phung po thams cad nyer len gyi phung por gsungs pa dang / sa sde las/ sdug bsngal bden pa ni nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga bo 'bras bur gyur swā dag go /zhes sdug bden dang rang rgyu 'dir bstan nyer len gyi 'bras bur byung ba'i phung po gnyis don 'dra bar gsungs pa dang / kun btus rgyal sras ma las/ nye bar len pa dang bcas ba'i chos rnams zhes rig par bya'o/ /zhes rang rgyu 'dir bstan nye bar len pa las byung ba'i chos tharnga/sa cad nyer len gyi phung por gsungs pa dang / de nyid las/ mtha' dag gis bsdus pa zhes bya ba la/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po ni nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga bo dag gis bsdus so/ rī /zhes sdug bsngal ba'i phung bo rnams ni nyer len gyi phung por gsungs pa dang / phung bo lnga'i rab byed las/ nye par len pa'i phung pos bsdus pa du zhe na/ gang zag pa dang bcas pa rnams so/ /zhes dang / ma ti paṇa chen gyis/ ci'i phyir zag bcas kyi khams rnams dang skye mched rnams nye bar len pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams zhes bya zhe na/ zhes dris nas/ lan ni de la phung po'i skabs su bstan pa bzhin du 'dun pa dang 'dod chags gnyis gzugs can rnams la dmigs byed du ldan zheng lhag ma rnams la gnyi gar ya nga ldan pas nyer len dang bcas pa'o zhes mtshungs par bshad do/ /zhes zag bcas kyi khams skye mched thams cad nyer len gyi phung por gsungs pa dang / de nyid kyis/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po ni nyer len gyi phung po lnga char gyis bsdus pa dang / zhes nyer len gyi phung pos sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad bsdus par gsungs pa dang / kun

—— 4ṭī1btus red ṭīka las/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po ni nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga gas bsdus so/ /zhes sdug bden yin tshad nyer len gyi phung bor 'du bar gsungs pa dang / de nyid las/ zag bcas kyi gzugs la sogs pa rnams la nyer len gyi phung bo nes bya ste/ zhes dang / nye bar len pa dang ldan pa de'i phyir nye bar len pa'i khams rnams dang skye mched rnams zhes bya'o/ /zhes zag bcas kyi khams dang skye mched kyis bsdus ba'i gzugs la sogs pa thams cad nyer len gyi phung bor gsungs pa dang / de nyid las/ nye bar len pa dang ldan pa'i chos gsum gyis ni spang bya kun nas nyon mongs kyi phyogs ma lus par bsdus la/ zhes nyer len gyi phung po khams skye mched gsum gyis kun nyon phyogs thams cad bsdus par gsungs pa dang / rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ 'jig rten nyer len gyi phung po/zhes ma dag pa'i 'jig rten ril gyis nyer len gyi phung por gsungs pa dang / dka' gnad brgyad kyi zin bris las/ sdug bsngal yang nyer len gyi phung bo spyi'i rnam grangs su rnam par gzhag go /zhes dang / kun btus dar ṭīka las/ sdug bsnga la gyis bsdus pa'i khams dang skye mched la ya nga nyer len gyi khams dang skye mched ces bya ste/ phung po bzhin du bshad par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes sdug bden gyi chos la nyer len gyi khams skye mched gang rung gis khyab par gsungs pa dang / rigs pa drug cu ba'i dar ṭīka las/ 'jig rten nyi bar len pa'i phung po lnga gang lam rig pa rkyen du yod pas ma rig pa'i rkyen can du grub po/ /zhes ma rig pa'i rkyen las byung pa'i 'jig rten thams cad nyer len gyi phung por gsungs pa

478 — —dang / gong ma'i lugs la sdug bden gyi phung po la zag bcas kyi phung bo zer ba'i rgyu mtshan zag pa ste nyon mongs las byung ba'i phung po yin pas de ltar bshad pa bzhin du de dag nye bar len pa nyon mongs dang de'i gtso bo 'dod sred las byung ba'i phung bo yin pas sdug bden thams cad la nyer len gyi phung po zhes bshad pa yin ba/ thos pa'i sa'i bsdu ba las/ mdor na nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga sdug bsngal zhes gang gsungs pa de lda nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga'i rab tu dbye ba ni 'di lta ste/ yid kyi sa'i rnam par gtan la dbab par phung po la mkhas pa las brtsams te bstan pa bzhin du rig par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs la/ yid kyi sa'i gtan la dbab pa'i phung po la mkhas pa ston pa'i skabs su/ de la gzugs gang zhe na/ de ni rnam pa bcu gcig tu rig par bya ste/ mig la sogs pa reg bya'i mthar thug pa'i bar gyi skye mched bcu dang chos kyi skye mched du gtogs pa'i gzugs so/ /de yang mdor bsdu na 'byung ba dang 'byung ba las gyur pa ste/ thams cad kyang gzugs su rung ba'i mtshan nyid yin na/ zhes sogs kyis zag bcas kyi phung bor spyir bshad pa las rgyud kyis bsdus pa la dmigs kyis phye nas ma bshad pa'i phyir dang / gzhan du na khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal lari'ang rgyud kyis bsdus pas khyab par thal/ de ni nye bar len pa'i phung po kho na la 'jog dgos pa'i phyir te/ sa las/ nye bar len pa'i phung po ni 'du byed rnams zhes bya'o/ /don gyi skabs 'di ni nye bar len pa'i phung po rnams kho na la bya bar bzhed de/ zhes gsungs ba'i phyir ro/ /thub pa'i dgongs rgyan las/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i phung bo rnams nye

479bar len pa ste bdag tu 'dogs pa'i rgyu nyid kyi phyir ram/ yang na nyon mongs pa rnams ni de rnams las skyes pa nyid kyi phyir nye bar len pa rnams gzung bya'i phyir nye bar len pa rnams te de rnams las yang dag par byung bas nye bar len pa'i phung po rnams so/ /zhes zag bcas thams cad nyer len gyi phung bor gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na 'dir drangs pa dang ma drangs pa'i gzhung chen mo tshad mar 'os pa rnams su nyer len gyi phung bo bshad pa'i skabs su zag bcas spyir bshad kyi nang gi zag bcas la dmigs kyis bkong nas bshad pa skabs don dgos dbang re gnyis las med pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang mig dang rna ba dang sems med pa 'di dag la lung ci tsam drangs kyang dgos ba ci 'dra yod pa cha ma 'tshal to/ /de ltar lung gis sdug bden la nyer len gyi phung bos khyab par grub pa nyid du ma zad/ rigs pas kyang 'grub pa yin te/ 'di ltar/ khyed cag la/ shug bden la rgyud kyis bsdus bas khyab par thal/ mdor na nyer len gyi phung bo lnga sdug bsngal lo zhes nyer len gyi phung bo lnga kho na snug bden du gsungs ba'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ yang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal chos can/ khyod la rgyud kyis bsdus pas khyab par thal/ khyod la nye len gyi phung bo 'jog dgos pa gong du rgyas par bsgrubs pa ltar yin ba'i phyir/'khor gsum/ yang mi shi ba'i ro tshos can/ nyer9 len gyi phung bo ma yin par thal/ rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khyod rang gi khas blangs la song / 'dod na/ de tshos can/ sngar srid pa dang las las byung ba'i phung bo yin la phyis de dag las byung ba ma yin par gyur bar thal lo/ /
