480 ri'adod pa'i phyir/ yang de chos can/ sngar rang rgyu kun 'byung bden pa las byung ba yin la/ phyis de ma yin par gyur to zhes khas blangs pa la gnod byed med par thal/ mtshungs pa'i phyir/ yang / phyi snod kyi 'jig rten chos can/ nyer len gyi phung po yin par thal/ nye bar len pa 'dod sred las byung ba'e phung po yen pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i zag phung nyer len gyi phung por sgrub mi nus par 'gyur la/ rtags grub ste/ ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten ma rig pa dngacolas las byung la sred pa dang len pa las ma byung bar khas len mi rigs pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa las lan sted do/ /phyi snod kyi 'jig rten las nyon las byung bar shin tu 'grub ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ khams gsum 'di ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ 'jig rten ma rig rkyen can te // /zhes dang / zla ba'i zhabs kyis/ sems nyid kyis ni sems can 'jig rten dang / /snod kyi 'jig rten shin tu sna tshogs 'god/ /ces dang / mdzod las/ las las 'jig rten sna tshogs skye/ /zhes dang /slob dpon rgyal bo'i sras kyis/ ci sems can du bgrang ba gang dag yin pa de dag ni nyon mongs pas mngon par brlan pa'i las kyi rgyu can yin pa'i phyir nyer len gyi phung po yi na par rigs na phyi'i dngos po rnams ni ji ltar nye bar len pa'i phung po yin zhe na de dag kyang nye bar len pa las grub pa yin te/ zhes dang / mkhas pa blo bzang grags pas kyang de ji lta ba bzhin bsgrubs pa'i phyir ro/ /de dag sred pa las 'grub tshul/ gangs can gyi shing rta ba chen pos/ phung po la sogs pa zag bcas kyi dngos

481bo la spyi ril du sred pa ni srid sred yin no/ /zhes dang / sred pa rgyur med par las gang yang gsog pa mi srid pas nyon mo ngas sa/zhan la ltos nas sred pa las kun gyi thun mong ba'i rgyu yin pas de dag las tha/ tso bo ba yin no/ /de'i phyir thog mar las gsog pa'i tshe na'ang sred pa gasngo bo zhes bshad do/ /zhes dang / pha bla ma'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi las/ tsha ba don du gnyer ba'i sred len shugs drag skyes pa'i mjug thogs su dbugs kyi rgyu ba chad ma thag yang sos kyi bar do grub/ ces bka' stsal bas mtshon lung dang bstan bcos rnams su mang du 'byung 'i/nga / gzhan yang / nyer len te nyon mongs ba'i dbang gis byung ba'i phung po la rgyud kyis bsdus pas khyab pa med par ma zad/ rnam smin rnams de las byung la bdag 'bras rnams de las ma byung bar khasalen mi nus pa'i phyir dang / snod bcud kyi khyad par sred pas 'grub dges pa du mar gsungs pa'i phyir dang / phyi snod kyi 'jig rten 'phen byed las kyi bdag 'bras yin yang gsos 'debs byed kyi len pa'i 'bras bur khas mi len pa su zhig yod ces smras pa yin no/ /gong ma'i lugs la nyer len la 'jog tshul gnyis byung ba ni/ kun btus las/ nye bar len pa gang zhe na/ 'dir 'dun pa dang 'dod chags gang yin pa'o/ /ci'i phyir 'dun pa dang 'dod chags nyid nye bar len pa zhes bya zhe na/ ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar gyi phung po mngon par 'grub pa da nga / yongs su mi gtong ba'i phyir te ma 'ongs pa la 'dod pa dang / da ltar la lhag par chags pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes dang / rgyal srus ma las/ nye bar len pa ni 'dun pa dang 'dod chags te/ zhes dang /

482 kun 'grel sa bzang ma las/ nye bar len pa rang gi ngo bo gang zhe na/zhes pa nas/ 'dod cing don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa dang / lhag par chags pa'i 'dod chags gang yin pa'o/ /zhes dang / rje red mda' bas/ thob 'dod kyi 'dun pa dang / mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i 'dod chags gnyis la nye bar len pa zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / dar ṭīka las/ ma 'ongs pa'i zag bcas kyi phung bo la 'dun pa dang da lta ba la 'dod chags gang yin pa de nyid 'dir nyer len yin pa'i phyir/ zhes nyer len la 'dun pa'am 'dod pa dang chags pa gnyis 'jog pa dang /zla ba grags pas mdzad pa'i phung po lnga ba las/ nye bar len pa ste/ nyon mongs pa/ zhes dang / paṇa chen 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas/nyon mongs pa rnams ni de rnams las skyes pa nyid kyi phyir nye bar len pa rnams gzung bya'i phyirartsonye bar len pa rnams te/ zhes nyon mongs pa thams cad nye bar len pa la 'jog par gsungs shing de yang gtso phal gyi khyad yin pa bshad zin pa ltar ro/ /chos mngon pa'i mdo dang / rigs pa drug cu ba'i zla 'grel dang / mdzod kyi gzhung rnams su sdug bden dang kun 'byung zhes pa don gcig tu bshad pa'i zhib cha 'khor ba'i rtsod lan spro ba'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i bog phung rna ma sa sdug swāsngal gyi phung bor khas len bzhin par nyeri len gyi phung bo yin par smra ba la mi bde ba ni nyer len gyi phung bo zhes pa ni rnam smin gyi phung bo zhig la byed dgos snyam pa yin na gtad so gang yang med par snang ngo / /mdoratshon rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i zarga/ bcaru/ rnams kyang nyer len

483gyi phung bor khas blangs na thogs med yab sras dang / rje yab sras kyi dgongs pa rma med par 'gro zhing yid 'byung skye ba la phan rnge bar snang gi de ltar khas bladzas na phyogs lhung can dag gi bzhed pu dang mi mthun pa'i skyon 'byung srid pa las/ rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ma dag gi don 'chol ba dang /nyams len gyi 'gag nor bar sgrub nus pa su zhig gang du rnyed par 'gyur/de bas na nags kyi spre'us mi la 'phya ba'i ngang tshul 'di bzang bo'i ngang tshul du mi snang bas/ rnyed pa dang bkur ste 'dod pas yid gdungs te log pa'i gtam 'ba' zhig lhur byed pa rnams rang mal du bde bar nyal na bstan pa la gnod pa chung ste/ mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ rnyed dang bkur snyi'i sems kyis dbyen spyos pa/ /zang zing tsam gyi sa/dul bya'i sems 'brid pa'i/ /bshes gnyen de dag rgyal ba'i bston pa la/ /re zhig ngal gso byas na gnod pa chung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//smras pa/ sdo gros chos kyi ri mo'i do shal gyis/ /'jam mgon lugs bsdung zla bzhin myos bum la/ /sgeg pa ster ba'i dpaX ldan kun gsal khyim/ /bsten pa'i 'od stong gnyis pa sa 'dir shar/ /mgon 'di'i ye shes sngo bsangs mdzes ma'i mthar/ /'khyud pas bde gshegs kun gyi mes po yi/ /mkhyen rab yungs kar gzhon nu'i lang tsho la/ /'god na mkhas par rlom rnams smros ci dgos/ /phyogs cha ma mthong rang 'dod dam bca'i tshig /sor tshad bye ma'i saskyob gnam lcags kyis/ /bskal bar gzhom pa'i nus pa bral ba'e stangs/ /mkhas rnams bzhad gad 'od du 'dzum pa'i gnas/ /de snyir lung rigs rno rje'i tsha tsha'i

484 — — — char/ /spros pas 'joms la ngal ba 'os min yang / /dbang med kun shes rig pa'i kha phye nas/ /legs par bshad pa'i phreng ba char du spros/ /kho bo'i rnam dpyod me long ngos kun gyi/ /gdong ba cig car 'dzum pa'i snang ba las/ /sprosu pa'i lung rigs 'od kyi rtse dga' yis/ /e ma phyogs kun brtan pa cis mi 'phrog /'phags bod sa/zhung lugs rgya mtshor rtsen pa'i mthar/ /snyim par zab don 'bras bu'i dra ba 'phyang / /mkhas dgu'i yid 'dzin mdzes sdug mi mnyam pa'i/ /zhags pa sa 'dir gnyis pa gzhan su zhig /kye kye rnam par dpyod pa'i mthong mig can/ /gang gang 'di na dam pa'i mgon bcas pa/ /de de'i mchu sgros bskyod pa'i cha tsam yang / /legs legs gtam gyi mdzod du gyur la ltos/ /de lta bu —ni yid ngo mtshar te nyams 'gyur khugs pa can gyi glur blangs pa'o//gsum pa 'khor ba la log par rtog pa dgag pa'i sgo nas smra ba ngan pa tshar gcod pa la gsum/ 'gal 'du'i phung bo rgan zhugs nga/sa ltag chod kyi 'chal gtam shog byang kha shas smras pa la nang 'gal bstan te bzhad gad 'ba' zhig gis dgag pa dang / rtog ldan la tshom pa skye ba'i lung rigs 'ga' zhig dogs gnas su bkod de 'gal ba spang ba dang / sdu ga bsngal bden pa la 'khor bas khyab pa'i lung rigs kyi sgrub byed yang dag ca par bkod de smra ba ngan pa drungs nas dbyung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i shing rta ba chen po mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal bos/ gang dag phrag dog dug chus mig long zhing / /snying ni zhe sdang gdung pa'i sbrul gyi tshang / /yid la 'khrul ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs

485pa/ /—'a di yis mi 'dzin log pa'i gzhung lugs gang / /zhes rdo rje bka'i lung gis zin te/ phrag dog gi dug chus myos nas gzu bor gnas pa'i mig long zhing zhe sdang gi sbrul gyis zin pas zug rngu mi bzad pas snying bcun/ yid la gang dran yang dag pa ma yin pa'i 'khrul ba'i dkyil 'khor du rdzogs te/ rnam par dag pa'i gzhung lugs ma lus pa'i don log par spyod pa'i rgan zhugs lus med pa'i pho nya pa gang gis dgag yig tu ming btags pa'i shog byang gi mgor rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i bya ba'i skabs su/ blo bzang smra ba'i dbang bo sa gsum na/ /rnam par grags pa'i dpal la mgos phyag 'tshal/ /zhes dang dpal ldan ri yi rgyal po dar ma'i zhabs/ /khyod kyi gsang gsu ma gzi yis bdag skyongs shig /ces dang / mkhas grub smra ba'e nyi ma dge legs dpal/ /rgol ngan mun pa'i go skabs drungs 'byin mdzod/ /ces dang / lhan cig brgal lan bgyid la spro bas 5ngas/ /zhes pa rnams ni/ 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i blo jigros kyi go lan du/ blo bzang smra ba'i nyi ma sa gsum na/ /grags pa'i 'od stong 'gyed gang rtag par rgyal/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan ngang ba'i rgyal bo da ra ma 'e/sa/ /zhes dang / khyod kyi rnam dkar mdzad pas bdag yid skyongs/ /zhes dang / mkhas grub smra ba'i seṅge dge legs dpal/ /rgol ngan gnyis 'thung myos pa'i klad pa 'gems/ /zhes dang / lhan cig brgal lan bgyid la mi spro mod/ /ces gsungs pa rnams kyi tshig zur re gnyis bsgyur ba tsam ste 'di ni khyod kyi rang ma tshang dang bor ston pa'i bya ma rta'o/ /bran mo la tshogs dpon/ rgyus med la sa mkhan/ gyol bo

486la ra mda' babs pa min na yang / mgo mi chud sar lus 'dzud pa la rangs pa ni ngan pa'i rang mtshang du snang ngo / /khyod kyi ngag 'khyal du/kha cig na re/ zag bcas dang nyer len gyi phung bo gnyis don gcig yin pas/ zag bcas la 'khor bas khyab ste/ zhes pa nas/ de la'ang spyir 'gi yin dang 'di min gyi kha tshod gcod dka' mod/ ces bkod pa ni/mkhas pa chen po'i dgongs don dpog dka' ba dang / rang nyid la tshig gcig gi don yang 'di yi na dang 'di min gyi kha tshon gcod pa'i rnam dpyod cung zad kyang med pa ni dngos su khas blangs nas/ rmongs pa dngociphrag dog gis gzir ba'i dmod pa mi bzad pa thod du babs pa'i ngang tshul rang gis skad gsang mthon pos sgrog pa ni bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /ngag kyal du/ re zhig 'di 'dri bar bya ste/ de dag don gcig tu sa/nga gis bstan byas pa la/ 'das ma thag pa'i gzhung der zag bcas kyi ming gi rnam grangs su bstan pa nges so/ /nes zer ro/ /'o na zag bcas yin na nyer len gyi phung po yin pas khyab par thal/ de gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ 'dod mi nus te/ phyi rol gyi zag bcas thams cad nyer len gyi phung bo ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/mdzod 'grel rgyal sras ma las/ 'on te zag pa deng lhan cig 'byung ba'i phyir yin na ni rgyud gcig la ci rigs par nyon mongs pa kun tu spyod pa nye bar len pa'i phung bo dag zag pa dang bcas par 'gyur gyi nyon mongs pa kun tu mi spyod pa yang ma yin la phyi'i chos rnams kyang ma yin no/ /zhes dang / mchims mdzod las kyang / zag pa dang lhan cig 'byung bas yin

— 487na nyer len gyi phung bo lnga kho na der 'gyur bas dge sems kyi phung bo zag bcas dang / phyi rol zag bcas mi srid par thal bas so/tre/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ nyer len gyi phung bo la zag pa dang lhan cig 'byung ba yod cing phyi rol gyi zag bcas la de mi srid pas nyer len gyi phung po lnga bo kho na der 'gyur zhes rnam gcod kyi sgra sbyar ba'i phyir/ ma grub zer na/lung de'i rnam bcad yongs gcod kyi don la brtags pa ye ma bcug pa'i de nyid bstan snang ngo / /zhes bris 'dug go /tshul 'di la brten nas khyod la skyon bzhi 'bab ste/ 'di ltar skyon dang po ni/ mdzod rtsa ba 'grel pa 'grel bshad thams cad las zag bcas kyi phung bo dang nyer len gyi phung bo gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su lan gcig ma yin par bsgrubs pa dang / ser 'bras so so'i yig cha rnams su yang mi mthun pa'i sgra zur tsam yang ma byung bar mgrin gcig tu dbyangs su byed cing / gsar bu tshun chad rigs pa smra ba spyi la tshul de rlung ltar grags pas/ kho bo cag ni mngon pa'i gzhung skad lta ci chos kyi spyi skad la'ang 'dris ci yang med do zhes rang mtshang khrom du sgrog pa'i ngan skad de nyan par spro ba su zhig yod/'di ni spyi skad la'ang rmongs pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gnyis pa ni/ rgyal sras ma'i lung don ni/ de'i phyogs snga mas zag pa ste nyon mongs mngon gyur dang lhan cig 'byung ba zag bcas kyi don du khas blangs pa la/ de ltar na zag pa nyon mongs dang lhan cig 'byung ba'i nyer len gyi phung bo lnga ni zag bcas su 'gyur gyi dge sems mngon du gyur pa lta bu'i dus kyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo dang / rgyud

488 —kyis ma bsdus pa'i phyi rol gyi zag bcas kyi phung bo rnams zag bcas ma yin par thal bas so/ /zhes 'phangs pa gzhung de dag sa brtags na shes pa'i phyir dang / gang spel las kyang / zag pa rnams dang lhan cig 'byung bas zag pa yod pa yin na de ltar na yang nyon cho/ngas pa can gyi sems kho na'i nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga zag pa dang bcas par 'gyur gyi/sems gzhan gyi ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'ang gsal zhing /mchims mdzod las 'dod pa du ma bkod nas snga phyi'i khas len de dag zag bcas 'jog tshul la khyab chung ba'i skyon yod par gsungs pa'i phyir dang /khyod lta bu'i blun po ma yin par shes rab kyi blo mi ga zur tsam phye ba dag gis brtags na 'ang gzhung don 'grel tshul de kho nar gnas pa las gzhan du ma yin no/ /khyod ltar na/ dge sems dus kyi zag phung zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo ma 7yin par thal lo/ /zhes 'phangs na'ang 'dod lan kho na 'debs dgos te/ phyi rol zag bcas kyi zla la de yang byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de ni gzhung don 'grel tshul nor pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so / /skyon gsum pa ni/ nyer len gyi phung po la zag pa dang lhan cig tu 'byung ba dgos par thal/ nyer len gyi phung bo la zag pa dang lhan cig tu 'byung ba yod cing phyi rol gyi zag bcas la de mi srid pas nyer len gyi phung bo lnga kho na zhes rnam gcod kyi sgra sbyar ba'i phyir zhes khyod rang gis bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma thong sgom bar chad med lam la so sor gnas pa'i skabs kyi 'phags pa dag dang / dgra bcom thob ma thag pa'i lhag bcas dgra bcom pa'i zag phung re re nas chos can/ nyer len gyi phung bo

4skyenya ma yin par thal/ de dag gi rgyud la zag pa dang lhan cig tu 'byulnge ba mi srid pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags mi shes na gsanā bu ba dag la dris dang khyod la blo skyed yang dag pa sbyin par nges so/ /de ni rang mtshon rang mgo gcod byed du song ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon bzhi ba ni/ rnam bcad yongs gcod kyi don la brtags pa ye ma bcug pa'i de nyid bstan snang ngo / /zhes smras pa ni rang nyid la rang nyid kyis zhwa ba slon pa bzhin du rang steng la mngon du gyur pa las ma 'das te/ rgyal sras ma dang mchims kyi lung don phyogs snga ltar na nyon mongs pa dang lhan cig spyod pa'i nye bar len pa'i phung bo lnga kho na zag bcas su yongs gcod la grub pa dang de las gzhan pa gnyis rnam bcad la bcad pa gang / khyod kyis de las phyin ci log tu bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /'di ni go ba hrob pa'i rtags bstan pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /de ltar 'go lha rang gshed dang kha zas 'chi duswā tu song ba ni byed tshul nor ba'i lag rjes te/ ji skad du/ dregs can blun po khas len can/ /chen po yin yang nyams phar 'gyur/ /gom pa gang gi sa byin pas/ /stobs ldan gyis ni sa gsum shor/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar tshig gis rang nyid rmas pa lha ma yin stobs ldan gyi ngang tshudze+ebazung ba yin no/ /la 'khyal du/ yang zag bcas yin na kun 'byung yin pas khyab par thal/ de gnyis don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ sdug bsngal bden pa yin na kun /'byung yin pas khyab par thal lo/ /'dod mi nus te/ gser 'phreng las/ sdug kun gnyis kyang kun tsho'abyung la sdug bden gyis khyab la

4spre(kyi tre — sdugawuden la des ma khyab ste/ dper na kun gzhi dang snod kyi 'jig rten dang dbang bo lnga dang gzhan ma bsgribs lung ma bstan zag bcas rnams lta bu'o/ /zhesu gsungs pa'i phyir/ ci 'dra 'dug ces bris 'dug go /tshul 'di la brten nas khyod la skyon gsu ma 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/ skyon dang po ni/ gang dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /phung bo de dag 'thab bcas kyang / /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'jig rten dang / /lta gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin/ /zhis pa'i mdo 'di rang gi bstan bya don gcig ming gi rnam grangs su ston pa'i gzhung du 'dod kyang dzig gi 'bru gnyer tshul la grub mtha' gong 'og gi 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba gnyis bdag gi rje thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan brjod par dka' ba de nyid kyis bzhed de/ 'di ltar/ bye brag smra ba'i lugs la/ zag bcas kyi phung po dang / nyer len gyi phung po dang / 'thab bcas/ dang / sdug bsngal bden pa dang / kun 'byung bden pa dang / zag bcas kyi 'jig rten dang / lta ba'i gnas dang / srid pa'am 'khor ba ste brgyad ka don gcig dang / gong ma'i lugs la/ nyonalongs pa'i zag bcas dang / nyer len gyi phung po dang /'thab bcas dang / sdug bden dang / rang 'bras sdug bsngal kunu 'byung pa'i nus pa can dang / ma dag pa'i 'jig rten dang / lta ba'i gnas dang / srid pa'am 'khor ba rnams don gcig tu lung rigs rgya chen pos sgrub bzhin bzhugs pa la khyod kyis phyogs snga'i bzhed tshul ma phyed par gnod pa bstan pa ni rang nyid rgol ba'i gral du 'os ma yin yang mi 'os bzhin du 'tshangs nas rarnga nyid gsal bar byas pa'o/ /'di ni 'os ma

po 491yin ya nga rang nyid rgol ba'i gral du 'tshangs pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gnyis pa ni/ gzhung de'i don 'grel tshul gnyis yod de/ bye brag smra bas zag bcas sogs brgyad ka don gcig tu 'dod pa gang zhig gong ma'i lugs la sdug kun gnyis don gcig min yang sdug bsngal bden pa dang rang 'bras sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'i nus pa can gnyis don gcig yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ de la nyer len gyi phung bo 'bras bur gyur pa rnams ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pa yin no/ /rgyur gyuro ba rnams ni kun 'byung gi bden pa yin te 'di las kun 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /de nyid kyi phyir 'di gnyis ni rgyu dang 'bras bur gyur bas ming gi sgo nas bye brag yo da kyi rdzas su ni ma yin no/ /zhes dang / mchims kyi mdzod ṭīka chen mo las/ des na sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung ni khyab mnyam mo zhes 'dod do/ /zhes dang / kha cig ni sred pa dang bral ba'i phung po dang snod kyi 'jig rten yang sdug bsngal yin yang kun 'byung ma yin no zhes zer ro/ /de dag la'ang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la kun 'byung zhes zer na ni de dag kyang kun 'byung du 'gyur te/ de dag kyang phyi ma ni sdug bsngal yiskya/ la de skyed pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ‘lta yin yang kun 'byung ma yin na sred pa dang bcas pa'i phung po 'ang kun 'byung ma yin par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /spros pas chog go /zhes dang /gung thang bden bzhir bye smras sdug kun gnyis don gcig tu 'dod cing /zhes sogs yig cha du mar gsungs shing / mngon pa'i spyi skad la mkhas pa dag la bsgrub mi dgos mod/ gang yang ma bslabs ci yang mi shes pa'i

492 blun po gti thug khyod 'dra bas kyang rna ba blags na 'og tu sgrub byed 'god pa dag gis kyang rtogs so/ /rtags gnyis pa grub ste/ chos mngon pa'i mdo de rang gi bstan bya don gcig tu ston pa'i lung gang / spyir sdug kun gnyis don gcig tu mi 'dod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ bzhi brgya ba'i zla 'grel las/ de bzhin du dge slong dag de ni skad cig ma yang yin no zhes bya ba dang / de bzhin du ston pas chos mngon pa'i bstan bcos las kyang nye bar len pa'i phung po lnga sdug bsngal lo zhes gsungs te/ sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'jig rten dang / /lta gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin/ /zhes bya ba dang / sdug bsngal nyid gsum ldan pa'i phyir/ /ci rigs ma lus sdug bsngal lo/ /zhes bya ba dang / yid 'ong yid du mi 'ong dang / /de las gzhan zag bcas rnams nyid/ /ces bya bas so/ /zhes lung de dag mdo lung dang / rang lugs su byas nas drangs pa gang zhig de bzhin du bzhi brgya ba'i dar ṭīka las kyang gsungs la/ rigs pa drug cu ba'i zla 'grel gong du drangs zin pa ltar de dag nyer len gyi phung sna bor gsungs pas na/ sdug bden dang / rang 'bras sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'i nus pa can gnyis don gcig tu ston byed du 'dod dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /sdug bden la ming de dag theg dman gyi mdo sde tsam du ma zad theg chen gyi sde snoshe 'phags pa'i bden pa'i le'u sogs du ma las rgya cher gsungs la/ le'u de las/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re na yang sdug bsngal gyi ming bye ba brgya stong phrag bcu bcu yod de/ de dag gis sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin 'dul lo/ /zhes bka' stsal bas na sdug

493bden sogs la rang rang gi ngor ming gsar ba re byung na sngon med pa'i tha snyad do snyam du se mas pa ni rang gi de nyid ston byed du snang ngo / /gnyis pa grub ste/ bsdu ba dang / gser phreng dang / yig cha rnams gong du drangs par kun 'byung la sdug bden gyis khyab la sdug ba den la kun 'byung gis ma khyab par bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni khyod kyis grub mtha' so so'i khyad ma shes pa'i nongs pa ste bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon d+nghagasum pa ni/ bdag nyid srid zhi'i mtha' las yongs su 'dzin pa dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ye shes rang gzugs de nyid nas bye brag smra ba'i lugs la sdug kun don gcig kyang gong ma'i lugs la de ltar mi bzhed pas/ ci 'dra 'dug zer ba ni phyogs snga ma la gnod byed ma rnyed par gang dran smras pa ste gnod byed kyis phongs pa'o/ /de ni gnod byed kyis —phongs nas gang dran smras pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /des na rigs pa smra ba gsar bu zhig gi rnam dpyod kyang ma byung bas khyod la ci 'dra 'dug rang la ci 'dra 'dug mi shes na rgan zhugs kyi rtags 'dug go /dri ma med pa'i dris lan las/ gnyid kyis log ba gang zhe na/ /skyes bu shin tu rmongs pa'o/ /tshe/sa gsungs pa'i don gra ma nyams par ngom pas gang bshad log pa'i gtam las ma 'das so zhes go bar gyis shig shes jildan dag 'di 'i ngag 'chal du/ gzhan yang / ming gi rnam grangs jiyin na don gcig ming gi rnam grangs yin pas khyab par thal/ khyod kyi zhe 'dod 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes pa nas/ phyi ma snga ma'i bye brag yin par dul lta sogs kyis bshad/ ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bris 'dug go /

494 rmotshul 'di la brten nas kyang khyod la skyon gsum 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/skyon dang bo ni/ phyogs snga mas rnam grangs thams cad la don gcig ming gi rnam grangs kyis khyab pa nam yang zhal gyis bzhes pa med pas thang stong la thal stong 'phangs pa ni mkhas pa'i bla 'tshong dang / rigs pa smra ba'i rkang 'dren bla na med pa'o/ /'di ni khas blangs med par gnod byed bstan pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gnyis pa ni/ khyod kyi tshig phreng 'di dag la snon phri phran bu las phal cher bse'i rten 'brel rgya tshig rnams mdangs ma 'gyur bar bkod de rang nyid kyis rigs pa chen po rnyed pa skad kyi zol sbyor byed pa ni rang stobs kyis thal ngag rnam dag gcig kyang 'god mi nus pa'i rmongs rtags ma nyams par phyir ngom pa ste khrom gyi spre'u ma byas na legs so/ /'di ni rang gi nang rtags bstan pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gsum pa ni/ chos mngon pa'i mdo las/ gang dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /zhes sogs kyi skabs su 'byung ba'i don de da ga don gcig tu sgrub pa la bsams nas thal ba de dag 'phangs pas/ de ni rtsa ba'i lung de'i don la khyod nyid phyin ci log tu song ba las ma 'das te/ gang spel las/ nye bar len pa'i phung bo zhes bya ba nas srid pa zhes bya ba'i bar 'di dag ni rnam grangs don dang mthun pa dag go /zhes dang / rnam grangs de dag yin la/ don dang mthun pa dag kyang yin nga sa na rnam grangs don dang mthun pa dag go /zhes don mthun pa'am don gcig pa'i rnam grangs su gsungs pa bzhin mdzod gzhung kun las byung tshul gong 'og tu gsal ba ltar yin pa'i phyir dang / gung

49byethang bden bzhi las/ dang po grub ste/ mdzod las/ sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'jig rten dang / /lta gnas srid pa'ang de dag yin/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'di sgras brjod tsam gyi rnam grangs su 'dod pa'ang rigs pa ma yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ni rang nyid gzhung don la phyin ci log tu song ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /de'i phyir khyod kyis/ ha cang dpa' thal zhing blo gsal rnams khrel ba'i gnas su 'gyur ro/ /zhes bris pa'i gnas su khyod nyid song ba der gda' bas/ji skad du/ blo ngan nyes bshad dug chus myos pa'i mthus/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzhung brgya ma mthong yang / /rang bzo'i gzu lum rang dgar spel byed pa'i/ /bshes gnyen de kun bag yod dus la bab/ /ces gsungs pa 'di'i don yid la byas nas bag yod la gnas na legs pas gzu lu ma ma byed cig 'chal gtam du/ 'o na/ mdzod kyi lung don gang yin zhe na/ mchims ṭīka las/ 'dus byas gang dag zag bcas su bshad pa de dag ni nye bar len pa'i phung po 'ang yin te/ nye bar len pa ni nyon mongs pa yin la de las byung bas na nye bar len pa'i phung bo ste rtswa dang sog ma'i me bzhin no/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/ mdo las/ 'dus byas zag bcas la nyer len gyi phung bo zhes btags nas bstan tshul dang /de'i rgyu mtshan rnams bkod pa tsam yin gyi de dag dngos gnas par gsungs pa ma yin no/ /gzhan du na/ pha dang ma ni gsad bya zhing / /zhes pa'i pha ma yang pha ma dngos gnas par 'gyur ro/ /'di lta bu rags pa yang mi go bar rgya bod kyi gzhung mang bo gung bsgrigs nga/'i stangs byed pa

496 — — —ni shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang rmongs pa ngo mtshar skyed pa'i rnam gzhag tsam mo/ /zhes bris 'dug go /tshul 'di la brten naswā kyang khyod la skyon gsum 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/ skyon dang po ni/ rgya bod kyi mdzod gzhung de snyed las zag bcas kyi phung bo dang nyer len gyi phung bo don gcig tu bsgrubs pa las/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo zhes btags pa bar bstan pa gcig kyang med par ma zad de ltar khas len pa ni richos skad lta ci spyi skad rags pa'ang ma byung ba'i gti rgan khyod las gnyis pa sngar yang ma byung zhing phyis kyang 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /gzhung de'i don de ltar 'grel bas na/ 'og tu khyod rang gis/ rnam 'grel la sa/ nan gyis khyod 'di 'dod byas pa/ /gsal bar dbang phyug spyod pa yin/ /zhes pa'i lung gis zin pa de khyod min nam/ zhes smras ba bzhin 'jig rten pa'i kha ngag la'ang / glang bus sa brkos rang gi gnya'/ mchil ma gnam 'phangs rang gi ngo zer ba ltar/ lung des zin pa rmi gdon mi za bar kha bshad 'gal 'du'i phung bo khyod nyid du nges te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ / skyon gnyis pa ni/ pha dang ma ni gsad bya ste/ /zhes pa'i pha ma rmi nga pha ma dngos gnas par 'gyur ro zhes zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ lung thams cad sgra ji bzhin par khas blangs pa'i phyir zer ram/ gang dag zag bcas nyer len pa'i/ /zhes sogs sgra ji bzhin par khas blangs pa'i phyir zhes zer/ dang po ni yul gang du dus nam zhig phyogs snga smra ba su zhig gis khas blangs/ dranartsopa rnal du zhog la smos shig phyi ma ltar na/lung de sgra ji bzhin par khas blangs na/ pha dang ma ni gsad bya ste / /

49ṭīzhes pa'i lung sgra ji bzhin du khas len dgos pa'i khyab 'brel thub pa sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi 'grub pas/ kha dang rkub kyi khyad par mi phyed par khyi rgan brag la zug pa'i brtul zhugs blangs pa ni mi shes pa dang 3phrag dog gi ngang tshul du zad do/ /kye glen pa 'dis 'di 'dra smras so/ /'di ni thal ba phyin ci log tu 'phangs pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gsum pa ni/ phyogs snga'i bzhed pa dang rang gis thal ba 'phen tshul rags pa tsam yang mi shes par 'chal tshig smra ba la ya nga ba med pa ni/ shes kyi khe 'dod pa dang rmongs pa ngo mtshar skyed pa'i rnam gzhag tsam mo/ /zhes khyod rang gis gtam du smras pa rang nyid khrom gyi gto byas pa ste/ ma sbyangs skye bo'i tshogs nang du/ /rdzun gyi phreng ring brgyus pa yis/ /rmongs pa ngo mtshar skyed pa'i gtam/ /blun po'i yid la 'bab gyur cing / /zhes pa'i brjod don khur du blangs pas rmongs pa'i khor sar gab pa'i rang rigs rnams mgu bar byed pa'i cho ga'o/ /kha stabs rgan mo las zhan kyang pho sgrob rgyal bo las mtho mdog bstan te tshig ngan smras pa de khyod la cang ran nam/ 'di ni phyogs snga'i bzhed pa dang de 'gog tshul la rmongs pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /'khyal gtam du/ de la kho na re/dzha mdzod lugs la zag bcas su gyur pa'i 'dus byas yin na nyer len gyi phung bo yin pas khyab ste/ mchims ṭīka las/ phung bo yin la nyer len ma yin pa 'dus byas zag med/ gnyis ka yin pa 'dus byas zag bcas dang / gnyis ka ma yin pa 'dus byas te mu gsum du 'gyur bas/ zhes — gsungs pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab ste/ lung des 'dus byas zag bcas

nga 4nya8 de phung bo dngos dang nyer len btags pa ba gnyis ka yin par bstan gyi nyer len gyi phung bo yin par ma bstan pa'i phyir dang / spyir nyer len dang phung bo gnyis ka yin na nyer len gyi phung bo yin mi dgos pa'i phyir te/rtag pa ma yin pa dang rgyu gnyis ka yin na rtag pa yin pa'i rgyu yin mi dgos pa'i phyir/ zhes bris 'dug go /tshul 'di la brten nas khyod la skyon gnyis 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/ skyon dang po ni/ lung de mdzod rang 'grel gyi tshig ji bzhin mchims 'jam dbyangs bas bkod pa yin la/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa kun gyis phung bo dang nyer len gyi phung bo la mu gsum brtsis te bkral ba las phung bo dang nyer len gyi phung bo btags pa ba la mu gsum brtsi ba ni khyod las gnyis pa su/ khyod ltar na 'dus byas kyi zag bcas thams cad zag bcas kyi phung bo dngos dang nyer len gyi phung bo btags pa ba'i gzhi mthun du mu gnyis pa'i gzhung gis bstan pas nyer len gyi phung bo mtshan nyid pa gzhi ma grub par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /'di ni lusdo don ma go ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gnyis pa ni/ spyir nyer len dang phung bo gnyis ka yin yang nyer len gyi phung bo yin mi dgos zer ba ci/lhan cig byed rkyen gyi zlayodrangs pa'i nyer len dang phung bo gnyis ka yin na nyer len gyi phung bo yin mi dgos zer ram/ skabs 'dir bshad pa'i nyer len dang phung bo gnyis ka yin na nyer len gyi phung bo yin mi dgos zer/ dang po ltar na spyir nyer len dang phung bo gnyis ka yin pa la nyer len gyi phung bor khas len pa'i rigs pa smra ba su zhig byung / da rnyu ra sogs 'khrul ba'i rgyu kha zas su byas pa ma yin nam/ bsam blo thongs shig

499gnyis pa ltar na/ skabs 'di'i nye bar len pa dang phung bo gnyis ka yin la nyer len gyi phung po min pa la ci zhig 'jog smra ba ngan pa/ 'dir bstan nyer len ni nyon mongs la bshad dgos pa gang zhig de yin na nyer len gyi phung bo yen pas khyab pa'i phyir/ de ni khyab 'brel 'tho/ ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /khyod ltar na/ sog ma'i me dang tsan+dan gyi me dang rgyal bo'i mi dang 'bras bu'i ljon shing re re nas chos can/ khyod khyod rang ma yin par thal/ sog ma'i me yin na sog ma dang me gnyis ka yin dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mdzod gzhung de dag gis zag bcas thams cad nyer len gyi phung bo yin bar ma bshad pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ de ltar na rang nyid gsal bar byas kyang da dung chos gtam la dga' ba ni/ kha ngag tu'ang / ra bo brag them la dga'/ phyug gsar kha ngom la dga'/ chos med dbyangs 'dur la dga'/ mkhas chung chos gtam la dga' zer ba der gda'/ shes rab sdong bur/ 'dod pas long pas sdig mi mthong / /dmus long gis ni gzugs mi mthong / /dregs pa yis ni skyorno mi mthong / /bdag ltas de nyid mi mthong ngo / /zhesabyudamus long gis gzugs mi mthong ba ltar nga rgyal gyis rang skyon mi mthong bar gsungs pa'i lung bstan steng du babs pa yin no/ /kha 'khyal du/khyod kyi zhe 'dod ltar na/ sangs 'phags chos can/ 'khor ba yin par thal/ zag bcas nyer len gyi phung bo yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags grub ste/ lam ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas rnams/ /zag bcas/ zhes dang / mkhas spub dpal

500ldan pa'i grub mtha'i mchan las kyang— / lam bden du ma gtogs pa'i 'dus byas dang zag bcas don gcig yin la/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/rtsa cibar 'dod na/ sangs rgyas su gyur pa'i gtan gyi spang bya yod par thal lotso/ /'dod na/ sangs rgyas su byed pa'i chos kyang don gyis spang bya yin par khas blangs yod pas chos dkon mchog tu gyur pa'i spang bya yod par thal lo/ /yang nges pa'i rgyun zhugs srid pa lan bdun pa chos can/ 'khor ba yin par thal/ zag bcas yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab sla/—'dod na/ dge 'dun du gyur pa'i gtan gyi spang bya yod par thal lo /de yang 'dod na/ da ni smin ma zang zing bar byas te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyis tshar gcod dgos sam snyam ste/ lung rigs kyis gdul bya ma yin pa ni blo thag rbad kyis chod byung bas thams cad kyis thugs mnyam zhog mdzod/ ces bris 'dug go /ngan pa lang la shor ba khyod kyis rang nyid la skyag gtad ci yang med par than bya'i ngan skad lta bu dbyangs su gyer ba 'di ci/ sangs 'phags zag bces su phyogs snga smra bas rang lugs su zhal gyis bzhes zer ram/ bye smra'i lugs la de ltar smras zer/ dang po ltar na/ gang zag sus dus nam du tshig gang gis tshul ji ltar khas blangs/ bdag gi rje blu ma ngag gi dbang bo sa rbadzñā rjes su slob pa dang bcas pas rmi lam na yang de lta bu mi 'dod pas khyod rang shes pa rnal du mi gnas ba ma yirno nam/ gnyis pa ltar na/ phar phyin zur mchan las bye smras sangs 'phags sdug bden du 'dod pas skyabs dngos su khas len pa min par nan gyis bsgrubs pa ltar bye smra'i gzhung rgya mtsho lta bu na de ltar 'byung mod/ smin ma zang zing gis

tram̐0’ tshar gcod par 'dod na bye smra'i slob dpon gser gyi ri bo dang 'dra ba dag tshar gcod dgos kyi/ de'i khas len 'di lta bu'o zhes skyor tshad la mtho mtshams par ga la 'os/ gzhan du na/ khyod chad lta ba dang sangs 'phags la dgrar lta ba'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod kyis rgyang 'phen pas las rgyu 'bras med pa dang / bdag cag gi ston pa dgrar khas len pa'i 'dod pa skyor ba'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ rtsing bo khyod kyis bye smra'i lugs la bsams 'dra yang zhib cha ci yang med par sangs 'phags zag bcas su bsgrus pas don gyis skyon de dag rang steng du 'gel ma dgos par blangs pa'o/ /smin ma zang zing byas te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyis tshar gcod dgos zer ba ni/ tshigs su bcad pa brgya ba las/ tsardon gla rtsi ga bur gyis byugs kyang / /sgog skya'i dri ni rang bzhin mi 'dor ltar/ /legs pa'i gzhung lugs bzang bor rab bslabs kyang / /rang bzhin ngan pa'i mtshan nyid 'dor mi srid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rang nyid na tshod yol gyi bar grub mtha' gang la zhugs nas bza' nyog gi bdag por bsdad de rnga dang thun ru rbad pa'i bag chags ni 6 /nga dag pa'i grub mtha' la zhugs kyang da dung gra ma nyams pa'i 'bras rtags so/ /smin ma zang zing byas te hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyis dgra bo tshar gcod pa la nang bsam pa'i 'khyer so lta ci/ phyi lus kyi bzo sta la'ang / stod ma sgur ba/ smad ma btsum pa/ mig ma na ba/ skad ma zhan pa/ kha lag ma 'dar ba zhig dgos pa la/ chags sdang gi rgya mtsho khyod ni ngan pa dgu tshang gi lus bo khur du thogs pa la nyam chung gnag rdzis kyang snying rje'i yul du byed pa kun gyis mthun snang du grub pa

502 yin pas/ khyod kyi smin ma zang zing la khyi rgan rgya bo yang mi skrag khyod kyi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa kyis srog chags grog ma yang mi sod de/ saden rdzun lag len la thob dang shes so/ /'dzi ni phyogs snga'i bzhed pa ma longs par 'chal gtam smras pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /ngag kyal las/gzhan yang / 'khor 'daso gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yod par thal ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi sa na 'khor ba yod par thal ba sogs gnod byed mtha' yas so/ /zhes bris 'dug go /kye hud/ go ba mo ma'i dpyad pa dang /rigs pa byis pa'i kha shags la mi do bar mi gtsang ba zas su za ba'i nor skyong gi rang bzhin 'dzin pa khyod kyi rang mtshang skyugs bro ba la ltos dang smra ba ngan pa 'dis kyang khyod la skyon 'byung ste/ myang 'das ni nyon mongs spangs pa'i so sor brtags 'gog la grub mtha' smra ba bzhi gas 'dod pas/sangs rgyas sar yod tshad myang 'das su 'dod pa khyod min pa su yod/gzhi der 'khor ba dang myang 'das gnyis ka yod na 'khor 'das kyi gzhi mthun yod dgos na/ khyod kyi lugs la lhag bcas dgra bcom pa chos can/ khyod kyi rgyud na 'khor 'das gnyi ga'i gzhi mthun yod par thal/khyod kyi rgyud na 'khor 'das kanyis ka yod pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum mo/ /bye smra'i lugs la sangs rgyas sar 'khor ba yod par khas len pas gnod do zhe na/ khyod la'ang de ltar gnod pa yod par thal/ bye smra'i lugs la sangs rgyas kyi lus rten de 'khor ba dang sdug bden yin par khyod kyis kyang khas len pa'i phyir ro/ / gong ma'i lugs la sdug bden la 'khor bas khyab pa phyogs snga mas zhal gyis bzhes pa sa sangs rgyas sar 'khor ba yod

503par thal ba 'phen na sangs rgyas sar sdug bden yod par phyogs sngas zhal gyis mi bzhes shing khyod kyis khams gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad grogs su spran te bskal bar bsgrubs kyang sgrub mi nus pa'i phyir ro/ /skyugs bro ba 'dis mgo'i zhwa dang rkang gi lham nor ba'i kha 'chal dbyangs su byas pa la ltos shig sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis/ khyi rgan ya rkan phug pa'i khrag /rus pa'i bcud du bsgoms nas 'cha'/ /zhes gsungasartsopa ltar rang gi ya rkan phug pa'i khrag rus pa'i bcud du 'dzin pa 'di 'dra las ngo tsha ba med do/ /'di ni rtswa dang rtso bsres pa'i ngag kyal thal ngag tu bkod pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /'chal gtam du/ lam rim gyi lung don yang / snod dang bcud kyis bsdus pa'i 'khor ba'i dngos po zhes /'grel dgos shing de la 'khor bas ma khyab po/ /khyed rang ltar na/ snod bcud yin tshad po 'khor ba yin par khas len dgos pas 'gal ba'i khur chen 'degs mi bzod pas non par 'gyur ba mkhas blun kun la bsnyon med du snang na dgag yig gi spros pas ci bya/ 'on kyang mtshon byed tsam ni/ bde ba can lta bu dag zhing gi snod bcud re re nas dang / mthar thug mngon mtho bzhi sogs thams cad 'khor ba yin par ha cang thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes bris 'dug go /tshul 'di la brten nas khyod la skyon gsum 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/ skyon dang po ni/ lam rim gyi lung don phyin ci log tu song ba'i tshul 'og tu lung don bsdu ba'i gzhung ltar yang dag par 'grol bar 'gyur bas shes nus te/ 'di ni lung don tshul bzhin ma shes pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /ston gnyis pa

504 ni/ lam rim gyi lung don khyod kyis bshad pa ltar byed na/ rgyud kyis ma bsdus pa'i zag bcas thams cad snod kyis bsdus pa'i 'a/wor ba'i dngos po yin yang snod dang 'khor ba ma yin par bshad dgos la/ de ltar na 'khor ba'i dngos po yin tshul ci/ 'khor ba bdag yin la phyi'i snod ni de'i bdag gi ba zhes bshad dam/ nang 'khor ba khyad gzhi phyi'i dngos po de'i khyad chos zhes bshad/ phyi ma ltar na phyi'i zag bcas thams cad 'khor ba'i khyang/ chos dang / nang gi nyer len gyi phung bo khyad gzhir 'dod dgos pas/ phyi'i rdo dang tsher ma mi gtsang ba la sogs pa lus kyi khyad chos kyang yin zhes khas longs shig ka bum gnyis chos can/ nyer len gyi phung bo'i dngos po yin par thal/ 'khor ba'i dngos po yim/ pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de nyer len gyi phung bo dang dngos po'i gzhi mthun du khyod kyis mi 'dod pas nyer len gyi phung bo'i khyad par du gyur pa'i dngos bo'i don du khas blangs la song bas na khyod lta bu'i 'grel byed mkhan po ni snyigs ma'i dus kyi rang rtags gong na med par mig mthong lag zin du 'jig rten gyi byed pos mdo smad byang rgyud kyi char sprul bar nges so/ /'di ni lung don log par smras pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gsum pa ni/lam rim gyi lung des snod bcud kyi 'khor ba gnyis yod par bstan pa dang / de yang ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad la 'khor bas khyab par bdag gi tshe rabs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad mkhyen pa 'di nyid kyis zhal gyis bzhes pa la snod bcud/ yin tshad la 'a/wor bas khyab pa'i thal ba kha 'khums lag 'khu/ myo/sa rigs smra'i rkang 'dren khyod lta bus lta ci/

505 dpal phyogs kyi glang bo yab sras dngos su phebs kyang bsgrub nus rigs su mi snang bas/ thal 'gyur tshig gsum bstud mar mi thon par 'jam dpal mi'i seṅge la chags sdang gi sen mos dbrad par 'dod pa dang / rdo rje'i brag la rang sen rmas pa'i khrag ris 'bri bar 'dod pa a re blun/ 'di ni go rigs phyin ci log tu song ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /zam ze mchog sred kyis/ ka tan+ta shes sgra mkhan dang / /gces sgrub shes pa'i sman pa dang / /dbyug pa thos/sa pa'i ral kha ba/ /de gsum 'jig rten bzhad gad sa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don thog tu babs pa'o/ /log bshad du/ gzhan yang / bum pa chos can/ khyod la rga na 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal dang ldan par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ 'dod na/ bum pa shi ba'i sbyangs chog dang dge rtsa khyod kyis sgrubs la/ gcer bu bas shing sems ldan du sgrub pa'i rtags khyab kyang khas longs shig khyab pa yod de/ 'khor ba la las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba zhig 'jog dgos pa gang zhig na rga 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal ya nga de 'dra'i skye ba'i rjes su 'gro ldog byed pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rgyud bla dar ṭīka las/ ma dag pa'i gnas skabs kyi chos gsum gyi nye bar len pa ni bden par zhen pa tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i yid la byed pa dang las dang 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa sngon du 'gro ba can gyi nying mtshams sbyor ba ming gzugs kyis bsdus pa'i skye ba yin te/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ lung de'i 'phror/ rgyu de med pas rga na sogs med par ston pa ni/zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ yang / de chos can/ nyer len gyi phung bo yen

506par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ na rga 'chi ba'i rang bzhin can yin par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ dge legs 'od snang 'gyed pa'i nyin byed las/ nyer len gyi phung bo dang de la brten pa'i na rga 'chi ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal gnyis me dang tsha ba bzhin 'bral mi rung— du gnas pa yin/ zhes dang / rgyal sras po to bas/ rigs drug gang du skyes phan chad na tsha dang 'chi ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni/ na rgyu zhig na ba yin/ 'chi rgyu zhig 'chi ba yin gyi/ de la mi 'os pa zhig glo bur du byung ba min/ 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid dam rang bzhin yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na rang cag gi 'dren mchogasaṃ gha'i zhabs kyis bum pa lta bu ni zag bcas dang phung bo gnyis ka yin yang zag bcas nyer len gyi phung po yin zer mi rung zhes gsungs skad thos pas de ltar khas blangs na skyon gyi rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes kyis kyang rnyed pa'i gnas med do/ /zhes bris 'dug go /mi gtsang ba'i dri nga ba 'byung ba'i gnas rang sha nang nas rul ba'i mdze bo'i lus rten bzhin du skyon mtha' yas pa'i 'byung gnas su mthong bas tshul 'di la brten nas khyod la skyon bzhi 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/ skyon dang po ni/ 'o na khyod rang la/ 'khor ba yin na na ba dang 'chi bas khyab par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ thog ma'i ma rig pa chos can/ na ba dang 'chi bar thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ nang gi sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ ma rig pa na ba la khyod kyis sman dang / ma rig pa 'chi ba la khyod kyis tshe smub gyis shig gzhan

— tram̐0 1 yang / byang 'phags rgyud kyi sred pa chos can/ na ba dang 'chi bas sdug bsngal bar thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ gzhan yang /dam bca' ba'i ngag chos can/ na ba dang 'chi bar thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ rtags sla 'dod na/ de chos can/ srog ldan yin par thal/ na 'chi byed pa'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ srog ldan lta ci dbang bos zin pa'ang min par mdzod rtsa 'grel las gsungs shing /de bzhin du rgyal mchog bdun pa'i gsang 'dus dbang ṭīka chen mo sogs las gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / 'khor ba yin na 'chi ba dang shi na dge rtsa dang sbyangs chog byed dgos pas khyab par thal/khyod kyis lab rdol dbyangs su byed tshul 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/g.yag gi rwa co dang / khyi'i rnga ma dang / bong bu'i rna ba re re nas chos can/'chi ba dang shi na dge rtsa dang sbyangs chog byed dgos par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ der thal/ rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ba khas/ rtags sla/ rtsa bar 'dod na/g.yag gi rwa co shi ba'i sbyangs chog khyod kyis gyis/ khyi'i rnga ma shi ba'i sngas mgo la khyod song / bong bu'i rna ba shi ba'i dge rtsa khyod kyis sgrubs shig kyem kha nag yang / dug gsum sogs nyon mongs rnams chos can/ 'chi ba dang shi na dge rtsa dang sbyangs chog byed dgos par thal/ khyod 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ nyon mongs shi ba'i grong chog la khyod rgyugs shig gzhan yang / dam bca' ba'i lus rten ngan pa dgu tshang chos can/shi na sbyangs chog byed dgos par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod

tram̐0skye — — — — —— —dzhan/ de chos can/ sbyangs tshog ma byas na khyod dmyal par lhung dogs yod par thal/ khyod la sbyangs chog byed dgos pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/'dod na/ ngag kyal gyi phung bo khyod shi ba'i 'og tu rang rten 'di dmyal bar 'gro dgos pa'i mya ngan da lta nas gyis shig— gzhan yang / 'khor ba yin na srog ldan dang sems ldan yin pas khyab par thal/ gcer bu bas shing sems ldan du sgrub pa'i rtags khyab khas len dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ na ba'i sdug bsngal du gyur pa'i rlung mkhris bad kan dang / rga ba'i sdug bsngal du gyur pa'i skra dkar gnyer ma spyi ther mgo 'dar lus sgur gom 'khyor sogs re re nas chos can/ srog ldan dngasems ldan yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/rtags nang gi sdug bden gyis grub/ 'dod na/ de dag chos can/shi na sbyangs chog dang dge rtsa sgrub dgos par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ kye hud/ smra lugs 'di la ltos dang / glen pa 'dis kha phar lta dang mtshon phar gdengs shig las kha nang lta dang mtshon nang 'debs shig gi bsam blo nam yang ma btang ba byis pa'i rtags su snang ngo / /'di ni rang mgo rmas pa'i mtshon cha rang gis bzos pa'i skyon te band gad kyi gnas so/ /slob dpon rta dbyangs kyis/ sdig can rnams ni rang bzhin gyis/ /'du dang 'gal ba'i lam la brten/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dza bo nyid kyis phyin ci log gi lam la spyod pa'i sdig to can/ 'gal 'du lteg sprod du khas len pa'i pha wang / rang skyon mi mthong ba'i lder bzo ha re long ba/rgud pa thams cad 'dren pa'i ltas ngan bye'u mgo sngon 'dis smras tshad/

— byo09legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las/ sna yi tshab ma nyos pa'i bu //g.yar ba'i rgyan dang brkus pa'i nor/ /slob dpon med pa'i rig pa rnams/ /yod kyang gzhan gyis brtsi ba med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten te rigs lam la ya nga dag par ma sbyangs pa'i rang mtshang gsal bar ston pa sha stag tu snang ba der gda' la/'di dang mtshungs par rigs pa'i rnam 'gyur ci yang ma chags par cal col smra ba la tshe rabs su goms pa du mas kyang / 'khor ba chos can/khyod la gcog rgyu yod par thal/ bum pa la gcog rgyu yod pa gang zhig de 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs skyugs bro ba'i 'chal gtam du ma 'dzem med du smras pas rang nyid sa/sa la bar byed do/ de ni sna bug nas rlung bo drag tu bus te/ snying rje'i yul du 'jog par 'os mod/ mtshon tsam smos na/ 'khor pa chos can/ /khyod mtshon gyis gzhom nus par thal/ dam bca' ba'i lus rten 'de mtshon gyis gzhom nus pa gang zhigadam bca' ba'i lus rten 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ 'khor ba chos can/ 'on rgyu yod par thal/ rna ba la 'on rgyu yod pa gang zhigarna ba 'khor ba yin pa'e phyir/ 'khor gsum/ 'khor ba chos can/ nar rgyu yod par thal/ 4 ga la zhar rgyu yod pa gang zhig mig 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ 'khor ba chos can/ gcos/ rgyu yad par thal/ mgo la gcog rgyu yod pa gang zhig mgo 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/'khor gsum/ 'khor ba chos can/ thag pa ltar chad rgyu yo da par thal/rgyu ma la de ltar chad rgyu yod pa gang zhig rgyu ma 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/

///)kyi/'u/ — — lke rī 'khor gsum/ sa/zhan yang / shes bya chos can/ khyod mtshon gyis gzhom nus par thal/ dam rmobaca' ba'i lus rten 'di mtshon gyis gzhom nus pa gang zhig de shes bya yin pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs rigs 'dra/ kho na re/bum pa chos can/ khyod la 'khor ba bo yod par thal/ khyod 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ 'o na/ byang 'phags rgyud kyi sred pa chos can/ khyod la 'khor ba po yod par thal/ khyod 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/'khor gsum/ kho na re/ snod kyi 'jig rten chos can/ khyod len pa bo yod pa ra thal/ khyod 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ che/sa zer/ 'o na/ so skye dang lus rten gcig gis bsdus pa'i byang 'phags kyi lus rten chos can/ khyod len pa bo yod par thal/ khyod 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/'khor gsum/ kho na re/ 'khor ba chos can/ khyod las rdzu 'phrul tsam gyis 'da' nus pa ra thal/ khyod la snod kyi 'jig rten kyang 'jog pa'i phyir/ zhes zer/ 'o na/ zag bcas dang / sdug bden dang / ma dag pa'i 'jig rten re re nas chos can/ khyod las rdzu 'phrul tsam gyis 'da' nus par thal / khyod la ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten kyang 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ skyugs bro ba 'di dag gis rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis kyang mi thon pa'i ris/sa pa ya mtshan pa 'phangs pa skad du rigs pa smra ba'i ṅka/nga 'dren gyi ngag tshig dri nga ba 'thul bar byas so/ /de dag ni/ khye'u gnyis kyi taigs pa brjod pa las/ dam pa ma yin gang brten pa/ /rlag par byed pa'i gnas yin te/ /kā la k+kaṭa bden pa yis/ /gnyi ga phung bar byed pa bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar dam pa ma yin pa'i rjes su

511'brangs na rang nyid rlag par byed pa'i gnas te/ khyi rgan ku co 'don pa na / / rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug /ces ba'i ngang tshul phrag par len pa mtshams byas na lung rigs kyi drag sngags bzod par dka' bas gzir bar mi 'gyur bas legs so/ /skyon gnyis rtsa4 ni/ 'khor ba la las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba zhig 'jog dgos zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ci/ la sa nyon gyi dbang gis dngos bor skye ba zhig 'jog dgos pa'i don nam/ de'i dbang gis rigs drug gang rung du nying mtshams sbyar ba'e bcu gcig pa skye ba zhig 'jog dgos pa'i don yin/ dang bo ltar na sdug bden thams cad 'khor ba yin par thal/ sdug bden yin na las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba yin pas khyab pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ltar na/ gang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig ma yin par thal/ nang gi sdug bden la bcu gcig pa skye bas ma khyab pa'i phyir te/ 'phen byed rgyu gsum dang / 'grub byed rgyu gnyis dang / byang 'phags rgyud kyi sred pa dang / dag ji/nga ba'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa'i sa bon sogs bcu gcig pa skye ba ma yin pa'i phyir/'khor gsum/ 'di ni rang gis khas blangs pa rang gis ngos ma zin pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gsum pa ni/ rigs drug gang du skye ba grub kyang na ba dang 'chi dgos pas khyab par thal/ na 'chi gnyis 'khor ba'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir te/ po to pa'i gsung 'grel tshul 'thad pa'i phyir dang / rang bzhin can gyis rang bzhin 'dor ba nam yang mi srid pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ khams gong na na ba yod par thal ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan ya nga / tshangs dbang sogs kyi lus rten kyang grub pa na

512na bzhin pa dang 'chi bzhin pa yin par thal/ me dang tsha ba bzhin na 'chi ni 'khor pa'i 'dor mi rung gi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/yang / 'khor ba yin na na rga 'chi bzhin pa yin pas khyab par thal/'khor ba la na rga 'chi ba rjes su 'gro ldog byed pas khyab pa khyod la 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ na rga 'chi bzhin pa ma yin pa'i lang tsho dar la bab pa sogs sa/zhi ma grub par thal lo/ /gzhan ya nga / gang zag gang gi rgyud la 'khor pa yo da na de'i rgyud la las nyon gyis nying mtshams sbyar ba'i skye ba yo da dgos/ de yod na skye ba de'i tres su 'gro ba na rga 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal yod dgos nga/ra thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/byang sems sa gnyis pa ba sogs kyi rgyud la rga na 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal yod pa ra thal/ de'i rgyud na 'khor ba yo da pa'i phyir te/ de'i rgyud na kun 'byung yod pa yig cha las gsungs pa de'i phyir/ des na lam khrid dang po to ba'i sa/sung sgros sogs kyi don/ rigs drug gang du nyer len gyi phung bo blangs kyang na rga 'chi ba sogs kyi sdug bsngal gyi sa bon dang bcas pa las ma 'das pas khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pas de dag byung yang mi 'os pa zhig gsar du byung ba min/ zhes pa'i don las 'khor ba yin na na 'chi byed pas khyab pa zhanasdo gyis ga la bzhes/ gzhan yang / khams gsum 'khor ba 'di ni dmyal bar mes sreg pa dang / yi dwags su bkras shing skom pa dang / dud 'gror bkol zhing spyod pa sogs kyi sdug bsngal las ma 'das pa'i rang bzhin can no zhes 'khor ba la de lta bu'i nyes pa spyir ldan par bshad na 'khor ba yin na de lta bu'i sdug bsngal ldan dgos pas khyab

snye /shā1(tswa) par thal lo/ /'di ni 'khor ba la na 'chi'i rang bzhin can gyis khyab par khas blangs pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so /skyon bzhi ba ni/ji skad du/ ngan pa phal cher rang gi skyon/ /gang yin gzhan la sgo bar byed/ /kha tas mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu/ /sa gtsang dag la 'bad nas 'phyis/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang gi skyon bla ma la bkal te/ pha bla mas kyang de ltar gsungs so zhes khā tas mi gtsang ba 'phyis pa'i ngang tshul bzung bas ci zhig bya/ mi gtsang ba phyag dar khrod du btang bas chog mod gser gyi mchod sdong steng du satong ci la dgos/ 'phung byed 'ug pa'i mgo can bsam blo thongs shig 'di ni rang mtshang bla mar bsgos pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /log bshad du/ gzhan ya nga / bum pa chos can/nang gi sdug bden yin rngu ra thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ma khyab na/ phar phyin mtha' dpyod las/ nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig ces gsungs pa dang / mkhas grub byatshoms pa bkra shis kyis kyang / ma dag pa'i snod kyi 'jig rten chos can// 'khor ba yin par thal/ sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ de chos can/ sems can gyi rgyud kyis bsdus par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ zhes mi 'dod pa'i thal ba 'phangs pa rnams mi 'thad par thal lo/ /de dag ni nang gi 'khor ba la dgongs zer na/ de'i rjes 'brang gi mkhas pa sus kyang de ltar ma bkral bas/ rnam 'grel las/ nan gyis khyod 'di 'dod byas pa/ /gas la bar dbang phyug spyod pa yin/ /zhes pa'i lung gis zin pa de khyod min nam / yang / sdug bden yin na 'khor ba yi/na rngazi sa khyab

//1///khri44// — — pha jipar thaṅge// 'dus byas surgyu ra pa'i zag bcas yin na 'khor ba yin pas —khyab pa'i phyir/ tigs khas/ 'dod na/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes/ de lta bu'i 'khor ba'i skye ba de ni sdugabaden miyang gtso po yin pas/ cho rnam 'grel gyi lung don yang de ltar 'grel dgosa'itsung / sdug bden la 'khor bas khyab pa'i don du mi gzung ngo / /zhes dang / 'jam dbyangs me'i rnam rol rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis kyang / sdug bden yin na 'khor ba yin pas ma khyab ste/ lhag bcas myang 'das pa'i rgyud kyi gzugs phung de sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ zhes gsungs pa rnams mi 'thad par thal lo/ /zheso bris 'dug go /tshul 'di la brten nas kyang khyod la skyon bzhi 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/ skyon dang po ni/ nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig ces khas blangs pa mi 'thad de/ nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig ma yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ lhag bcas pa'i zag phung nang gi sdug bden yin yang 'khor ba ma yinapa'i phyir/ der thal/ se ra kun mkhyen gyi lung khyod la 'thad ba'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ 'di ni lung dang bo khas blangs pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba yin na rgyud kyis bsdus pa yin pas khyab par khas blangs pa mi 'thad de/ rten 'brel rtsom 'phror lhag bcas pa la zag bcas kyi phung bo de ldan yang de rgyud la mi ldan par gsungs pa'i lung khyed cag gis 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'di ni lung gnyis pa khas blangs pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gsum pa ni/ lung gsum pa sgras zin ltar khas len na 'khor ba la bcu gcig

— sgro 51 5pa skye ba zhig 'jog dgos pa la 'a khor ba la des ma khyab par nang dzisdug bden thams cad 'khor bar 'jog pa khyod kyis yig cha ltar khas len pa'i phyir/ 'di ni lung gsum pa khas blangs pa'i skyon te 4zhad gad miganas so/ /skyon bzhi pa ni/ lung bzhi ba'i don khyod la mi'athad par thal/ lung des lhag bcas myang 'das ba'i rgyud kyi gzugaspophung nang gi sdug bden yin yang 'khor ba ma yin par bshad pa gang / nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig pa khyod kyis drangs pha'i yig cha'i lung gis grub ba'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ 'di ni lung bzhi ba khasablangasapa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so / /des na nang 'gal 'ba' zhig tu 'gro ba'i lung kha la gang thogs 'dren pa ni bong bu rta dang / ra gan gser du dzu ba'i dus la 'tshams pa min na rigs smra gsar bu zhig gi rnam 'gyur yang ma byung snang la/ nang gi sdug bden dang 'khor ba don gcig tu bsgrub 'dod na lung de dag gi khungs sakhyod rang khams su song nas khyer 'ongs pa'i sa rdo'i 'og nas sa steng du blangs pa'i chogo'adra med na/ ston pa'i zhal nas paṇa grub la brgyud pa'i chos 'dra med par ga chod do/ /des na mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ tshig bzhi'i dogayang rtogs ba'i nus med par/ /'brel med tshig gi dpung tshogago'atshol ba'i phyir/ /lugasoms yongs su gdung ba'i dka' thub kyis/ /rang gi mig la brtse ba ma dor zhig /ces pa ltar khyod dang khyod 'dra ba tshig bzhi'i don ya nga rtogs pa'i nus pa med par 'brel med kyi lab rdol 'tshol ba dag gis rangasnagi mig la brtse ba bsten na legs so/ /'khyal gtam du/ yang bum pa

/5)kyi45 — sa chos can/ khyod la gang gis 'ching ba dang / gang du bcing ba dang / bcings pa'i ngo bo gsumā gyi sgo nas bshad lugs shig yod par thal/'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ lam rim las/ de yang las dang nyon mongs gnyis 'khor bar 'ching byed yin la/ de gnyis kyi dbang gis khams kyi dbang gis 'dod khams sogs gsum dang / 'gro bas phye na lha la sogs pa lnga'am drug dang / skye gnas kyi sgo nas mngal la sogs pa bzhir phung bo nying mtshams sbyar ba ni bcings pa'i ngo bo yin pas de las grol ba ni thar ba'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ zhes bris 'dug go /tshul 'di la brten nas khyod la skyon gsum 'bab ste/ 'ji ltar/ skyon dang po ni/ lung 'di'i don 'og tu rgyas par 'grol ba la mig yod par byos dang shes paraci'agyur bas/ 'di ni lung don phyin ci log tu song ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gnyis pa ni/ 'o na khyod rang la/byang 'phags rgyud kyi sred pa chos can/ khyod la gang gis 'ching ba sogs gsum bshad tshul yod par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa khas/ma grub na/ de chos can/ der thal/ nang gi sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ yang / dag zhing ba'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs dang nyon mongs kyi sa bon re re nas chos can/ khyod la gang gis 'ching ba sogs gsum bshad tshul yo da par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ dag zhing ba'i rgyud na de dag yod cing de dag 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal yin pa sngar mdo lung sogs kyis bsgrubs zin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang / thog ma'i ma rig pa chos can/ skye gnas bzhi gang rung du nyire sku

517mtshams sbyar ba'i phung bo yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ 'dod na/ rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i sdug kun gang rung la bcu gcig pa skye bas khyab par thal lo/ /yang / bar srid pa'i phung bo chos can/ rigs drug gang rung du nying mtshams sbyar ba sogs gsum bshad tshul yod par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ 'di ni 'khor ba mtha' dag la gang gis 'ching pa sogs gsum tshang dgos pa'i khyab 'brel nor ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi/ gnas so/ /skyon gsum pa ni/las nyon gnyis gang gis 'ching byed dang / gang bcings pa'i ngo bo gnyi ga yin par thal/ dang bo gang zhig gnyis pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po lam rim gyi lung gis grub la/ gnyis pa der thal/ de 'khor ba gang zhig 'khor ba la gang bcings pa'i ngo bos khyab pa gzhung 'di'i don du khyod 'acidod pa'i phyir / rtas/sa dang po grub ste/ nang gi sdug bden yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab khas/ rtsa bar 'dod na/ gzhi gcig la ltos pa'i 'ching byed dang bcings pa'i ngo bo gcig tu thal lo/ /'di ni bya byed las gsum gcig tu thal ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ bya ba nyams kyis mi lcogs pa/ /gzhan gyis sbyar kyang byar mi rung / /dge 'o dge 'o zhes smras pas/ me yi nang du su zhig mchong / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang si/ blos lcogs mi lcogs la mi lta bar mi 'os pa'i las la zhugs te glen pa me nang du lcibs pa'i brtul zhugs bzung ba 'di snying re rje/ 'chal tshig tu/ yang dam bca' ba'i skye ba 'de chos can/ 'khor ba yin par thal/ las nyon gyis bskyed

ri518pa'i dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ ma khyab na/ ma dag pa'i snod bcud thams cad 'khor bar 'dod pa'i rgyu mtshan nyams la/ 'dod na/ de chos can/rab byung ma yin par thal/ 'khor ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ /khyab 'brel rigs lam 'phrul lder gsal/ zhes bris 'dug go/ /tshul 'di la brten nas kyang khyod la skyon gsum 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/ skyon dang po ni/ gong du 'khor ba la las nyon gyi dbang gis skye ba zhig dgos par smras nas/ 'dir dam bca' ba'i skye ba 'khor bar mi 'jog par bsgrubs pa 'di ni rang tshig snga phyi 'gal ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gnyis pa ni/ dam bca' ba'i skye ba zhes pa dam bca' ba kho na la go 'dug mod/ dam bca' ba chos can/ skye 'chi gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de 'khor ba ma yin par thal/ dam bca' ba'i skye 'chi dam bca' ba'i blang bya'i phung bo ma yin pa'i phyir/ yang / myu gu chos can/khyod kyi skye 'jig khyod las gzhan med par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ yang /dud 'gro'i skye 'chi sogs chos can/ dud 'gro rang nyid las gzhan mi 'jog par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ 'di ni skye ba'i don khyab chung ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gsum pa ni/ rigs lam 'phrul lder gsar bu ba dag gis rigs pa 'phen shes phyir yin pa min par bsgrubs pa dang min pa yin par bsgrubs pa la khyab pa de snyed bcad pa thams cad spyir rang lugs mtha' gcig tu bzhag pa min pa bsdus grwa ba gsar bu tshun la rlung ltar grags mod khyod nyid sgrub byed kyis phongs drags nas lung de tsam la skyabs su song ba snying rje las kyang snying rje'i gnas su

519'khums so/ /'di ni rgyab dpung nor ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnasaso / /tshul 'di yang / shes rab sdong bu las/ gzu lum can gyi spyod pa rnams/ /dgos pa myur du nyams par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar blun po gzu lum can gyi ngang tshul gsal bar byas pa'o/ /ngag 'khyal du/'o na 'khor ba'i ngo bo gang yin zhe na/ skyes bu'i shes rgyud kyis bsdus nga/'i zag bhacas nyer len gyi phung bo'i tshogs rgyun zhig la 'dod dgos te/ rnam 'grel thar lam gsal byed las/ tshogs rgyun 'jog mi shes pa dag ces pa nas/ rigs pa 'di dag gi dgag bya'i garu bo yin no/ /nes dang /ṭīka chen rigs pa'i rgya mtsho las/ des na las nyon gyi dbang gis nyer len gyi phung bo rgyun ma chad par len pa'i rgyun la 'khor ba zhes bya'o/ /zhes dang / dge legs 'od snang 'gyed pa'i nyin byed las/ tshe snga ma'i phung bo las sred len sogs dang / de dag las tshe 'di'i phung bo dang / 'di las kyang sred len sogs dang / de dag las kyang tshe phyi ma'i phung bo 'byung ba sogs kyis mtshon thog med nas da lta'i bar dang slan chad kyang las nyon gyi dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi phung bo rgyun ma chad par len dgortswapa 'di dze+e 2khor ba zer ba yin/ zhes sogs shin tu gsal bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes bris 'dug go /tshul 'di la brten nas kyang khyod la skyon gsum 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/ skyon dang po ni/4 rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i zag bcas kyi tshogs rgyun yin na 'khor pa yin pas khyab par thal ngo bo 'jog tshul 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gong du nying mtshams sbyar ba'i ming gzugs kyis bsdus pa'i bcu gcig pa skye ba zhig 'jog dgos par

520khas blangs pa dang dngos su 'gal ba'i phyir/ yang / lhag bcas dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi gzugs phung chos can/ 'khor ba yin par thal/ rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i nyer len gyi phung bo'i tshogs rgyun yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ gong du se ra'i yig cha rang lugs su drangs pa dang dngos su 'gal/'di ni rang gis smras pa snga phyi 'gal pa'i skyon te ba'/da gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba yin na tshogs rgyun yin pa ru khyab par thal/dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ tshogs rgyun ma yin pa'i nyer len gyi phung bo mi srid par thal lo/ /'dod na/ dngos bo yin na rgyun can yin pas khyab par thal lo/ /des na 'khor ba yin na zag bcas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rgyun gyis khya/ ba kyang rang gi ngo bo rgyun min pa du ma yod ba'i phyir/ 'di ni khyab chud ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ / skyon gsum pa ni/ ṭīka chen dang lam khrid kyi tshig zin gong du bshad pa ltar nyams len gyi gnad ston phyir yid 'byung skye ba'i gnas kyi gtso bo ngos bzung ba tsam min par khyab mtha' bzung ba yin na/ byang 'phags rgyud kyi nyon mongs lhan skyes chos can/ las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis blangs pa dang len pa'i rgyun gang rung yin par thal/ de gnyis tshig zin ltar 'thad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ byang 'asdogs de chos can/nyon mongs lhan skyes len pa bo yin par thal/ derme tshonyon mongs lhan skyes blang bya dang las nyon gnyis len byed du khas len pa'i phyir/ 'khor gsum/ 'di ni lung don ma go ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ / tshul 'dis kyang / ji skad du/ gang blo dngul chu'i thigs pa ni/ /khu

la ///)/rdo/rtiX1 kyitshur drag pos bzung ba ltar/ /rnam par dpyad pa tsam gyis ni/ /zhig cing zhig cing 'gyur ba gang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar blun po rnams kyi blo gros kyi rang bzhin khong du chud do/ /ngag 'chal du/ sgra bshad ni/ zhes lung drangs pa rnams phyi nang gi 'khor ba'i dngos po rnams sdug kun gcig nas gcig tu ba rgyud de 'ong ba'i tshul gsungs pa yin gyi/ 'di dag gis nang gi chos su yang bstan to/ /zhes khyod kyis smras pa ltar lung de dag gis 'khor ba la nang gi sdug bden gyis khyab par bstan pa ga la yin/ 4'chal gtam du/ de la kho na re/ bum sogs zag bcas thams cad 'khor ba yin par thal/ zin bris bla ma'i sku tshab las/ srid rtse nas mnar med kyi bar gyi snod bcud thams cad khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal/ zhes pa nas/ zer na/ zhes bris 'dug go /'di ni nang gi 4shes rab kyi mig long ba tsam du ma zad phyi thos byed kyi ṅge ba'ang 'on pa'i rang rtags te/ de dag ni phyogs snga mas zag bcas la khyab nga 'du byed kyi sdu ga bsngal gyis khyab par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i gzhung yin gyi/ zag brtas kyi dngos bo la rakhor bas khyab pa'i dngos kyi sgrub byed du gsungs ba thos pa'i gang zag su zhig yod/ rang nyid gang la'ang brtag zhib med par zer rgyus phongs pa'i cal col lo/ /log bshad du/ da dung yang brjod par bya ste/ mtha' dpyod myu gu las/ zhes pa nas/ zhes sogs lung mtha' yas la/ de rnams kyi don nang gi chos las gzhan la 'grel lugs ji ltar yong / ces bris 'dug go /lung de dag khyod kyis bshad pa ltar don la ma zhugs pa'i tshul 'og tu rgya sa/ par sgrub pas shes par 'gyur pas/ rang

522rtsod pa'i skabs go ba rags thob pa'i rtags bstan snang ngo / /log bshad du/ der yang dgongs pa len pa skad byed pa ni sangs rgyas las kyang nga mkhas snyam pa'i 'khrul skad chen po'o/ /de'i phyir mkhas grub chen po lcang skya rol ba'i rdo rjes/ ha cang gtam gsar ba mang drags na ra pho dkar bo lug khyur mi tshud pa'i dpe ltar rang nyid ston chen gyi gral nas bud kyis dogs/ zhes gsu ngas pa ltar lags pas cung zad bag 4rikhums par gyis shig 'di ni nga'i gdams ngag yin no/ /zhes bris 'dug go /tshul 'di la brten nas khyod la skyon bzhi 'bab ste/ 'di ltar/ skyon dang po ni/ lung don—rigs pa dri ma med pas 'byed pa la gtsigs su mdzad pa nyid rgya bod kyi mkhas pa spyi'i lam srol rtsod med du grub pa la/ lung sna gang mthong la ngo gdong sor bzhi'i go thob bam me ba zhig thebs pa na bo/ ba a mchod dang rigs pa rgan mo la mi 'gran pa'i de nyid ngo ma shes par sangs rgyas las kyang gting phug pa lta bu'i 'khrul snang la ngo bo nyid nas 'byams klas pa'i dbang gis shog byang bzhi lnga tsam bris pa 'di gcig pur yang rang tshig snga phyi dngos 'gal du shor ba glang chen gyis khur du mi theg — pa'i tshad longasacirang grub tu byung ba 'di gar mchis pas/ bdag gi rje bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs nas mkhas pa so so'i bzhed dgongs lung don dri ma med pa'i rigs pas gtan la phab/ tshad thub kyi lung gi dpung char du bsnyil ba la rigs pas grub pa'i dgongs pa blangs pa 'khrul skad du smras pa ni/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas/ phal cher gsung rab lta la phyogs re'i mig / lung don rigs pas 'byed pa'i mju med pas/ /bstan pa'i gnad rnams

523rdzogs pa'i gdams pa mchog /rgyal ba dgyes ba'i lam dang bral mthong nas//zhes dang / mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pas/ /rigs pa'i lam du ngal ba ma byas shing / /shing rta chen po'i srol bzang ma mthong ya nga / /blo gros chung ngu tshig gis khengs pa yis/ /lung tsam skyabs su 'dzin pa blun po'i phul//zhes gsungs pa ltar rang nyid 'phral du gang mthong gi lung tsam skyabs su 'dzin pa la gtsor zhen gyis nang brtag bstan pa'o/ /'di ni tshad thub kyi lung 'tshol mi shes shing lung don rigs pas 'byed ba'i mthu med pa'i rtags bstan pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gnyis pa ni/rin ngo/ che gsum gyi gtam gyi sbyor ba las/ rigs lam phra mo phyed pa'i rnam dpyod dang / /gzhung lugs gdams par shar ba'i nyams len dang / /tshig sbyor tshul la mkhas pa'i ngag gi dpal/ /sa steng 'di na rin chen rnam gsum snang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa ni rin po che rnam pa gsum gyi yon tan lhan skyes su mnga' bas mkhas ba'i mdun sar de ga'i khyad chos mngon du mdzad de rigs pa dri ma med pas dam bca' g.yo ba med bar mdzad pa/ khyod ni lung rig tshad sbas zin ltar 'dod cing dri ma med pa'i rigs pa la dgrar lta ba'i skye bo yang dag pa'i rigs pa'i srog gcod pa'i bshan par snang ngo / /'di blang dor nor ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon gsum pa ni/ /sdug bden dang nyer len gye phung bo dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal la 'khor bas khyab par bshad pa nyid gtam gsar pa'o zhes phyogs su 'phud 'dod kyang / kha sho la tshig shed dang dpung chag la lag shed 'byung ba gnas oṃ

524 yin te/ 'og tu lung rigs kyis rgyas parngo sgrub pa ltar/ pha gcig blo bzang grags pa/ /mes po rgyan drug ma/chog gnyis/ yang mes shākya thub pa'i zhal gtam yin pas pha mes kyi ngaka/ rgyun gtam gsar bar 'khrul ba ni rang nyid mthong rgya dang thos rgya chung ba ste/ ‘radi ni gtam gsar rnying go ldog tu song ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /skyon bzhi ba ni/ 'khor sgyur la sprang bos gsog srung dang / rgyal bo la gdol bas 'bangs skyong dang /mig can la long bas lam ston gyi dpe bzhin rang tshod rang gis mi zin pa'i gti rgan/ mkhas pa'i yang rtse la 'chal gtam smra ba la ya mi nga ba'i spyi brtol can/ khrom du rang nyid gto byed pa la gnong mi 'khur ba'i pho shal khyod lta bus ni/ yon tan gyi phung bo mtha' dag lhan skyes su khong nas rdzogs pas rgyal ba rnams kyang ngo mtshar ba'i gnas la 'god pa/ /blang dor gyi gnas mtha' dag lag mthil gyi rdzas bzhin 'khrul med du ston pa/rtsod pa'i dus kyi paṇa chen ngag gi dbang bo 'di lta bu la bslab ston byed pa ni chos kyi de nyid shes pa lta ci 'jig rten gyi phyogs tsam la yang ce re long du gnas pa'i rang rtags so/ /'di ni gdams ngag byin pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /ngag kyal dbyangs su byas pa'i bya ba mthar phyin pa'i skabs su/ / rnam dag lung gi 'dab ma rab tu rgyas/ /dri med rigs pa'i ze'u 'bru phang phung g.yo/ /brjod don zab mo'i sprang rtsi'i bcud chags ba'i/ /legs bshad pad+ma'i sdong bo deng 'dir grub/ / ces bris 'dug go /ngag 'khyal du drangs pa'i lung phal cher dpyad gsum rgyus dag pa'i lung yin yang / khyod kyis 'bru 'grel log par byas nas rnyog

/ sa ma ga ba//5/rdoshārtiphu//mi ma can kyi lung du btang ste drangs pa lung drangs pa'i skyon te/ 'chal gtam 'dirapyirgya gzhung gi lung yig cha na yod par gnyis las drangs med pa la bltas na khyod kyi slob ma dag gis khyod lta rgya che skad gleng ba la snying nas yid ches so/ /res nang gi sdug bden la 'khor bas khyab pa dang / res lhag bcas dgra bcom pa'i zag phung yang 'khor ba min par bsgrubs pa dang / res 'khor ba la bcu gcig pa skye bas khyab par bshad pa dang /res 'khor ba la kun nas nyon mongs pa gsum ci rigs kyis khyab par smras ba dang / res 'khor ba la tshogs rgyun gyis khyab par bsgrubs pa dang /res grub mtha' gong 'og bsres te bshad pa dang / res mngon pa'i lung don phyin ci log tu smras pa dang / res phyogs snga ma'i bzhed pa ma longs par thal ngag bkod pa sogs mdor na thal ngag gang bkod rang mgo gcog byed kho na las thal ngag rnam dag tu song ba gcig kyang med pa dang /brjod bya shing rta chen po 4klob sras dang rje thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras kyi dgongs mthil lase phyi rol tu gyur ba sha rnya ga tu sna nga bas log bshad 'ba' zhig las legs par bshad pa gcig kyang mi snang ngo / /'di ni sho lo ka dang po'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha mthar ma son cing / /rigs lam phra mos bdar sha chod min yang / /gzhung don nor bu brtag la mkhas pa 'di/ /e ma lha dang bla ma'i drin las ci/ /zhes bris 'dug go /mkhas pa' ded dpon gyi mgon dang phrad kyang nang gi rkyen tshang ba'i sgo nas tshul bzhin ma bsten pas grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son rwa4 lta ci phyogs tsam yang ma marbo nga ba 7 ) nga / ṅgha/na zhus/sari 0/ti thug

526 — — —— tu song bas rigs 3 3 phra mo lta ci rags pa la'ang bdar sha cha chod par rang gis khas bladzis pa ltar/ bdag gis spyang de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ thams cad la rtsod med mthun snang du grub pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes smra'o/ /gzhung don la brtags pa gang bcug rtsing lam du 'amyan pa dang / phyin ci logā gi blo sna rnyed pa lha dang bla ma'i dngos grub tu rtsi ba a re blun/ 'di ni sho lo ka gnyis pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /deng sang sprin bral mkha' la rtag 'char ba'i/ /mun sel 'od rab spro ba'i nyin mor byed/ /ring du btang nas srin bu'i 'phongs me la/ /rmongs pa'i mun pa sel phyir 'ga' zhig rgyug /ces bris 'dug go /khyod kyi de nyid gong du lan gcig ma yin par gcal du bkram pa ltar yin pas rang — nyid mun pa'i rteng bzhin du ngo bo nyid nas grub pa la nyin byed du rlom pa dang / sa gre/sum gyi sgron me dag la srin bu me khyer du snang rngo ni gang snang log par 'phyan pa'o/ /'di ni sho lo ka gsum pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /de bas ma dros las byung lam gsum 'bab/ /yan lag brgyad dang lhan pa 'di bsten na/ /tsha reg skom gyi gdung ba mi 'byung zhing / /phan bde char du bdo ba dngos bo'i gshis/ /zhes bris 'dug go /'di la/ rgyang 'phen pa'i gzhung lugs kyang phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas su gyur pa'i lung gi bsta na pa dri ma med pa yin par thal/ rgan zhugs kyi kha 'khyal 'di phan bde 'byung ba'i gnas su gyur pa'i lung gi bstan pa dri ma med pa yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khas/ khyab ste/ rgyang 'phen pa'i gzhung lugs dang rgan zhugs pa'i gzhung lugs gnyis log ba'i gtam

tre—— /blo/tswa/mi41/'ba' zhig gi phung bo yin pa 'dra ba'i phyir ro/ /skyugs pa la bdud rtsiro'akhrul ba 'di ya cha/ 'di ni sho lo ka bzhi ba'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /'di ni rnam dpyod gting mtho' med pa'i mtsho/ /lung rigs gdengs can rtse dgas rol ba las/ /legs bshad rlabs phring 'gyed pa 'ga' mchis na/ /dgag lan zegs mas bdag yid brlan par mdzod//cesadang / gong du/ phran gyis bshad pa dag lam du ma song phyin dri ma med pa'i lung rigs kyi sgo nas tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gyi bka' drin skyongs jidang / yi rang gi me tog 'thor nges pas de bzhin thugs 'jags 'tshal/nes 'gal 'du'i ngag kyal 'di ni nad brgya sman gcig dang gdon brgya sngags gcig yin rgyu'i log bsam gyis sus kyang lan mi sbobs pa'i gnas su rloms nas snyan sgron lta bu'i tshig kyang bris pa la/ da ni kho bo cag nas/'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin rlabaṭa/ kyis mkhyen rab kyi pad+mo yongs su/ grol ba/sbyang bar bya ba mtha' dag la sbyangs ba'i mthar gtugs pa/ dpal nā len+d+ra'i sdon gyi mkhas ba chen po rnams migral du bgrang rung ba/ bdag gi pha bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa 7 dpal mi pham mtsho byung bzhad pa'i lang tsho'i gsung ngag dri ma med pa lung dang rigs pa'i gter kha klong du brdol ba gang nyid 'jigs pa med pa seṅge nga ro'i dbyangs su bsgrags pa 'di bzhin mchis pas rang nyid gzu bor gnas shing legs nyes 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod kyi mig zur cung zad phyes bar gda' na/ sngar byas kyi dri ma la 'gyod tshangs dang / slad mar rtsod dus kyi mkhas ba mi'i seṅge gang la/ dad pa dang gus pa/ dga' ba dang spro ba/ gzengs bstod dang zhe bsngags yang

///rdobye//rdo///rdo — dzha phya 4la tsho ra gu dag par gyis shig da dung dug sbrul gyis gla rtsi'i dri tshor ba bzhin du 'gyur na sngar gyi de bas brgya 'gyur gyi phrag dog dang zhe sdang gi ting nge 'dzin la nyin mtshan du mnyam par zhog la sdod cig bdag cag deng nas byang chub snying bo'i bar/ /dri bral mkha' la shar ba'i nyi ma dang / /'dab stong ldan pa'i mdza' ba bzhin gyur nas/ /theg mchog lam gyi bgrod pa mthar phyin shog /ces bris 'dug go /nang du phrag dog dang zhe sdang dang nga rgyal dang 'gran sems kyis/ bdag gi bla ma mi'i zur phud lnga ba la gnod pa'i byed pa 'chang bzhin kha dang sems mi mthun pa'i smon lam 'debs pa 'di yang g.yo sgyu'i rnam 'gyur sba bar ma nus pa'i rtags so/ /'di sho lo ka drug pa'i skyon te bzhad gad kyi gnas so/ /da ni 'di skad kyang brjod par bya ste/ khyod kyis/ pha bla ma sangs rgyas kun dngos mtshan brjod par dka' ba de nyid kyi gsung zin yin khul gyis rang gis log zin sa/zu lum du spel bar/ sngags ram gyi bya rgyud thad kyi phyogs snga sla ba'i 'dod mthun rang lugs dang dngos su 'gal ba dam ye bsre ba bla med kyi lugs yin par bshad pa lta bu gzhung dang 'gal ba'i log zin dang / bde lam dang pha bla ma'i lam khrid rang gi tshogs zhing gi thad tsam yang ma nges par rtsa ba'i bla ma la chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa zhes zer mi rung pa lta bu gang la'ang rtog dpyod mi gtong bar hang 'gros byas pa'i log zin dang / dpal mchog ṭom+bi ba dang ṭosbi he ru ka gcig tu 'khrul ba lta bu deb ther ma nges pa'i log zin dang / 'jam dbyangs dga' blo'i dris lan brgyad pa ma mthong stabs 'jam dbyangs dga' blo zer rgyu la —

529'jayodabyangs bde ba'i rdo rje zhes bris pa lta bu gang zag ma ngegaba'i log zin dang / gser btso galta bu zheyopa dkar la dmar mdangs chags ba'i don du bshad pa dang / rnam shes min pa'i rnam shes kyi/ /zhesposogs dang / srid pa na yang gnas par byed/ /ces sogs kyi lung don log par 'grel ba sogs lung don ma shes ba'i log zin dang / theg chen gyi gdams ngag yin na klu sgrub thogs med gang rung la thug pa dgos zhes pa ltabu rigs lam la mabyang ba'i log zin gyis mtshon pa'i/ lo rgyus ma nges pa rnam thar ma nges pa/ rtsa 'grel ma nges pa/ dpe don ma nges pa/ dgos don ganges pa/ skabs don ma nges ba/ rgyu mtshan ma nges pa/ tha na lam rim che chung dang / lam khrid nyid kyi tshig zin rags pa tsam yang ma nges pa/ go thob thob song ba/ rigs lam la ma byang pa/ rang tshod rang gis ma zin pa/ kha sna la gang thogs bris tshad yin thag chod las the tshom tsam yang ma zhugs pas log zin bris pa so sor brjod na mtha' klas ba zhig snang yang thams cad rjen char du 'bri ba la/ pha bla ma 'khor los sgyur ba la bu kha sho khyod 'dra ba'i zhabs 'dren byung ba nged yab rje dam pa'i slob rigs su gtogs tshad gdong gyen du 'degs pa la gnong ba khur du mi theg pa mchis stabs/ khyi lud yin yang 'gebs grogs dang / log skyon yin yang gsang grogs kyi rams btegs chibe yin mod/ ngan pa sdod mi tshugs par dbyu gus rnga la snun pa'i byed pa lag len la bkal na hrags sgra snying nas mi 'dod kyang rna ba 'gas pa'i rang gshed du 'bab pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid du song gshis rna bar gzan pa'i dus kyang yong nyen gda'/ de ltar ngan pa stong gsob

530'di nyid la ngag kyal khrom du bsgrags nas rang mtshang rgyal mtshan bzhin du 'phyar dgos pa'i kheg ci ya nga dmigs su ma mchis na yang / dpal chos dbang grags pas/ tshig rtsub kha chu rnam par 'dzag ldan pa/ /ltag chod ca co mang bos rna ba la/ /'on pa ster byed wa skyes tshogs mang yang /so ldan rigs rgyud bzung bar nus ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar phrag dog dang rmongs pa mi bzad pa'i sug rjes su thod la drang srong gi dmod pa lhung ba bzhin du kha lag sdod mi tshugs par tshig rtsub dang ltag chod mang bos rang nyid rmas ba'i sbyor ba la zhugs te rang nyid gsal bar ston pa'i me long 'di bris pa la/ rje phyogs las rnam rgyal chos dbang grags pas/ kun mkhyen smra ba'i seṅge la/ /rgol byed rtsod lan smra ba'i khyi/ /srog dang bral bar gyur ba'i gtam/ /kho bos cung zhig rnam par bsnyad/ /ces gsungs ba ltar kho bo cag nas/ rje bla ma dmigs pa med pa'i thugs/ rje chen po dang ldan pa/ rtsod dus kyi phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi blo bzang dpal ba'i gsung gi bdud rtsi dri ma med pa longs su byas te/ rgan zhugs pa'i ngag kyal gyi mchod brjod nas bzung mjug rtsom gyi bar tshig gcig kyang ma lus nga༈ra sun phyungs nas gcal du bkram ste/ kun mkhyen smra ba'i seṅge la klan ka 'tshol bar sems pa'i nor skyo nga gdug pa pham bar byas pa 'di bzhin gzur gnas blo ldan dag gis gzigs dang / kho rang gis gnod byed du bkod pa'i thal ngag 'chal 'chol gcig lam du song ba mchis na'ang kho bo cag nas phyag dang bkur snyis mchod nga ra g.yar dam 'cha'o/ /kha sgang 'gal 'du ba ni rgan zhugs su song gshis rigs pa smra

7 531ba'i re ba gnag rdzis kyang byed mi thang mod/ gsob kyi ngang tshul bzung nas smra ba ma mang bar bam bam byas te sdod tshugs na/ go ba a mchod du brtsis nas mgo bo rdog pas brdzis pa'i sdug bsngal nyams su bsten mi dgos pa la/ kha lag chags sdang gi bran du song ba'i ring la/ da ni gnyis med seṅge las ma byung ba 'di wa skyes ri dwags kyi rje bor rdzu ba las nyams dmas pa'i dpe ji lta ba bzhin nyams su myangs pa'o//smras pa/ blo chen yid dbang 'phrog pa'i lung rigs kyis/ /blo badz+wang bzhed dgongs ṅgikhrul med 'byed pa'i dpaskya/ /blo gros yangs pa gzhan gyis 'gran min pa/ /blo ldan snying gi gdung sel rgyal gyur cig /yid kyi nags tshal gdug pa'i byin za blas/ /bsregs las khaX yi klong du 'brel med tshig /dud ris nag por g.yo ba'i gīng bu la/ /kyi hud lus med phyogs kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /u hu chags sdang dug can glal ba'i lce/ /tshom med g.yo ba'i kha rlangs nag po'i shugs/ /mun pa'i bla bre stong las lhag pa zhig /byang rgyud 'dzin ma'i mkha' la stug por bres/ /rmongs bzhin 'chal tshig smyon pa'i cho nga'i sgra/ /yi ge'i lam la srin bu'i sug rjes bzhin/ /bris pa klog pa'i gzhon nu de dag kyang / /hu hu nyes bshad dug gi 'byung khungs nyid/ /'khrul ba'i snang ba dpal du rlom pa'i blos//zlos gar sna tshogasalhur len phye ma leb/ /a ho mun sel snang ba'i rtse mo la/ /mchong 'dod rang nyid rlog pa'i thabs min nam/ /mi bzad tshimi / gi phreng ba rngams gnag pas/ /col chung se'u bcu pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ /sngangs pas byang khog tsit+ta dmar ba'i khyim/ /tshal ba stong du gas par ma
