///shā///rto414/ la —sa shā la kyis/ /lto 'gro— gdug pa'i klad la bsnun te ldang du med par bcom pa yis/ /e ma yongs 'dzin 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i dbu 'phang 'og min zhing la btegs/ /'di na bden tshig rig sngags kyis/ /log pa'i mtshan rgyu lhag ma byas/ /gzhung bzang stong gi dgongs pa'i snying / /cig car nyid du gsal bar byas/ /dam pa'e 'phrin las lan brgya ru/ /srid rtse'i bar du ci yang bstod/ /gang dang lhan cig rmongs pa'i khyu/ /'dzin ma'i rkang sen 'og tu brdabs/ /rgyu des rgol ba ngan pa'i blo/ /nyin byed nub pa'i pad+ma la/ /rkang drug 'khyud pa'i rnam 'gyur bzhin/ /'dar ldan bzhin gyi me long nyams/ /rjes/ su spyod pa'i khyu tshogs kyang / /bzod med snying la ri bos non/ /de lta na yang cod pan gyi/ /'khrul ba'i ri mor ci byar yod/ /dpal ldan rtsod pa'i dbang phyug ni/ /'jam dpal bas kyang 'jam dpal zhes/ /bsngags pas bsngags pa de lta mod/ /de yis bskrun pa'i sras dag kyang / /yon ta na nor gyi bang ba zhes/ /phyogs kyi jubeden pa smra ba'i phreng / /de dag longs spyod 'khor lo'i rnga/ /dgongs pa gcig tu chub pas brdungs/ /zang zing grags snapa kho na'i phyir/ /phyi mayongs btang rang bzo'i gtam/ /smra ba'i spyi mo brtol shugs skyed pa/ /'gal 'du'i phung bo khyod kyi tshul/ /shing rta che dang rgyal ba'i lung / /rigs pa'i gseng lam las drangs nas/ /gsal byas lam gyi rim pa la/ /bsgrigs 'di bdag gi bla ma'i srol/ /lung sto mang sprin gyi phung bo las/ /rigs pa'e dbyar tre 'khrol dang lhan/ / tshig gyen glog gi do shal gyi/ /rked chings grol ba gtam 'di'i dpal/ —/ sgyu

/5(1(5 —— — —— — — —— ——— ge zung——— — — yis 'phags bod gzhung mang bor/ /yang dang yang du sbyong ba'i thabs su smon/ /gang gang phyogs lhung gdon gyis myos pa dag /mang mang lung rigs gtam gyi sbyor ba 'dis/ /gsal gsal rnam 'byed blo yi mig sbyangs nas/ /myur myur gsung rab dgongs don rtogs par shog /gser zhun bsregs bcad brdar lta'i 'khrul med pa'i/ /gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i mdo sngags srol/ /gser sbyangs btso ma bzhin du lham me bar/ /gser ldan khyon du nyams med dar gyur cis /bdag kyang deng nas nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par/ /bdag nyid che 'di'i 'phrin las bla nas blar/ /bdag nyid gcig pus 'degs pa'i skal bzang ni/ /bdag gi dngos bo mchog tu 'gyur la re/ /mdor na log smra yid kyi glang bo dri ma med pa'i lam la zhugs te bdag gi 'dren pa chos kyi rgyal bo'i gdul bar bya ba nyid du smin/ /kun mkhyen rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs pad mi shigs rdo rje'i khams su sgun grub legs mdzad 'chi med bdud rtsi'i thig le gegs med phyogs kyi 'gram par brdal/ /'di smra bo yang byang chub bar du mi yi 'jam dpal gang 'dis rjes bzung gsang ba mchog gi bang mdzod mtha' dag khur du 'khyer la mi ngal zhing / /lta sgom spyod pa dri mas yongs btang mdo sngags 'gal med nyams su bzhes pa 'khrul bral blo bzang bstan pa'i bka' srol rdzogs ldan las kyang dar gyur cig /de ltar bden pa bzhi las brtsams pa'i rtsod yig legs par bshad pa 'jigs med rigs pa'i gad rgyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba'i sa/sung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs don shing rta chen po dang rje yab sras kyi bzhed pa ji lta ba banin dri ma med

587pa'i lung rigs kyis phyin ci ma log par gtan la 'bebs pa la mkhas pa'i mdun sar 'jigs pa med pa'i khyu mchog rlabs po che'i gnas mngon du mdzad cing lung rtogs yon tan gyi phung bo nam mkha'i mtha' las brgal ba bdag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sa'i steng na 'gran pa'i zla thams cad nas thams cad du bral ba/ rje thams cad mkhyerne pa gyi blo bzang dpal pa'i zhal snga nas kyis/ na tshod kyi me tog kha ma phye ba nas sgo thams cad nas thams cad du rjes su bzung ste/ mdo sngags rig gnas kyis bsdus nga/'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i legs bshad kyi bdud rtsis bskyangs pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab par ma zad/ nad gdon bar chad thams cad byin rlubs kyi stobs kyis bsal cing 'phral gyi bya ba phra mo tshun la'ang bka' khyab kyis zin pa ra mdzad pas khyi gral nas lha gral bsnyegs pa/ 'phags bod kyi gzhung lugs mang bo la pho tshod dang rang bzo min par dam pa'i man ngag dang sbyar te cung zad sbyangs pas pha med pa'i bur ma gyur pa/ gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i rang lugs gzhan dang bsre lhad phra mo tsam yang med par tshe rabs nas tshe rabs su 'dzin pa la gus pa'i dbang bo rgyas pa/brub chin skal ldan rgya mtsho'i 'phrin 'a sa kyi gdugs dkar bo gcig gi 'og tu lha sde dkar bo'i rigs su dal 'byor gyi lus rten rnyed pa/ 'gar gyi sde snod 'dzin pa 7 'jigs med smra ba'i seṅge mi pham dbyangs can dges pa gnas lnga rig pa'i rdo rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i spong ba bas/ rje bla ma mchog gi gsung ngag dza lta ba bzhin rang bzos lhad ma bcug par/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i bgrang bya nga badzo/na pa/ bu lugs ltar

588 na srid zhi'i rnam 'dren don kun grub pa zil gnon me rta la sku bltams nas bgrang bya nyis stong brgyad brgya so bdun 'das pa/ phug d+kulugs ltar na nyis stong brgyad brgya gya gsum thal zhing / rgya la bstan lnga brgya phrag drug pa'i steng nas lo grangs sum brgya dang gsum song ba tshul khrims le'u'i smad cha/ byang phyogs cha bsags kyi zhing khams yangagabor chos kyi khri la dpal rigs ldan3 stobs po che rgyal phran go drug gi ral ba'i zur phud kyi rtse mor mnga' bsgyur nas bgrang gzhi bcu phrag dgu dang nyag ma drug 'das pa/ gangs ljongayotshad ma'i ston pa— rgyal pa 'jam dpal snying bo zhing 'dir gzugs sku'i nyi ma dang bor bzhad pa nas lo grangs lnga brgya re drug thal ba/ snyigs dus kyi dpal a ti sha rdo rje 'chang saṃ snya'i zhabs skyed bu'i gtsug tu smin pa nas bgrang bya don gcig brgal ba/ rtsod dus kyi paṇa chen ngag gi dbang bo blo bzang dpal ldan sprul ba'i zlos gar bsgyur ba nas lo zhe gnyis song ba/ smra ba ngan pa mtha' dag gi log rtog drungs nas 'byin pa po rang lo nyer drug tu slebs pa/ me mkha' rgya mtsho la 'das lo drug cu skor bcu bzhi dang bcu phrag lnga nyag ma drug bsres pa 'phags yul legs sbyar gyi skad du tu ti ru/ shar phyogs tsi na'i rgyal khab tu guhā/ stod 'grel bod kyi brda ru khrag skyugadabang thang dang bstun pa'i chu mo phag tu 'bod pa/ 'byung ba gsum ldan/ kha yan/ 4bla phrungs/ lnga ser rgyal po dgu bring gi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bo/ dbugs theg me tog can gyi dus tshigs/ nyin byed kyi dbang bo lug khyim du spyod pa/ nyal chu shel gyi dbang bo sa ga'i tha bor slebs pa/ dus 'khor ba'i dbyar pa/ — rgya rtsis ba'i dbyar tha/ hor gyi zla ba zhi ba/
